documents.title: Jev 可行性评估
documents.text: # Jev 可行性评估 2026-09-28；本次决定为**先评估，暂不调整 Self-RAG 主线**。已核对仓库调用点和 TypeSafe 官方资料，Jev 实际请求数为 0，没有安装 SDK、修改默认模型或上传项目源码。当前进程没有 `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`，未检查其他凭据存储。 ## 结论 值得在“给定一条断言和可定位证据，判断支持、矛盾或材料不足”上进行小规模对照。现在没有证据支持把整套 Critic、规划或执行控制交给 Jev，也没有项目内质量、成本或延迟收益数据。前置大小模型路由涉及模型能力标定和失败后的升级成本，工作量大于新增一个分类请求。 当前训练入口 `scripts/run_self_rag_training.py::_train` 使用 `trl.SFTTrainer`，通过 LoRA 与反思 token 行训练进行监督微调。接入 Jev 将增加外部决策模型，不会把这段训练转换为 RLCD；RLCD 是 TypeSafe 对其模型训练方法的命名：[官方介绍](https://docs.typesafe.ai/introduction/machine-learning-primer)。 ## 已核对的接口与限制 `POST https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone` 接收 `state`、`model`、`questions`，使用 Bearer API key。Choice 返回选项及概率分布，Score 返回等级评分与分布，Noul 返回真假概率；响应包含实际模型版本和输入/输出 token。相同状态下多个独立问题可合并请求。[API](https://docs.typesafe.ai/api)、[问题类型](https://docs.typesafe.ai/primitives) 官方当前列出 `jev-1.13.0`，输入价格为 $0.042 / 百万 token、输出免费。若一个请求实际计费输入恰为一万 token，按此单价计算是 $0.00042；本项目尚无实际账单或端到端成本。官方标注请求总量 64k token，状态加最长问题 32k；英文效果最好，中文需要单独验证。[模型与价格](https://docs.typesafe.ai/models) Choice/Score 的 `confidence` 是从分布计算出的统计量，不能直接当作本项目的正确率。官方也明确披露数字、复杂间接推理、无关长上下文、低层表示、对抗内容和生成任务的弱项。这使它更适合判断整理好的源码事实或观察，而不适合直接读大量 IL 后决定运行正确性。[置信度](https://docs.typesafe.ai/confidence)、[已知弱项](https://docs.typesafe.ai/model-jaggedness/jev-1.13) 这是托管接口。官方声明不使用客户请求/响应训练，企业 ZDR 需另行安排；普通请求的数据保留不能按零保留推定。[数据政策入口](https://docs.typesafe.ai/legal) ## 仓库可复用位置 | 位置 | 当前实际职责 | Jev 可评估的增量 | | --- | --- | --- | | `evaluation/self_rag_critic.py` 的 `candidates_from_records`、`locate_quote`、`annotation_bindings` | 绑定真实问题、答案与原始上下文，检查引用文本是否存在 | 复用输入与引用定位；只替换语义支持度判断 | | `evaluation/self_rag_inference.py::infer(..., critic=...)` | 外部 Critic 回调和一次修订 | 已有注入点；先旁路评分保存判断，之后才比较修订策略 | | `libs/reranker/BaseReranker`、`RerankerFactory` | 配置驱动的候选重排 | 候选相关性评分的后续实验，无需新建检索系统 | | `planning/request_interpretation.py` | 有限规则识别明确指令，未决语义留给 RequirementProjection | 可评估未决请求类型；明确授权和否定范围仍由现有合同处理 | | `planning/model_selection.py::ModelPlanningTargetSelector` | 在已有证据中选择修改目标 | 名称中的 model 指模型参与目标选择；它不是轻量/强模型路由器 | | 原 Graph、ArtifactStore、执行与 Build/Runtime 模块 | 状态、来源、执行与实际验收 | 保持这些职责；Jev 判断作为带来源的观察输入 | 首个接入并非把 Jev 包装成普通文本生成器。现有 Critic schema 还要求生成 `core_claim`、`issue`、`evidence_quotes`，Jev 不生成这些内容。实验可先使用已经标注并能定位的断言与引用；产品使用时，断言提取由代码或通用模型完成，这部分成本要计入总额。 还有一个与供应商无关的职责混用：`existing_local_critic` 用 `select_generator_sample` 的“是否适合进入训练集”结果填充推理期 `accepted`。训练筛选明确排除拒答，而推理中证据不足时拒答可能正确。后续应分开训练筛选和修订决策。为什么要有它：换供应商不能修正错误的验收问题，也不能让正确拒答触发无效重写。 ## 项目现有实测给出的依据 现有本地 Critic 的六题校准，在修正两处主机评分口径后符合要求 1/6；原始运行和重评分分别保留。这个小样本说明需要检查判断质量，但尚不能预测 Jev 的表现。 14 道留出题的三种策略已完成，两个 Codex 评审者分别盲化审查各七题的全部策略答案；每题只有一个评审者，属于来源辅助 AI 评审。断言支持度依据生成时可见上下文与题设，完整度和效用审查另可参考题目作者的参考答案；模型反思标签不参与真值判断。 | 策略 | 无证据断言 / 可判定断言 | 完整回答 | 模型调用 | 输入 token | 整轮秒数 | | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | | 固定检索 | 10/37（27.0%） | 4/14 | 14 | 16,329 | 159.74 | | 当前反思 token 微调 | 57/104（54.8%） | 1/14 | 28 | 10,537 | 425.39 | | 本地外部 Critic + 一次修订 | 11/38（28.9%） | 5/14 | 42 | 59,239 | 802.41 | “完整回答”包含对不可答题的合理拒答，微调臂的1/14即带事实说明的合理拒答。固定检索和外部 Critic 各有一条歧义断言未进入真假分母。当前小样本微调没有显示质量收益；外部 Critic 的额外调用也没有降低该断言率。生成器是 Qwen3-1.7B，训练含五条审阅过的真实样本与五条合成机制样本；这些结果不能外推至更大训练或其他模型。各策略输出断言数不同，报告是描述性对照。原始数据与可重算汇总在 `e1/self-rag-independent-20260928/blind-review-01/quality-summary-01.json`，SHA-256 `368f87738ad95f6b4f1af1bcdfafdb5596819875117b44a9546ef7aee318523b`。 ## 建议的首轮对照，尚未执行 **结果判读与采用决定（上述14题）**：当前小样本微调方案在本轮明显退化，**不进入产品默认路径**；训练和重载成功只完成实现前提。外部Critic以三倍调用取得的结果尚未证明额外成本值得，**暂不推广**，优先核验“训练筛选条件充当推理接受条件”的职责混用。固定检索继续作为这组实验的对照基线，其27.0%无证据断言率也需要改进。为什么要有它：负面结果需要改变采用和投入决定，不能停留在表格，也不能把相对较好写成已经可用。 当前按[交付与评测共同推进](EVALUATION_FIRST_CYCLE.md)安排工作，七项证据责任保留。下一次Self-RAG改动针对输入协议、标签或推理决策的明确失效原因，记录反例及预期变化，再比较质量与总成本；Critic的修订收益还需与“直接重写一次”对照，Jev仍只作方案评估。为什么要有它：新实验应区分原因并支持下一步决定，保留研究目标不等于持续投入已退化的配置。 | 决定 | 为什么要有它 | | --- | --- | | 先用公开 RFC 的已有失败样本开发问题措辞；把之后评估的样本按原问题分组，预留整组不调参 | 同一问题的多个答案不能跨组制造独立样本量；现有 14 题用于新方案调优后须标为已暴露 | | 对相同断言和证据比较代码检查、本地 Critic、Jev；引用不存在先用代码判定 | 避免用新增材料或更好的输入准备冒充 Jev 单独收益 | | 一个局部判断提供“支持 / 矛盾 / 证据不足”，保留完整分布；明确概率针对给定证据下的支持关系 | 世界知识里的事实真假和当前材料的支持程度是不同问题 | | 先只记录预测；任何筛选/修订阈值只用开发集确定，再冻结评估 | 防止把未经测量的误判接成新的阻断点 | | 报告错误接受率、错误拒绝率、各类召回、Brier 分数与分箱样本数、覆盖率，并分开中文/英文和简单/多步样本 | 高 confidence 和总体准确率可能掩盖危险误判；小样本校准不能当保证 | | 同时记录实际版本、输入哈希、预测、token、含重试延迟与费用；后续修订实验再比较每个成功任务总成本和端到端完成率 | 单次判断便宜不一定减少修订、升级或总耗时 | 这次评估后的优先级：证据支持度对照，其次候选相关性；失败语义归类只处理明确错误码无法解释的部分。前置模型路由待不同模型在实际任务上的能力与成本有数据后再决定。源码一致性、路径权限、预算计数和真实构建/行为验收继续由代码与运行观察负责。为什么要有它：有限语义判断应减少现有工作量，而不是在所有节点增加一次模型请求。

documents.title: Retrieval Architecture Decisions And Open Gaps
documents.text: # Retrieval Architecture Decisions And Open Gaps ## 1. Purpose This document preserves the retrieval and Agentic RAG decisions discussed for RepoForge. It separates: - implemented facts; - design decisions; - hypotheses that still require experiments; - external project patterns worth studying; - specification material that must not be executed directly. It is not an implementation-completion record. Experimental claims become project facts only after the protocol in `docs/RETRIEVAL_VALIDATION_PLAN.md` has produced reproducible results. ## 2. Current Implemented Baseline Current source and focused tests already provide a controlled-agent foundation: - local source registration and stable source identity; - content/file hash based incremental indexing; - exact symbol indexing and lookup; - local BM25 indexing and query; - deterministic EvidencePack construction; - source authority and readiness gates; - optional dense-provider contracts that remain auxiliary; - evidence binding from retrieval into planning, proposal, review, and repair. This baseline proves coexistence of deterministic, symbol, and BM25 mechanisms. It does not prove that any mixed retrieval strategy improves end-to-end code generation over an `rg`-only baseline. ## 3. Missing Or Unproven Capabilities The following items are missing or lack production-quality evidence: 1. Agent-controlled decision about whether retrieval is needed. 2. Query-class routing among `rg`, symbol/AST, BM25, and dense retrieval. 3. Retrieval-result relevance or sufficiency scoring calibrated on real tasks. 4. Query rewrite followed by a second retrieval attempt. 5. Multi-step or multi-hop retrieval. 6. Controlled-agent RRF fusion. 7. Controlled-agent reranking. 8. Complete citation and source-span evaluation. 9. Ablation experiments comparing retrieval configurations. 10. Production dense cache, batching, incremental refresh, latency, and cost data. 11. Reliable workspace-change synchronization for disposable code indexes. 12. Rename/delete handling and stale-result fallback to live search. 13. Isolation between branches, worktrees, and index namespaces. 14. Revalidation of every consumed code result against current file content. 15. Measured downstream effects on Hook selection, wrong-file edits, review blockers, and final task success. These are implementation or evaluation tasks, not evidence that the project must adopt every technique listed above. ## 4. Differentiating Product Decisions The project can distinguish itself through source-specific retrieval authority, not by claiming that BM25 plus grep is novel. ### 4.1 Select Retrieval By Data Structure - Current code uses exact and structure-aware tools: `rg`, live file reads, symbol lookup, AST/LSP, and call-graph evidence where available. - Community notes, historical sessions, release notes, and fragmented technical discussion use lexical retrieval such as BM25/FTS with time and source filters. - Dense retrieval is evaluated only for vague intent or semantic mismatch where deterministic retrieval demonstrably misses relevant evidence. ### 4.2 Separate Relevance From Authority A high retrieval score does not grant permission to modify code. - Current `target_source` and verified API/source evidence may ground a patch. - Reference implementations and community notes generate hypotheses and search directions. - Raw community chat is never direct patch authority. - Build/runtime logs are authoritative only for the diagnostics they observed. ### 4.3 Require Cross-Source Verification A community or reference-project Hook hint must be verified against current source, current decompiled API, or current runtime evidence before it can affect an edit target. ### 4.4 Make Index Freshness Explicit - Persistent BM25 indexes are appropriate for slower-changing historical and community material. - Current code truth comes from the live workspace. - Symbol/AST/call-graph indexes are disposable navigation accelerators. - A code-index hit is re-read and re-hashed before it enters an EvidencePack. - Stale, missing, renamed, or branch-mismatched results fall back to live search. ### 4.5 Resolve Source Conflict By Authority When community guidance conflicts with current source or verified API evidence, the current source/API evidence wins. Scores from different source classes are not blindly merged into one authority ranking. ### 4.6 Measure Downstream Code-Agent Effects Retrieval quality is judged by both retrieval metrics and delivery outcomes: - correct Hook and source-span recall; - wrong-file modification rate; - review-blocker precision; - final controlled-task success; - latency, model/API calls, tokens, and monetary cost. ## 5. Recommended Three-Layer Architecture ### Layer 1: Persistent Historical And Community Retrieval Purpose: recover scattered experience, discussions, prior decisions, release notes, and curated community claims. Primary mechanisms: - local archive with source, timestamp, session/thread, author, and provenance; - BM25/FTS lexical index; - time, project, version, source-type, and confidence filters; - incremental hashing and append/update handling; - read-only output with `requires_verification=true` by default. This layer proposes search terms, Hook hypotheses, failure explanations, and reference patterns. It cannot authorize edits. ### Layer 2: Live Code And API Retrieval Purpose: locate the exact current implementation and verify patch targets. Primary mechanisms: - `rg` and direct live file reads as the freshness baseline; - symbol/AST/LSP/call-graph navigation for structural queries; - disposable incremental indexes scoped by repository, branch/worktree, and index version; - file existence, content hash, symbol identity, and source-span revalidation immediately before evidence consumption. This layer supplies patch-grounding evidence when authority and freshness checks pass. ### Layer 3: Evidence Decision And Control Purpose: decide whether, where, and how retrieval is used and whether its output is sufficient for the controlled delivery chain. Responsibilities: - classify the query and select retrieval tools; - keep source-class results and authority separate; - build EvidencePack citations and source spans; - enforce freshness, authority, readiness, and cross-source verification; - retry or rewrite within an explicit budget; - route insufficient evidence to blocked/repair/clarification states; - expose decisions to proposal review, eval, traces, dashboard, and MCP. LangGraph remains the workflow control plane. Retrieval does not approve or apply patches. ## 6. External Project Patterns To Study These projects are architectural references, not proof that their choices fit this project. ### Katok Study for historical/community material: - local archive design; - time/session filtering; - SQLite FTS/BM25 retrieval; - read-only access to communication history. Repository: <https://github.com/NomaDamas/katok> ### Semble Study for coexistence of literal search and code-aware retrieval: - code-aware chunks; - BM25 plus static embeddings; - fusion as an optional retrieval mechanism; - explicit use of grep for exhaustive literal matching. Repository: <https://github.com/MinishLab/semble> ### CodeSeek Study for structural code navigation: - AST-aware indexing; - symbol and dependency relationships; - BM25, dense retrieval, graph signals, fusion, and reranking; - incremental hash and Git-aware refresh mechanisms. Repository: <https://github.com/CodeBendKit/codeseek> ### What This Project Retains As Its Own Design - EvidencePack lineage; - explicit source authority; - evidence readiness; - source conflict resolution; - proposal review and permission gates; - build and runtime evidence boundaries; - eval-gated completion; - controlled MCP exposure. ## 7. Specification Restructuring Decision The current `DEV_SPEC.md` and `EVIDENCE_RAG_MCP_SPEC.md` contain useful detail, but repeated additions and imported legacy blueprints make them unsuitable as a single linear execution plan. The target structure is: 1. `DEV_SPEC.md`: concise normative product and control-plane specification. 2. `EVIDENCE_RAG_MCP_SPEC.md`: concise normative retrieval/evidence subsystem specification. 3. `docs/RETRIEVAL_VALIDATION_PLAN.md`: preregistered experiments and metrics. 4. `docs/references/`: imported or superseded blueprints retained for design reference without execution authority. 5. `docs/PROJECT_STATE.md`: current verified state. 6. `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_QUEUE.md`: unfinished executable work only. 7. `docs/SPEC_COVERAGE_MATRIX.md`: mapping from requirements to implementation and evidence. 8. `docs/audits/`: frozen historical evidence and acceptance records. Until physical extraction is completed, imported/legacy sections inside either SPEC are reference-only. They cannot create queue work or override the new normative rules. ## 8. Decisions Versus Hypotheses Accepted design decisions: - retrieval strategy is source-specific; - relevance and authority are separate; - live workspace validation is required for code evidence; - community evidence is planning-only until cross-verified; - LangGraph and review/eval gates retain execution authority; - experimental techniques do not enter the production path without measured benefit. Unproven hypotheses: - BM25 improves recall for community/history-dependent tasks; - symbol/AST navigation improves Hook recall beyond `rg` alone; - dense retrieval finds additional correct Hooks; - source-aware hybrid routing reduces wrong-file edits; - Agentic rewrite/retry improves final success enough to justify its cost. The hypotheses are defined and gated in `docs/RETRIEVAL_VALIDATION_PLAN.md`.

documents.title: BetterHitFeedback leakage audit
documents.text: authority: non_authoritative_derived_presentation # BetterHitFeedback leakage audit - The request contains no complete Hook identity or historical run identity. - The actual retrieval scope is an allowlist of `Assets/Scripts/Modules-ASM` and `Datablocks` under the supplied R8 root. - Natural API identifiers inside those roots are legitimate source facts. - Historical BetterHitFeedback implementation, technical annotation, Runtime expected/support records, project/queue documents, fixed-answer tests, and prior Agent/RAG output are explicitly excluded from actual retrieval. - Current assembly, historical implementation, and Runtime records may support independent annotation review; they are not actual retrieval inputs. - The validator checks the request for the fixture's fixed complete-answer literals and verifies the manifest allowlist and excluded source classes. This is a fixture-bound leakage check, not a held-out, promotion, RAG-quality, or Data Readiness claim.

documents.title: 活动文档入口清理与导航验证
documents.text: # 活动文档入口清理与导航验证 日期：2026-09-26。请求：移出活动入口中的历史叙述，复用现有能力导航，并围绕具体需求完成实现与入口验证。 本轮具体需求是文档入口清理；没有修改产品 Python、模型配置、审批机制或历史运行产物。文档任务的正常入口为活动文档链接和现有只读导航命令，不将它计作产品 Agent 真实任务成功。 ## 1. 改动与归档 | 活动入口 | 清理前行数 | 清理后行数 | 保留职责 | 原字节归档 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | [产品契约](../ACTIVE_PRODUCT_CONTRACT.md) | 1,802 | 56 | 稳定执行边界、权限与声明口径 | [原文](../ACTIVE_PRODUCT_CONTRACT.history-20260926.md) | | [项目状态](../PROJECT_STATE.md) | 2,980 | 54 | 可定位实现、事实层级、缺口和既有导航 | [原文](../PROJECT_STATE.history-20260926.md) | | [实施队列](../IMPLEMENTATION_QUEUE.md) | 1,679 | 27 | 当前选择、紧邻候选和执行方式 | [原文](../IMPLEMENTATION_QUEUE.history-20260926.md) | 原始字节快照取自当时工作区，包含此前未提交改动，不从 HEAD 还原。归档仍位于原 `docs` 目录，保持相对链接基址。旧 `Current Development Selection` 锚点保留短导航；旧 Follow Recoil 锚点只跳转历史段，不恢复旧任务。 归档是历史资料而非活动合同；只有当前问题需要追溯时才读取，不能据此恢复旧任务或授权。为什么要有它：原始证据应保全，但读取入口不能继续携带过期指令。 三个原文 SHA-256： ```text ACTIVE_PRODUCT_CONTRACT: efa702f781df6ddb68042eeb641bc0ad0ac002776cf3bd3db707f7916939fbb2 PROJECT_STATE: 8a028d56e2516591742489fefd3ca1be4f990c3c06f7de5a572cbb34c8f294ce IMPLEMENTATION_QUEUE: 6dcef223e9e37b0717840580d65f343e71bd4213f2824522ba47176b8d74f65f ``` 另有两处直接相关的小修：评测协议的历史交付链接改指归档；架构说明末尾失效的 `AGENTS.md section 2` 引用改为当前请求与适用工作约定。其他架构叙述与既有 WIP 保留。检查前身份见[快照清单](active_entry_cleanup_20260926/before.json)。 ## 2. 复用导航与静态链路 现有工程认知工具的 summary，以及 `CompleteCrosshairVerification`、`make_complete_crosshair_evaluator`、`PatchWorkerConfiguration` 精确符号查询，均已由并行只读调查执行并返回 exit 0。项目状态页仅保留代表性入口命令，不增加另一套索引或任务包。 源码核对路径：`cli.run-request` 加载 worker 配置 → `run_local_request` 注入行为裁判 → `RequestPatchExecution` 使用共享适配器 → lazy factory 按哈希/工厂名/kwargs 装配 → 组合 verifier 产生反馈。符号导航是定位工具，动态配置和真实执行仍需单独核验。 相关现有测试使用受控 HTTP、编译器或裁判替身，属于可复用回归资产；本轮没有运行这些产品测试或真实编译，不将它们写成新增通过结果。 ## 3. 本轮验证 验证覆盖归档字节、当前文档链接、两类历史锚点、无关 WIP、实际文档导航命令及 diff 空白检查。聚合结果保存在[最终验证记录](active_entry_cleanup_20260926/verification-final.json)。 独立审阅由没有参与编辑的审阅者检查：稳定合同是否遗漏、历史是否完整保留、是否仍有旧任务被标为当前、正常入口是否可定位。提出的历史交付链接修正已落实；最终只读审阅通过，没有发现稳定边界遗漏、旧授权恢复或将导航误报为产品通过。 首次检查保留在[原校验记录](active_entry_cleanup_20260926/verification.json)：归档、链接、无关 WIP 与导航均通过，但架构说明补丁将末尾 CRLF 改成 LF，导致“反向替换后逐字恢复”校验失败。仅恢复该补丁区域原换行后复核；已经通过且实现未变的导航不重复执行。 文档改动不运行无关产品模型或全套测试。为什么要有它：本轮验收对象是阅读和导航入口，产品成功率需要另行真实任务证据。

documents.title: Coding Agent v0 Internal Alpha：实际大目标、产品阶段与执行合同
documents.text: # Coding Agent v0 Internal Alpha：实际大目标、产品阶段与执行合同 ```yaml document_status: current_implementation_target document_version: 2026-08-24-rg-live-sufficiency-owner-audited completion_claim: none implementation_authority: current_user_selected_documentation_scope created_at: 2026-08-16 target_worktree: rag_capability_mainline target_branch: codex/rag-capability-mainline target_head_at_audit: 2c5f194957ed2bd7c151d65ee48d69a6dc5ee9be current_checkpoint_at_last_sync: 2c5f194957ed2bd7c151d65ee48d69a6dc5ee9be product_milestone: coding_agent_v0 first_integrated_delivery: coding_agent_v0_internal_alpha active_work_package: rg_live_evidence_sufficiency_owner_audit_complete_pending_p0_authorization current_product_stage: coding_agent_v0_internal_alpha_evidence_owner_identified rag_1a_role: internal_evidence_capability rag_1b_role: public_entry_adoption ``` > 本文定义当前产品里程碑及其第一条内部集成路径，不声称代码已经完成，不授权产品源码写入、Build、Runtime 或外部披露。 > 当前事实仍由源码、测试、真实运行报告和 `docs/ACTIVE_PRODUCT_CONTRACT.md` 决定；本文不得用于覆盖失败事实。 阅读和执行优先级：`§1 实际大目标与工作包构造 → §5 当前物理状态与第一失败层 → §8 唯一实施顺序 → §9 完成门`。模块清点、行数统计、历史工作树、文档分类和后续成熟化只提供背景，不得覆盖这四处当前执行合同。 ## 1. 目标与问题 当前仓库已经分别实现了通用 RAG、工程证据检索、Planning、Patch、Review、Dry-run、Build、Runtime、Repair、Eval、ArtifactStore 和 Workflow 能力，但还没有形成一条唯一、真实、可反复运行且由 observation 改变下一步的 Coding Agent 产品闭环。 当前主要问题不是模块缺失，而是： - RAG/ER 长期作为只读主线独立优化，真实下游消费者进入过晚； - 模型一度在第一次观察环境前承担 identity、跨引用和工具参数记账； - `evidence-request`、`intelligent-evidence-request`、`run-request` 和若干直接 Graph 入口并存； - WallCrawler、BetterHitFeedback 的领域规则部分进入通用入口或通用 Workflow； - 当前工作树和其他工作树存在尚未归并的代码、文档和安全加固； - Trace、Eval、Harness、Artifact 和 Workflow 的语境尚未统一。 Coding Agent v0 的目标是把现有能力组合成一条真实纵向链，不重新建设 Agent SDK： ```text 自然语言请求 → 观察允许的当前工程环境 → 形成证据与工程判断 → Implementation Plan → PatchProposal → Review / Dry-run → 隔离 Build/Test → 根据真实失败改变一次下一步 → 完成或明确阻断 ``` ### 1.1 当前唯一实际大目标 当前大目标不是“继续完善 RAG、EvidencePack、Graph 或失败处理”，而是在一个不预填目标文件、符号或 Patch 答案的自然语言 Issue 上，由同一个 Agent Runner 完成一条可客观判定的工作闭环： ```text 自然语言 Issue → 从当前受控工作区 observation 自主定位文件、符号和引用 → 阅读源码、测试和当前工程证据 → 形成可由真实消费者使用的 EvidencePack → 形成非阻断 Implementation Plan 和受限 PatchProposal → Review / Dry-run / 隔离 Apply → 执行预先绑定的客观 Build/Test 成功命令 → 若失败，将真实诊断作为 observation 返回 Agent → 形成与首次不同的受限修复 → 再次 Build/Test → 测试通过，或在支持边界内保存物理证据并明确停止 ``` Internal alpha 的产品完成必须同时证明： 1. 至少一条受支持 actual-only 任务最终 Build/Test 通过； 2. 至少一次真实 Build/Test 失败改变后续语义动作，并完成不同修复和再次验证； 3. 全过程没有读取 Golden、annotation、历史 Patch 或预填工程答案； 4. 所有写入发生在授权的隔离工作区，修改范围可审查且 `scope_violations=0`； 5. 结果由 Build/Test、diff、Artifact 和运行报告等物理事实判定，不由模型自评。 受控小工程可以证明 Runner、Patch、Build 和 Repair 的机械闭环，但不能单独证明大型仓库、GTFO 领域任务或生产成熟度。Internal alpha 完成后必须使用现有仓库中的真实小型 Issue 复核文件定位和修改能力，再进入 RAG-1B、领域 Harness 和 public alpha。 ### 1.2 大目标驱动的工作包构造 本节落实 OpenAI Docs 的结果导向工作方式：给出目标、相关上下文、硬约束、授权边界、所需证据、成功标准和输出格式；对 change/build/fix 请求，在授权范围内连续完成修改、检查和结果复核，不在每个安全步骤停顿。它是推进与交接格式，不新增 Product Schema、Artifact、Gate、审批状态或 Workflow 节点。 每个工作包开始前必须明确： ```yaml actual_product_goal: real_task: objective_success_command: workspace_and_revision: current_product_stage: target_next_product_stage: first_physical_blocker: why_this_change_advances_the_goal: authorized_change_scope: hard_constraints: required_physical_evidence: success_criteria: stop_condition: handoff_output: ``` 工作包结束时必须回传： ```yaml claimed_completion: completion_level: new_product_stage_crossed: objective_result: capability_advanced: physical_evidence: observation_changed_next_action: not_completed: first_remaining_failure: responsible_subsystem: checkpoint_and_worktree: next_product_stage: ``` 构造规则： - 大目标先于局部实现。局部修正只能来自同一真实任务的第一物理阻断，并必须说明修正后预期跨过哪条产品阶段箭头； - 安全、范围内的代码修改、相关非破坏性验证、diff 复核和一次必要重放属于同一工作包授权，不需要逐步暂停确认；外部写入、破坏性操作、昂贵操作或实质扩张范围仍需单独授权； - 环境、fixture、索引或依赖准备必须与产品能力分开报告；修复环境只能声明前置条件成立，不能声明 Coding Agent 阶段前进； - 新测试、错误码、Schema、validator、版本、文档、运行编号或 checkpoint 只能支持能力交付，不能替代 `Issue → Files → Patch → Build/Test → Repair → Revalidation` 的阶段前进； - 若没有跨过新的产品阶段，必须写 `capability_advanced: false`，说明本轮只改善了基础、可见性或诊断； - 连续两个工作包没有跨过产品阶段时，停止继续细化同一局部合同，重新检查真实任务、输入表示、工具面、Agent/Workflow 分工和组合方式； - 工作包不能用“纵向链”“闭环”“健壮性”作为无验收条件的抽象目标，必须绑定真实 Issue、成功命令、当前工作区身份和最终物理结果。 官方依据： - [OpenAI 模型指导：目标、上下文、约束、证据、成功标准与自主性边界](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/latest-model) - [OpenAI Developers：把 issue 变成可工作的修改，运行检查并审查结果](https://developers.openai.com/) ## 2. 统一术语 | 名称 | 当前唯一含义 | 不拥有的权力 | | --- | --- | --- | | 智能面 | 模型理解需求、选择调查方向、解释 observation、决定下一步语义动作 | 来源身份、权限、持久化真相和最终执行权 | | 控制面 | 权限、预算、副作用、恢复、Artifact commit 和执行边界 | 搜索方向和工程事实解释 | | Workflow | 可靠执行外壳、条件路由、interrupt/resume 和阶段恢复 | 预先决定 Hook、修改方案或失败后的工程方向 | | RAG | 找到与请求相关的文档、源码和结构 | 把相关性自动升级为当前工程事实 | | ER | 将相关信息绑定为当前版本、当前来源的工程事实 | Patch、Build 或 Runtime 权限 | | RAG-1A | 证明内部证据发现、验证、关系和充分性能力成立 | 公共入口采用 | | RAG-1B | 让公共产品入口采用同一 RAG-1A executor 和结果 | 重新优化检索或另建语义所有者 | | Coding Agent v0 | `Evidence → Patch → Build/Test → 一次修复` 的产品里程碑 | 开放式无限自治和通用多 Agent 平台 | | v0 internal alpha | 使用内部调用面消费真实 EvidencePack 的首个集成证明 | 公共 API 稳定性和生产质量声明 | | 领域 Harness | 控制 GTFO、插件、进程、日志、截图和恢复 | 通用 Agent 工程语义 | | Agent Harness | 运行完整 Agent 任务并保存输入、动作、观察和结果 | Golden 真相和产品审批 | | Eval Harness | 回放数据集并比较 actual 与 expected | 修改 actual 或授予副作用权限 | | Trace | 记录发生了什么及其关联 | 决定证据真假、充分性或权限 | | 本地小助手 | 本地模型 provider 和模型身份 | 独立产品 Agent 或长期记忆 | | Skill/Playbook | 可复用过程知识 | 当前产品事实、运行状态或工具权限 | | Memory | Agent 在步骤内或跨任务可读取的状态 | Artifact 历史的自动可信化 | ## 3. Observation 的精确定义 Observation 是 Agent 执行动作后，从工具、文件、索引、编译器、测试、Runtime 或用户确认中返回的、可定位到发生时环境的结果。 它至少回答： - 执行了什么动作； - 观察到什么结果； - 来源、版本、路径或 Artifact 身份是什么； - 动作成功、失败还是只得到部分结果； - 哪些事实是直接观察，哪些仍是推断或未知。 本项目中的 observation 包括： - `rg`、BM25、symbol 或 live-read 返回的源码片段和位置； - metadata 返回的程序集 SHA、MVID、类型、方法和 token； - IL inspector 返回的当前方法体； - ArtifactStore commit/read 的结果； - Dry-run diff； - Build/Test 的 exit code、诊断和输出 Artifact； - GTFO Harness 的进程、日志、标记、截图和恢复结果； - 明确绑定运行身份的人工观察。 模型生成的解释本身不是 observation；它是对 observation 的推断。Workflow 节点完成也不等于工程事实充分。 “Agent 行为成立”的最小证明是：新的 observation 会改变下一步调查或修改动作。固定执行 `search → patch → build` 但不根据结果调整，只是 Workflow。 ### 3.1 结果导向的完整工作包原则 本节是指导性推进原则，不新增 Gate、Artifact、审批状态或 Workflow 节点。“完整工作包”是本项目用于落实结果导向协作的管理抽象，不是 OpenAI 官方术语，也不要求单轮完成整个产品里程碑。 | 内容 | 来源与当前解释 | | --- | --- | | 目标导向、范围明确、结果可验证 | OpenAI 官方明确建议提供目标、相关上下文、硬约束、所需证据、成功标准和输出要求 | | 修改后运行检查、审查结果 | OpenAI 官方明确建议 change/build/fix 请求完成范围内修改并执行相关非破坏性验证；Codex 产品说明强调形成可工作的修改、继续迭代、运行检查并审查 diff | | 不在每个安全步骤停顿 | OpenAI 官方明确建议给出自主性与批准边界，使安全、范围内工作可以持续推进，在外部写入、破坏性、昂贵或实质扩张范围前停止 | | “完整工作包”这个名称 | 本项目管理抽象，用于防止局部协议修改替代能力交付 | | 每个工作包具体多大 | 由真实依赖、风险、运行成本和验证成本决定；复杂目标允许拆成多个 checkpoint | 官方依据： - [OpenAI 模型与自主性指导](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/latest-model) - [OpenAI Codex 工作方式](https://developers.openai.com/) 本项目中的完整工作包至少包含： ```text 一个明确能力目标 → 必需的范围内修改 → 一次真实运行或真实消费者调用 → 与改动风险相称的验证 → 可复现的结果和 diff → 成功进入下一能力阶段，或准确停在第一物理失败层 ``` 工作包不以修改文件数、测试数量、Schema 字段、错误码或文档页数作为完成标准。它也不要求一次完成整条 `Evidence → Patch → Build/Test → Runtime`；例如“证据不足时 ImplementationPlanner 正确阻止 Patch”和“可信 EvidencePack 进入 Build/Test”可以是两个独立工作包。拆分后的每一包仍必须产生可观察价值，不能只有未来才会被消费的结构。 每个 change/build/fix 工作包应在开始时明确： ```yaml goal: context: in_scope: hard_constraints: authorization_boundary: success_criteria: real_run_or_consumer: validation: stop_condition: ``` 安全、非破坏且范围内的读取、编辑、定向测试和运行事实收集默认连续完成；外部写入、破坏性操作、昂贵操作、权限扩大或实质扩张范围仍需明确授权。 ### 3.2 最小失败处理闭环 当前已证明的负向链只覆盖失败处理体系中的一个分支： ```text 证据不足 → ImplementationPlanner 读取 committed EvidencePack → proposed_changes=[] → patch_allowed=false → 返回具体证据缺口 ``` 它证明“不该继续时能够安全停止”，但尚未证明“本来应该继续却失败时，Agent 能根据失败 observation 改变动作”。v0 internal alpha 应沿正向消费者链同步补齐最小失败闭环，不先建设独立失败平台、完整 Trace 平台或新的控制面。 #### 3.2.1 失败类型与有界处理 | 第一物理失败 | 最小处理 | 不应采取的处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | 结构化输出不合法 | 保存原始输出；使用同一 Schema 和一致策略纠正一次；仍失败则返回明确结构化错误 | 为单一模型错误增加持久版本或模型专属分支 | | 工具输入可确定性修复 | 从当前 Registry、observation 或运行内 handle 恢复精确参数后重试一次 | 让模型重抄路径、hash、MVID、token 或长引用 | | 来源或身份已变化 | 重新观察并重新绑定当前身份；无法验证时停止 | 使用旧身份继续执行 | | 暂时性工具执行错误 | 在明确重试预算内重试；保存两次物理结果 | 无限重试或把工具故障解释成证据不足 | | 合法零结果或部分结果 | 作为 observation 返回智能面，由模型换调查方向或停止 | Workflow 固定跳到下一工具或伪造成功 | | 环境、权限或依赖缺失 | 返回明确阻断和恢复条件 | 修改 Prompt 规避环境事实 | | 证据不足 | 安全拒绝 Patch，并给出最小调查或 Runtime Probe | 强行继续或修改 Golden 适配 actual | | Patch/Apply 被拒绝 | 保存范围、权限或事实缺口，回到对应 owner | 放宽来源、权限或副作用完整性 | | Build/Test 失败 | 保存 exit code、诊断和输出；让 Agent 基于该 observation 形成一次不同的受限修复；再次验证 | 机械重复同一 Patch 或把测试失败直接标为完成 | | Runtime 失败 | 由领域 Harness patch_scope_or_authority_failure build_compilation_failure test_behavior_failure runtime_failure environment_or_permission_failure timeout_or_budget_failure ``` 审查 里程碑：端到端真实任务 + actual/expected 隔离 Eval ``` 失败分类、错误码和测试本身不算能力前进。每个工作包仍应推动真实运行进入下一阶段，或证明安全拒绝本身就是所需产品结果。 当前优先建设失败处理的准确含义是：把格式、工具、Build/Test repair 和失败归因嵌入正在推进的正向 v0 链；不是暂停可信正向 EvidencePack 和 diff、测试命令和工作包开始/结束时间。若历史工作包缺少可比时间字段，应明确标为不可比较，不补造时间。 验证对象分两层： 1. **受控重现层**：各选择一个可复现的结构化输出失败、工具失败和 Build/Test 失败，核对新闭环能否准确给出第一失败层、负责模块、允许的有界恢复和最终结果； 2. **真实工程层**：连续记录最小失败闭环完成后的三个真实工作包，与此前三个最接近的工作包做方向性对照，不挑选最好结果，不将不同难度任务解释成严格因果实验。 至少记录以下可复算指标： | 指标 | 定义 | 期望方向 | | --- | --- | --- | | `time_to_first_failure_attribution` | 运行开始到第一失败层和负责模块被确定的时间 | 降低 | | `targeted_test_wall_time` | 定向定位与验证所用测试墙钟时间 | 降低或保持 | | `checkpoint_regression_wall_time` | checkpoint 完整相关回归时间 | 可以保持；不得通过少跑必要回归伪造加速 | | `tool_calls`、`model_calls`、`tokens`、`elapsed` | engineering_acceleration_verdict: accelerated: 关键周期缩短，跨层误修或重跑减少，质量与完整性不退化 mixed: 部分指标改善，但成本转移、任务难度或样本不足使结论不稳定 not_accelerated: 没有缩短关键周期，或引入额外恢复复杂度 inconclusive: 缺少可比基线、运行中断或样本不足 ``` `ENTRY-001` 证明唯一公共产品入口委托同一 Runner、现有单一 StateGraph、 ArtifactStore 与既有 Evidence/Plan/Patch/Review/Apply/Build/Repair owner； - `OPS-001` 证明既有运行事实可以投影为可查询 lifecycle、heartbeat、stage/run deadlines、当前 owner、剩余预算和 terminal receipt； - `TOOL-001` 证明 fresh execution context 可以从批准的 tool manifest 解析并 验证 exact tool artifact，而不是猜路径或要求每个 checkout 包含 untracked bin； - `REPORT-001` 证明 reporting failure 不会隐藏已提交的业务 Artifact； - `REC-001` 证明最小 cancellation、checkpoint resume 与显式 fallback policy 存在且不会静默切换 model/tool。 每项必须满足 `docs/audits/ENGINEERING_ISSUE_REGISTER.md` 中的 `minimum_acceptance`，并且 register status 为 `closed`，或由 Operational Readiness checkpoint 明确记录 `mitigated_with_verified_boundary` 及其验证证据， 才可请求 Public Alpha 授权。Internal diagnostic functions 和兼容 CLI 不要求 删除；它们必须委托唯一 Runner，或明确标记为 non-product baseline/diagnostic， 且不拥有独立 Store、route 或 final-result authority。 这个 gate 不是 WallCrawler/RAG-1A 前置，也不是完整 Trace/Eval engineering area、Kubernetes、OTel、Langfuse、模型网关或分布式恢复项目。本次只登记完成 门，不授权实现 Operational Readiness。 ### 8.6 Internal alpha 之后的连续开发顺序 Internal alpha 没有把成熟 Coding Agent 所需能力从产品目标中删除。它只固定第一条不可替代的纵向证明，使后续能力拥有真实 Runner、工具观察、Artifact 和 Eval 数据作为输入，而不是在没有消费者时预建通用平台。 后续开发按依赖关系推进： | 顺序 | 阶段 | 必须交付的能力 | 暂不在该阶段扩张 | | ---: | --- | --- | --- | | 1 | v0 internal alpha | 独立 actual-only 真实请求形成可信 EvidencePack；产生受限 Patch；隔离 Build/Test；一次真实失败 observation 改变下一动作并完成一次修复 | 用 BHF expected truth 补足实现依据、公共 API 稳定、多 Agent、长期 Memory、完整 Trace 平台 | | 2 | RAG-1A 收口 | BHF 方向 actual、WallCrawler 负向 actual、Hidden-Golden、最小关系 Eval 和失败归因 | 把 BHF `sufficient/continue` 当作方向通过条件、Dense/RRF/rerank 默认化、完整评测平台 | | 3 | RAG-1B 与 v0 public alpha | 一个公共入口、一个 Agent Runner、一个 Evidence executor；旧入口明确委托或退出 | 重新优化 RAG/ER、第二 Graph、第二结果语义 | | 4 | Runtime 闭环 | Build 产物进入 GTFO Domain Harness；部署、进程、日志、标记、截图和恢复形成当前运行 observation | 用 Runtime Harness 决定通用 Agent 工程语义 | | 5 | 端到端 Trace 与回归 Eval | 关联 request、工具动作、observation、Artifact、Plan、Patch、Build/Runtime、repair 和 final result；先用 3–5 个真实任务验证关联和失败分类 | 先建 Dashboard、OpenTelemetry 或全局 span 平台 | | 6 | 任务与模型评价扩张 | 扩到 10 个真实任务，再形成 30–50 条标准化任务；固定硬件、Prompt/config、模型/量化/index 身份，比较质量、正确拒答、延迟、吞吐和内存 | 用单一 BHF、单次运行或社交媒体热度决定默认模型 | | 7 | 工具面与工程泛化 | 根据真实任务增加仓库/语言/Build adapter；让模型在有界工具 Registry 中选择调查、编辑、测试和 Runtime 动作；MCP 只暴露同一 Runner 的工具和状态 | 一次性设计所有工具、让 MCP 成为第二产品 Agent | | 8 | Skills 与运行内 Memory | Skills 提供过程知识；运行内 Memory 保存当前请求、已读文件、工具 observation、修改尝试和未解决问题 | 将 Skill 文本、Artifact 历史或 Golden 自动视为当前事实 | | 9 | 长期 Memory | 只有多任务数据证明重复搜索、重复错误或项目约定反复丢失时，才保存可失效、可追溯、可删除的跨任务状态 | 提前保存 Hook 答案、旧输出、临时协议结论或未经验证的推断 | | 10 | 子智能体、并发与长期自治 | 单 Agent 闭环和 Eval 稳定后，再实现任务分解、owner、结果合并、预算、并发隔离、恢复和停止条件 | 用多 Agent 数量替代单 Agent 的 observation-driven 能力 | | 11 | 生产成熟化 | 权限、沙箱、恢复、并发、保留策略、服务化、监控和运维基于前述真实运行数据加固 | 因“未来可能需要”恢复大型控制面先行路线 | 该顺序表示默认依赖，不要求把每项能力建设成独立平台。若真实消费者证明某一后续能力必须提前，允许形成有界工作包，但必须绑定具体运行失败、现有消费者和可验证完成门。 现有文档覆盖关系如下： - `docs/ENGINEERING_RAG_EVIDENCE_INTELLIGENCE_TARGET_DRAFT.md` 负责 RAG-1A、RAG-1B、最小 Eval、Trace/Eval 边界及能力优先原则； - `docs/LOCAL_MODEL_COMPARATIVE_EVALUATION_EXPERIMENT.md` 负责 30–50 条标准化 Prompt、模型身份、量化、质量、延迟、吞吐和内存的正式评价协议； - `DEV_SPEC.md` 负责 Planning、Patch、Review、Apply、Build、Runtime、repair、权限和恢复的父产品边界； - `EVIDENCE_RAG_MCP_SPEC.md` 的 0–3 节负责当前 RAG/MCP 子系统规则，后续导入蓝图只作参考； - 本文负责把这些能力放入同一 Coding Agent 产品的当前开发顺序。 当前没有一份已批准的独立文档完整拥有长期 Memory、Skills、子智能体、并发和长期自治的实施合同。本节只登记它们的进入条件和顺序；只有前序真实数据成立并选择对应工作时，才编写有界专项设计，不从历史蓝图直接恢复通用框架。 ### 8.7 时间盒与不可降级核心 时间盒限制单轮投入和修改范围，不降低阶段完成门。时间盒结束而真实门未满足时，状态必须是 `incomplete`，不得把剩余 Agent 行为移动到后续阶段后再宣称当前阶段完成。 v0 internal alpha 至少必须证明一次： ```text 真实自然语言请求 → 当前环境 observation → 可信 EvidencePack → 受限 Implementation Plan 和 Patch → 隔离 Build/Test → 真实失败 observation 改变后续语义动作 → 与第一次不同的受限修复 → 再次验证 ``` 以下结果不能单独替代该证明： - 只形成 EvidencePack 或 Planning block； - 只跑固定 Workflow 节点； - 单元测试证明某条分支存在，但没有真实纵向运行； - Build/Test 失败后机械重复同一动作； - 新增 Schema、validator、错误码、测试数量、Trace 字段或文档； - 用 BHF 单例成功声明通用 Coding Agent、模型优劣或生产成熟度。 后续能力同样不得因时间盒被删除。若它们尚未达到各自完成门，应保留为明确的后续产品能力，不得用 `deferred` 表述成永久非目标。 ### 8.8 Coding Agent 核心定义与 internal alpha 范围 Coding Agent v0 的产品定义不是“调用若干工具并产生 EvidencePack”，而是接收一个真实 issue，在当前受控工作区中定位并阅读相关代码，形成受限修改，运行客观 Build/Test，并根据真实失败 observation 改变下一步，直到支持范围内的任务通过或达到明确停止条件： ```text Issue / 自然语言请求 → 定位当前仓库、相关文件、符号和引用 → 阅读真实代码与已有测试 → 使用 RAG/ER 补充当前工程事实 → 形成受限 Implementation Plan 和 PatchProposal → Review / Dry-run → 沙箱内 Apply → 隔离 Build/Test → 读取失败 observation → 形成与首次不同的受限修复 → 再次 Build/Test → 通过或明确停止 ``` 文件、符号和修改位置必须来自当前工作区观察、工具结果和已提交 EvidencePack，不得由 Golden、annotation、历史 Patch、预填 Hook 或手工指定最终答案注入。RAG/ER 是这条产品链中的工程证据工具，不是上位产品本身。 #### 8.8.1 Agent 与 Workflow 的最小证明 Workflow、Graph 和控制层可以固定工具准入、权限、预算、沙箱、副作用、持久化、恢复和验证命令；它们不得预先决定需要读取哪个业务文件、选择哪个工程方法、产生何种修改或在 Build/Test 失败后采用哪个修复方向。 internal alpha 必须保存至少一组可比较的动作事实，证明新的 observation 改变了后续语义动作： ```text first_action + build_or_test_observation → second_action ``` 仅按固定节点执行 `Search → Patch → Build → End`、只改变内部 identity、或者由 Workflow 写死修复内容，均不能证明 Agent 行为成立。 #### 8.8.2 客观完成事实 internal alpha 的完成判断优先使用确定性工程结果，不由模型自评。现有运行报告、Artifact 和 Trace 事实至少应能够表达： ```yaml issue_ref: workspace_and_revision: files_and_symbols_read: patch_ref: modified_files: build_exit_code: tests_passed: scope_violations: first_failure_stage: failure_observation_refs: repair_changed_action: revalidation_result: final_result: ``` 这些是运行事实要求，不授权新增 Trace 平台、Artifact 类型或第二结果 owner。能够从现有 Artifact、Build/Test 输出和运行报告重建的字段不得重复持久化。 证据不足时正确阻止 Patch 是必要的负向能力，但不能替代正向完成门。internal alpha 至少需要一条受支持任务最终 Build/Test 通过，并需要一次真实失败 observation 导致不同修复且完成再次验证。如果首条任务首次即通过，不得人为破坏它制造失败；应使用另一条真实、可复现的失败任务验证 Repair。 #### 8.8.3 最小 Eval 与成熟 Eval 的边界 internal alpha 从第一条纵向运行开始记录最小评测事实，但不以完整 Eval 平台为前置： | 范围 | internal alpha 要求 | 后续成熟化 | | --- | --- | --- | | 最终结果 | Build/Test 是否通过、是否越界修改、最终结果 | 多任务成功率与回归质量门 | | 轨迹事实 | 文件读取、工具序列、失败位置、修复是否改变 | 轨迹部分分、合理替代路径和系统化错误分析 | | 单步调试 | 首次文件定位、工具选择和 Repair 方向 | 标准化单步数据集和 held-out 评测 | | 稳定性 | 保存可重复运行所需身份 | 同任务重复运行和波动区间 | | 成本 | 记录模型调用、工具调用、Token 和 elapsed | 每成功任务成本、p50/p95 和容量规划 | 30–50 条标准化任务、SWE-bench 子集、正式模型排名、重复运行统计、完整轨迹评分、Dashboard 和 CI 质量门均不阻塞 internal alpha；它们在首条正向闭环和 3–5 条真实任务后进入。 #### 8.8.4 工程贡献与模型贡献分离 internal alpha 不根据单次 Qwen、Phi 或其他模型运行决定模型优劣。每条运行应固定并记录： ```yaml model_digest_and_quantization: prompt_identity: agent_harness_revision: tool_surface: workspace_and_source_identity: sandbox_and_permission_profile: temperature_seed_and_budgets: build_test_environment: ``` 这些身份用于后续在相同 Harness、任务和硬件下分离模型差异与工程脚手架差异。正式模型选择仍由标准化任务、重复运行、质量、吞吐、延迟、内存和成本数据决定；单次 BHF 或单一步骤结果只用于失败定位。 ## 9. 完成门 ### 9.1 v0 internal alpha ```yaml request_and_workspace: natural_language_issue: true actual_product_goal_bound: true objective_success_command_bound: true current_workspace_revision_bound: true relevant_files_located_from_observation: true relevant_symbols_and_references_read: true no_prefilled_target_or_patch_answer: true evidence: committed_actual_only_task_pack: true strict_rehydrate: true bhf_direction_calibration_is_not_patch_authority: true planning: consumes_committed_pack: true patch: bounded_proposal_and_dry_run: true sandboxed_apply: true scope_violations: 0 build_test: isolated_execution: true one_supported_task_passed: true agent_behavior: observation_changes_next_action: true one_repair_attempt_verified: true repair_revalidation_passed: true trace_eval: run_local_fact_chain_recorded: true product_stage_progress_recorded: true objective_result_recorded: true model_prompt_harness_tool_source_identity_recorded: true no_full_platform_required: true ``` ### 9.2 RAG-1A - BHF 方向 actual 已提交并按 Case 评分投影完成 expected-truth 隔离比较； - WallCrawler 负向 actual 已提交并识别关键行为缺失； - actual 冻结前不读取 annotation、历史实现或旧输出； - 失败可以归因到 retrieval、selection、metadata、IL、reasoning 或 planning； - 没有 BHF/WC 固定答案进入通用 discovery。 ### 9.3 v0 public alpha - 一个公共入口； - 一个 Agent Runner； - 一个 Evidence executor； - Workflow 不拥有工程语义； - Domain Harness 不污染通用 Runner； - Build/Test observation 可以改变下一动作； - 重复入口有明确委托或退出状态。 ## 10. 时间盒 从 2026-08-17 当前同步点开始，在本地模型和 Build 环境持续可用的前提下，剩余目标为 5–7 个集中工程日： | 天数 | 交付 | | --- | --- | | 1 | 修复现有 Repair Patch owner，完成第二次 Apply/Build/Test 或保存新的第一物理失败 | | 2 | 受控 actual-only 任务 checkpoint；使用现有仓库真实小型 Issue 复核定位、Patch 和 Build/Test | | 3 | 最小失败闭环工程加速验证；同步当前产品状态与运行事实 | | 4 | BHF 方向 Hidden-Golden、WallCrawler 负向 actual 和最小关系 Eval，关闭 RAG-1A | | 5 | RAG-1B 公共采用、重复入口收缩和 v0 public alpha | | 6–7 | 全链回归、3–5 个真实任务最小 Eval、文档和 checkpoint 收口 | 该时间盒不是完成承诺。若真实来源、模型或 Build 环境阻断，应返回第一物理失败，不以新增合同或测试数量伪装进度。 ## 11. 附录：Markdown 文档审计归类 本轮共检查 44 个 Markdown 文件，按职责归类如下。 ### 11.1 当前权威与状态链 - `AGENTS.md` - `docs/ACTIVE_PRODUCT_CONTRACT.md` - `docs/PROJECT_STATE.md` - `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_QUEUE.md` - `docs/SPEC_COVERAGE_MATRIX.md` - `docs/ARCHITECTURE_OVERVIEW.md` - `DEV_SPEC.md` - `EVIDENCE_RAG_MCP_SPEC.md` `DEV_SPEC.md` 和 `EVIDENCE_RAG_MCP_SPEC.md` 含大量历史阶段与导入材料，只能按 `AGENTS.md` 的读取顺序读取当前相关段落，不能整体解释为当前队列。 ### 11.2 当前能力目标与实验文档 - `docs/ENGINEERING_RAG_EVIDENCE_INTELLIGENCE_TARGET_DRAFT.md` - `docs/CODING_AGENT_V0_INTERNAL_ALPHA.md` - `docs/RETRIEVAL_ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md` - `docs/RETRIEVAL_VALIDATION_PLAN.md` - `docs/LOCAL_MODEL_COMPARATIVE_EVALUATION_EXPERIMENT.md` - `evaluation/directional/v2_ret_directional_001_decision.md` 本地模型实验文档当前未跟踪，正式模型排名尚未开始；两模型局部诊断不能升级为默认模型结论。 ### 11.3 历史、审计与控制设计 - `docs/CONTROL_PLANE_CONSOLIDATION_DESIGN.md` - `docs/audits/AGENT_HARNESS_TRANSITION.md` - `docs/audits/LOOP_HISTORY.md` - `docs/audits/V2_MAINLINE_TRANSITION.md` - `docs/GIT_WORKFLOW.md` 这些文件提供历史事实、设计或流程，不自动创建当前工作。 ### 11.4 Calibration derived presentation - `docs/calibration/two_slice_data_readiness/better_hit_feedback/leakage_audit.md` - `docs/calibration/two_slice_data_readiness/better_hit_feedback/source_coverage.md` - `docs/calibration/two_slice_data_readiness/wall_crawler/leakage_audit.md` - `docs/calibration/two_slice_data_readiness/wall_crawler/source_coverage.md` - `docs/calibration/two_slice_data_readiness/reproducibility_report.md` 这些文件明确是非权威派生展示。Golden expected 与 actual 运行继续隔离。 ### 11.5 Skills 与参考材料 - `.agents/skills/hook-discovery-playbook/SKILL.md` - `.agents/skills/mod-delivery-playbook/SKILL.md` - `.agents/skills/mod-planning-brief-playbook/SKILL.md` - `.agents/skills/runtime-diagnosis-playbook/SKILL.md` - `.agents/skills/qa-tester/SKILL.md` 及 reference - `.agents/skills/resume-writer/SKILL.md` 及 reference - `.agents/skills/skill-creator/SKILL.md` 及 reference - `.agents/skills/auto-coder/references/01-overview.md` 至 `07-future.md` `auto-coder/SKILL.md` 已冻结为 `SKILL.md.frozen`。Skills 只提供过程知识，不进入 runtime prompt、产品状态、EvidencePack 或工具权限。 ### 11.6 其他说明 - `README.md` - `tests/fixtures/sample_documents/README.md` README 是用户入口说明；fixture README 只描述测试数据。两者不拥有当前产品完成状态。 ## 12. 禁止声明 在完成对应真实门之前，不得声明： - `rag_capability_mainline` 已包含所有工作树代码； - RAG-1A、RAG-1B 或 Coding Agent v0 已完成； - BHF 已自动发现正确 Hook； - 两模型诊断已经完成模型选型； - workflow trace 等于端到端 Agent Trace； - Domain Harness 等于 Agent Harness； - 当前大量测试通过等于真实纵向产品闭环成立。

documents.title: 真实交付与评测共同推进
documents.text: # 真实交付与评测共同推进 更新于2026-09-29。目标是理解自然语言，完成新 Mod 创建、生成中的迭代修复、已有问题 Mod／代码库修改，并用同一次真实执行检验平台能力。七类待测继续保留在[成果与证据清单](PROJECT_OUTCOMES.md)；任务选择见[实施队列](IMPLEMENTATION_QUEUE.md)，指标定义见[评测协议](EVALUATION_DRIVEN_DEVELOPMENT.md)。 ## 每个交付周期 | 动作 | 同时得到的结果 | 为什么要有它 | | --- | --- | --- | | 选择真实需求，明确预期行为、保留行为、目标工程和适用验收 | 一项可交付修改及可执行的成败判定；验收要求能由公开需求、接口合同或允许读取的材料推出 | 为什么要有它：选题对应维护成本、回归风险或交付障碍，避免为凑指标挑题或让模型猜隐藏偏好。 | | 沿正常入口调查、实现、验收和交付，复用现有工具与裁判 | 工程、补丁、适用Build/运行结果；已有Trace同时记录模型/工具和执行事实 | 为什么要有它：真实构建和行为检查就是这次交付的评测，不必为了记录再生成一次答案或另建runner。 | | 从原件汇总成败、实际成本、介入和边界；判断失败或退化反映什么 | 原运行引用、直接原因及采用/修复/回退/证据不足的决定 | 为什么要有它：数据需要改变下一步；缺失成本标未知，不能为了补统计字段阻塞已满足验收的合法交付。 | | 将有复用价值的失败变成回归，必要时做针对性对照，再回到真实任务 | 平台短板的修复、受影响验收与邻近任务验证 | 为什么要有它：回归防止重犯，任务结果检查修复有没有实际作用；只停在局部测试不算交付改善。 | ```mermaid flowchart LR A[真实需求与验收] --> B[正常入口开发与交付] B --> C[同次运行的成败 成本 边界] C --> D[结果判读与下一步决定] D -->|存在具体短板| E[反例或定向对照] E --> F[修复与受影响验证] F --> B D -->|已有交付或暂不采用| G[下一真实任务] G --> A C --> H[回归样本与候选版本留出验证] H --> D ``` ## 三种评测按用途嵌入 | 用途 | 何时做、复用什么 | 为什么要有它 | | --- | --- | --- | | 每次交付的验收与观察 | 正常 `run-request` 的验收、manifest/result、批准和执行回执；`measure_product_task.py` 汇总已记录的段，`product_trace.py` 查原始过程 | 为什么要有它：日常即积累可复查数据；所选段用量不自动升级为完整任务成本，人工工时等缺项仅在需要时补录。 | | 解释具体短板的实验 | 结果会影响修复选择或投入时，固定同一失败候选/反馈或同一任务做最小对照；复用 `run_patch_sft_eval.py`、`probe_retained_requests.py` 和公共批次runner | 为什么要有它：分清模型、上下文、规格、环境和裁判问题；无新假设、输入或配置变化时收口原试验，不靠重复跑分维持进展。 | | 检验采用与泛化 | 候选策略准备采用、或需要独立成果声明时，用预先选定的新任务和重复运行；复用 `run_product_trial_batch.py` 与已有独立任务发布/裁判 | 为什么要有它：旧任务负责开发和回归，新任务检验迁移；同题重复不能增加独立任务数。 | 比较问题决定基线：版本回归用已冻结版本；架构取舍增加合理的“读源码→修改→测试→修订”简化循环，并保留相同源码、权限、隔离、验收和授权边界；修订机制比较固定同一失败候选与反馈。现有给定Plan的Patch/Repair可先作阶段对照，完整自然语言简化基线仍需接线验证。为什么要有它：修复旧接线故障、改进修订能力和证明复杂架构净收益，是不同结论。 ## Astra的开发职责与投入取舍 Astra负责调查、实现、判读和维护平台；产品运行继续按选定本地模型评测。Astra或开发者补解法、改候选代码的交付另记辅助完成；正常模型运行的结果保持原样。为什么要有它：开发助手的能力不能被记成被测产品模型的成功率。 主线程推进当前交付，独立调查、裁判核对、邻近回归或留出制备可并行；代码修改按实际所有者划分。共享本地模型/GPU和有状态执行按资源隔离安排，不为用满并行度制造竞争。为什么要有它：Ultra的并行应缩短交付等待，避免多份审计和相互影响的测量。 七类证据都保留完成责任，但每轮选择能推进当前交付或明确成果缺口的测量；训练、检索优化和追踪等专题有具体问题及退出结论时推进。当前不设固定投入比例，也不把某一道题成功设为所有后续工作的前置条件。为什么要有它：兼顾交付与完整证据目标，避免七线平铺或永久搁置待测。 ## 官方依据与项目应用 2026-09-29已查阅当前官方页面： - [Astra行为与开发建议](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/latest-model#prompting-best-practices)：强调自主推进、核查技能/文件中的冲突指令、有意义的并行，以及按改动范围验证。本项目沿用当前8条AGENTS约定，纠正活动文档中的冲突，不追加整套相同规则。 - [Codex实践](https://learn.chatgpt.com/guides/best-practices)：任务应有目标、上下文、约束和完成条件，常驻指导保持简短、具体。这里用现有任务记录表达，不要求每次另填实验表。 - [评测实践](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/evaluation-best-practices)：从实际使用和失败收集用例，按任务设计评测、持续比较并校准评分；架构复杂度由评测需要推动。本项目优先复用现有本地设施。 - [Ultra说明](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/models#know-when-to-use-max-or-ultra)：Ultra通过子agent处理可拆分工作。此处用于并行工程工作，不推导被测本地模型会自动获得同样能力。 以上工作安排是结合仓库作出的应用判断，不是官方规定的比例、题数或成功率标准。为什么要有它：模型使用建议需要落实到实际项目，不能再变成脱离任务的新门禁。

documents.title: Engineering Issue Register
documents.text: # Engineering Issue Register Status: lightweight observation register Last reviewed: 2026-08-29 ## 1. Purpose And Authority Boundary This register records engineering problems that were physically observed in a real run, deterministic replay, or verified checkpoint. It keeps the problem's owner, evidence, current disposition, and exact reopening condition available without turning old failures into current authority. This file is not: - the Implementation Queue or a source of execution authorization; - an automatic repair, routing, policy, or prioritization rule set; - a replacement for `docs/ACTIVE_PRODUCT_CONTRACT.md`, `docs/PROJECT_STATE.md`, `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_QUEUE.md`, or `docs/audits/LOOP_HISTORY.md`; - the complete Trace/Eval engineering area; - a repository-wide TODO scan or a ten-thousand-line asset reconciliation. The current user request and Active Product Contract always outrank this register. A matching entry can inform a decision only after a current physical failure has independently established the same owner and satisfied the entry's `reopen_trigger`. ## 2. Classification ### 2.1 Severity | Value | Meaning | | --- | --- | | `S0` | Fact fabrication, unauthorized action, or irrecoverable-risk boundary | | `S1` | Blocks the current product completion gate | | `S2` | Quality, stability, or traceability defect | | `S3` | Local cost or maintenance issue | ### 2.2 Decision Priority | Value | Meaning | | --- | --- | | `P0` | Immediately blocks the current work | | `P1` | Must be handled in the current product stage | | `P2` | Observe; handle after physical repetition | | `P3` | Frozen; do not proactively handle | ### 2.3 Status Allowed values are: - `observed` - `active` - `mitigated_for_current_scope` - `explicit_unresolved` - `closed` - `deferred` - `rejected_currently` - `superseded` ### 2.4 Evidence Level | Value | Meaning | | --- | --- | | `real_run` | Direct current-run process, provider, tool, Build, or Artifact evidence | | `real_run_and_comparison` | Real actual plus an independently executed expected-side comparison | | `checkpoint_and_tests` | Current source checkpoint plus focused executable tests | | `mechanical_replay` | Deterministic reconstruction or identity replay without a model call | ### 2.5 Optional Stage-Gate Fields Operational issues may add: - `required_before_stage`: the product stage that cannot be authorized until the issue meets its minimum boundary; - `minimum_acceptance`: a bounded list of observable facts required to close the issue or record a verified mitigation boundary. These fields do not put an issue in the Implementation Queue. An Internal Alpha completion checkpoint reopens every entry whose `required_before_stage` is Coding Agent v0 public alpha, raises its decision priority to `P1`, and creates one bounded Operational Readiness work package. Implementation still requires current user authority. ## 3. Event-Triggered Review Protocol Review this register only after one of these events: - a first physical failure is frozen; - Evidence is committed as `blocked` or `insufficient`; - the same owner/failure signature repeats; - two consecutive bounded runs make no progress; - a proposed fix crosses an owner or layer boundary; - a product-stage checkpoint is formed. The mandatory order is: ```text freeze the current failure and immutable evidence -> locate the current physical owner without using this register -> inspect this register only for that owner/signature -> retain only entries whose reopen_trigger is currently satisfied -> decide reopen, add, defer, reject, or leave closed ``` Do not read old issues first and fit the current observation to them. A reopened entry grants no permission to edit code, change a model, expand a budget, run a tool, or change product scope. Those actions require current authority. ## 4. Registered Issues ### OBS-001 ```yaml issue_id: OBS-001 title: qwen3:4b BHF semantic discovery and source disambiguation are insufficient scope: BHF positive calibration on the bound R8 corpus owner: EvidenceDiscovery Search Planning and action selection for the current local model evidence_level: real_run_and_comparison severity: S1 decision_priority: P3 status: explicit_unresolved first_seen: 2026-08-21 run002 latest_evidence: run004 EvidencePack b554e02190af1117b4b552072eea0404ae4271927b803619db9447c89764e9b1; expected-side acceptable_hook_identity_set_matches=false current_effect: BHF positive direction gate is unresolved for the current model and strategy; RAG-1A positive gate is not passed workaround: preserve the explicit unresolved result and continue only with another selected product slice reopen_trigger: an explicitly authorized model-role evaluation, or an independent task with the same semantic discovery/disambiguation failure next_action: none in the current BHF route last_reviewed: 2026-08-22 ``` Reopen review on 2026-08-24 did not map AccurateCrosshair run `8d26e4e5` to `OBS-001`. The symptom again involved source disambiguation, but the current owner is deterministic `RgLiveEvidenceProvider.collect` Evidence sufficiency, not model-driven EvidenceDiscovery Search Planning/action selection. The new failure signature, `deterministic RgLive Evidence relevance-to-sufficiency promotion failure`, is now recorded as `EVID-001` and mitigated for the current scope by checkpoint `c8004845fe3f01d844e79ab8b6aba0634b6a5c01`. Its run facts remain in `docs/audits/ACCURATE_CROSSHAIR_ACTUAL_OUTCOME_20260824.json`; the owner audit is `docs/audits/RG_LIVE_EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENCY_OWNER_AUDIT_20260824.json`. ### OBS-002 ```yaml issue_id: OBS-002 title: Search Plan investigation coverage was unstable scope: split Requirement Projection and Search Planning subturn owner: EvidenceDiscovery Search Planning structural compliance evidence_level: real_run severity: S2 decision_priority: P2 status: mitigated_for_current_scope first_seen: 2026-08-21 run003 latest_evidence: checkpoint e7b84f14e0c600f41e583f1b9019d8dd64ac2d5b adds one bounded correction; run004 used it and froze a Search Plan current_effect: the observed coverage mismatch no longer blocks the current scope, but another task may expose the same structural failure workaround: one correction only; the original coverage gate remains strict reopen_trigger: a new independent task returns a Search Plan investigation-count mismatch after the bounded correction next_action: record the new run facts before deciding whether the mitigation is insufficient last_reviewed: 2026-08-22 ``` ### RET-001 ```yaml issue_id: RET-001 title: bge-m3 per-text OllamaEmbedding and Chroma fail during full-R8 materialization scope: full-R8 source-only Dense feasibility experiment owner: embedding provider full-corpus stability evidence_level: real_run severity: S2 decision_priority: P3 status: rejected_currently first_seen: 2026-08-21 full-R8 experiment bge_m3_full_r8_ab_20260821_001 latest_evidence: decision_record SHA256 7404f84661f7fdc3051e9047b3c3ab8d83fce4772fa9c2686ad1ad29b2b688e7; failure_record SHA256 e8c69f52ddeb6cf9436520e34c7f9091820082c341a70224b6195d5cece3a860 current_effect: the current Dense path is not eligible for experimental auxiliary adoption workaround: use the existing non-Dense Retrieval Plane; do not treat the synthetic micro-canary as full-corpus proof reopen_trigger: a new product failure explicitly requires Dense reconsideration and the user separately authorizes provider materialization work next_action: none; Retrieval provider exploration is closed last_reviewed: 2026-08-22 ``` ### CTX-001 ```yaml issue_id: CTX-001 title: Ollama service default context was insufficient for a bounded discovery turn scope: local Agent-turn execution with qwen3:4b-instruct owner: run-level Ollama context configuration evidence_level: real_run severity: S2 decision_priority: P3 status: mitigated_for_current_scope first_seen: 2026-08-21 BHF run001 latest_evidence: Wall relation-aware run001 and run003 were rejected before HTTP at explicit num_ctx 16384 and 32768 respectively; final run004 used run-level num_ctx 65536, passed per-call admission through seven model-call attempts, and stopped instead on Provider response timeout rather than context admission current_effect: context admission is not the latest first blocker for the closed Wall route; 65536 is only a bounded run-level observation and does not change product defaults or prove every future request fits workaround: preserve per-call admission and the run-level identities; do not continue Wall context escalation or promote 65536 to a product default reopen_trigger: a new authorized run fails context admission with an explicit, model-supported context setting next_action: none in the current Wall route; reopen only on a new selected product task that fails the existing per-call admission under an explicit model-supported setting last_reviewed: 2026-08-22 ``` ### ART-001 ```yaml issue_id: ART-001 title: Hand-authored future FeatureSpec identity was not reproducible scope: calibration actual authorization packet construction owner: production FeatureSpec and ArtifactStore identity projection evidence_level: mechanical_replay severity: S1 decision_priority: P3 status: mitigated_for_current_scope first_seen: 2026-08-21 BHF preflight latest_evidence: production RequestPlanner and FeatureSpecBuilder produce feature_258e3fb80ea6 with hash 79786316d2c4a8201e5c5659a81ae9906b6cf5fa638edd32c6da3cdee751dded current_effect: future calibration runs use the production owner rather than hand-authored payload fields workaround: none required after production-owner projection reopen_trigger: production projection, materialized ArtifactRef, and approved identity drift for the same immutable input next_action: fail before model execution if identity drift is observed last_reviewed: 2026-08-22 ``` ### EVID-001 ```yaml issue_id: EVID-001 title: RgLive lexical observations were promoted to Patch authority without requirement coverage scope: ProductExecution RgLive lexical-only Evidence sufficiency owner: src/mod_agent/evidence/rg_live.py::RgLiveEvidenceProvider.collect evidence_level: real_run severity: S1 decision_priority: P3 status: mitigated_for_current_scope first_seen: AccurateCrosshair run 8d26e4e5 latest_evidence: checkpoint c8004845fe3f01d844e79ab8b6aba0634b6a5c01 makes lexical-only and source-authentic RgLive observations non-authoritative when explicit requirement coverage is absent current_effect: the observed wrong sufficient-to-Patch-authority transition is closed for the current lexical-only scope; positive requirement coverage remains the independent P1 capability and is not owned by this Issue workaround: none required for the current scope; preserve the deterministic fail-closed boundary reopen_trigger: any lexical or source-authentic observation again produces readiness=sufficient, can_generate_patch=true, or Patch Proposal authority without explicit validated requirement coverage next_action: reopen only on that exact false-sufficiency signature; do not merge P1 positive coverage work into this Issue last_reviewed: 2026-08-25 ``` ### EXEC-001 ```yaml issue_id: EXEC-001 title: Long packet and run roots exceeded the Windows isolated-workspace path budget scope: P2 isolated workspace materialization before ProductExecution owner: packet-bound execution-root path budget evidence_level: real_run severity: S1 decision_priority: P2 status: mitigated_for_current_scope first_seen: actual1 run a63fdb36 latest_evidence: actual1 stopped at workspace_preparation before ProductExecution; its actual_failure SHA256 is 257855d76ce8de66b26915ffc8ef46ef539be91ee5de4b6e4ef82f351a322808 and product run_failure SHA256 is 54f74947912ebee5573cd47d40481062509faeea59c5fa7288fb060075d6eede. Short a6a2-a6a6 roots remained within the sealed path budget and later actuals entered ProductExecution incident_record: docs/audits/CODING_AGENT_V0_RECENT_ISSUE_INTERACTION_AUDIT_20260826.md current_effect: the selected Case no longer fails workspace materialization, but arbitrary long delivery roots are not claimed supported workaround: seal a conservative destination-path budget and use a short packet-bound execution root reopen_trigger: a fresh Windows actual that satisfies the sealed path budget fails workspace materialization because a projected destination path is too long, or a packet is sealed without checking every generated destination class next_action: none in the current scope; reopen only on the exact workspace path-budget signature last_reviewed: 2026-08-26 ``` ### BUILD-001 ```yaml issue_id: BUILD-001 title: Isolated baseline restore could not resolve the target project's GameFolder dependency scope: run-local build dependency identity and MSBuild GameFolder projection owner: src/mod_agent/local_entry.py::RunLocalGameFolderBindingV1 evidence_level: real_run severity: S1 decision_priority: P2 status: mitigated_for_current_scope first_seen: actual2 run d9c35191 latest_evidence: actual2 baseline restore reported `The GameFolder property must be set to the Game folder.`; checkpoint a182db4 added one exact read-only binding and run-local `-p:GameFolder`; actual6 run 905a0a60 then completed isolated baseline restore/build with DLL SHA256 174ce450da330c36bb57ab709880040e1961a3eeefd5bd48c6ab455c12b33e6d incident_record: docs/audits/CODING_AGENT_V0_RECENT_ISSUE_INTERACTION_AUDIT_20260826.md current_effect: the selected AccurateCrosshair baseline build dependency is admitted and buildable; changed-product Build remains not reached workaround: use the exact sealed GameFolder snapshot through the run-local binding; do not modify canonical GameFolder.props reopen_trigger: a new bound target with a verified run-local GameFolder dependency reaches baseline restore/build but the existing binding cannot project the exact property without changing canonical source next_action: none in the current scope; do not generalize to arbitrary MSBuild properties without a real consumer last_reviewed: 2026-08-26 ``` ### FS-001 ```yaml issue_id: FS-001 title: Ordinary Windows directory copy omitted or could not read long GameFolder dependency paths scope: run-local GameFolder dependency copy on Windows owner: src/mod_agent/local_entry.py::_copy_validated_directory_tree evidence_level: real_run severity: S1 decision_priority: P2 status: mitigated_for_current_scope first_seen: actual3 run 65541df6 latest_evidence: actual3 stopped at build_dependency_copy with long-path file reads reported missing; checkpoint 1036f98 added validated extended-length path projection, and actual4 copied the physical 165-file dependency before the later independent snapshot failure incident_record: docs/audits/CODING_AGENT_V0_RECENT_ISSUE_INTERACTION_AUDIT_20260826.md current_effect: copy no longer blocks the selected Windows Case; long-path snapshot identity remained a separate owner under FS-002 workaround: use validated absolute extended-length source and destination paths only inside the bounded directory-copy owner reopen_trigger: a fresh Windows run with an exact bound dependency again fails or omits a regular file during run-local copy because of path-length handling next_action: none in the current scope; preserve the exact copy boundary and reject symlink/reparse expansion last_reviewed: 2026-08-26 ``` ### FS-002 ```yaml issue_id: FS-002 title: GameFolder snapshot traversal omitted Windows long-path files and produced false identity drift scope: run-local binary dependency snapshot and post-copy identity owner: src/mod_agent/local_entry.py::_binary_tree_snapshot evidence_level: real_run severity: S1 decision_priority: P2 status: mitigated_for_current_scope first_seen: actual4 run f3a54f16 latest_evidence: actual4 physically contained 165 source and destination files while the old snapshot observed 137 and rejected copy identity; product run_failure SHA256 is 2100c60a7e7f1580c242d2c533a09b11b5eb11312a73215b1514a77691a66b6f. Checkpoint 2ee3e03 added complete extended-length traversal; actual5 and actual6 admitted the full 165-file snapshot e7bed3c58810a0203f2aa08f58e1dc7d43def39574899d1add6f0fb46326673b incident_record: docs/audits/CODING_AGENT_V0_RECENT_ISSUE_INTERACTION_AUDIT_20260826.md current_effect: the selected dependency source/copy identity now remains equal and no longer blocks baseline Build workaround: use the single complete long-path snapshot owner for binding, copy verification, and path budget inventory reopen_trigger: a fresh Windows run reports source/copy count or hash drift while an independent physical inventory proves regular long-path files were omitted by the snapshot owner next_action: none in the current scope; no second snapshot algorithm last_reviewed: 2026-08-26 ``` ### EVID-002 ```yaml issue_id: EVID-002 title: Requirement projection structured output fails deterministic disposition admission after one correction scope: ProductExecution requirement projection response-schema admission, semantic rejection diagnostics, and bounded correction contract owner: src/mod_agent/evidence/requirement_coverage_provider.py::StructuredModelRequirementCoverageProvider.project evidence_level: real_run severity: S1 decision_priority: P3 status: closed first_seen: actual5 run f6bdb182 latest_evidence: fresh actual p2_ac_20260825_010/actual_10, Product run 940f14d6, passed Entry, baseline Build, Requirement Projection, and reached Findings without REQUIREMENT_COVERAGE_INPUT_DISPOSITION_INVALID. Its actual_result SHA256 is 596ab34dcda6c97431481b6787dd954c539c0ff49bd6c078a1c1ded0ebe82128. Coverage was insufficient and ImplementationPlan blocked; Patch, ProposalReview, Dry-run, approval, Apply, changed-product Build, Repair, Revalidation, and Runtime were not reached incident_record: docs/audits/CODING_AGENT_V0_RECENT_ISSUE_INTERACTION_AUDIT_20260826.md implementation_checkpoint: 22f8fa0f6913e964b556d49c8d3d6a01ead5ae2e implementation_checkpoint_lineage: 984716f09ef18111b781bcc1623bf184881f6e41 followed by diagnostic closure 22f8fa0f6913e964b556d49c8d3d6a01ead5ae2e implementation_checkpoint_status: accepted_for_bounded_code_and_tests close_evidence: actual10 met the original close trigger through a fresh passed preflight and a fresh actual that reached Findings without the prior Projection failure signature current_effect: the old Projection owner is closed. This does not establish actual10 or product success; actual10 stopped at insufficient Coverage and a blocking ImplementationPlan, now owned separately by EVID-003 workaround: preserve the immutable actual5/actual6 outputs and fail-closed EvidencePack; do not add a third correction, switch model, change retrieval, or relax coverage policy reopen_trigger: any selected real task returns a projection object that fails exact response-schema admission or deterministic input-disposition semantics after the single bounded correction close_trigger: the accepted focused checkpoint is followed by a newly sealed preflight that passes, and a separately authorized fresh actual reaches findings without this failure signature next_action: none;
