Public Alpha Advanced Robustness Trigger Catalog This catalog is not part of `Registered Issues`. Its entries are conditional capability directions, not observations that a physical problem has occurred, not claims that a capability exists, and not execution authority. Entries use `capability_key`, never `issue_id`. Grouping by an expected owner family does not authorize a shared implementation owner: activation must relocate the current physical owner, and distinct owners require distinct Issues. ```yaml catalog_key: public_alpha_activation_triggered_advanced_robustness_backlog status: conditional_trigger activation_trigger: Public Alpha readiness/entry activation plus explicit user selection current_queue: false internal_alpha_blocker: false minimum_public_alpha_blocker: false promotion_rule: Only a real risk audit performed at activation time may promote an entry into the minimum Public Alpha blocking boundary; activation first relocates the current physical owner, then creates a new single-owner Issue only when the observed risk requires implementation. ``` The existing `ENTRY-001`, `OPS-001`, `TOOL-001`, `REPORT-001`, and `REC-001` `minimum_acceptance` lists remain the minimum Operational Readiness boundary before Public Alpha. This catalog does not expand, replace, weaken, or complete those hard gates. ### 5.1 Provider And Tool Resilience All retry-capable entries in this family retain one logical retry owner. An adapter reports transport/tool facts; it does not independently replay work or compete with the Runner attempt owner. #### Bounded Exponential Backoff Plus Jitter ```yaml capability_key: provider_tool_bounded_exponential_backoff_jitter expected_owner_family: existing Runner attempt policy and the exact provider or tool transport owner real_activation_signal: repeated explicitly retryable transient failures after Public Alpha activation where immediate bounded retry causes synchronized load or unstable recovery expected_benefit: spreads bounded retry pressure and reduces synchronized transient-failure amplification cost_and_risk: adds latency, timing nondeterminism, retry-budget tuning, and a risk of replaying work outside its valid identity window degradation_boundary: never retries non-idempotent or high-risk side effects automatically; exhausted or ineligible work stops with the original failure and a terminal receipt separate_issue_on_activation: true ``` #### Full Circuit Breaker This is the single catalog entry for both “full Circuit Breaker” and any “complete circuit-breaker platform” wording; they must not become duplicates. ```yaml capability_key: provider_tool_full_circuit_breaker expected_owner_family: existing Runner attempt policy plus the exact failing provider or tool transport owner real_activation_signal: repeated current failures show that bounded attempts continue reaching a known-unhealthy dependency and materially worsen availability or cost expected_benefit: stops calls to a demonstrably unhealthy dependency and exposes an explicit open, half-open, and closed recovery boundary cost_and_risk: requires durable health-window semantics, concurrency control, reset policy, observability, and protection against stale or cross-tenant health state degradation_boundary: an open breaker grants no fallback authority and cannot convert unavailable evidence or execution into success separate_issue_on_activation: true ``` #### Tool Gateway ```yaml capability_key: provider_tool_gateway expected_owner_family: existing tool manifest, resolver, preflight, and tool invocation boundary real_activation_signal: Public Alpha exposes repeated cross-tool policy, identity, isolation, quota, or observability failures that cannot be represented by current tool instances and preflight expected_benefit: centralizes verified tool identity, invocation policy, receipts, quotas, and isolation without giving tools route authority cost_and_risk: creates a critical dependency and possible bottleneck, expands policy surface, and can obscure exact tool ownership if introduced without physical failures degradation_boundary: gateway failure blocks or reduces the operation to an explicitly authorized read-only mode; it never fabricates a tool result or bypasses tool-specific validation separate_issue_on_activation: true ``` #### Model Gateway ```yaml capability_key: provider_model_gateway expected_owner_family: existing model admission, disclosure, provider adapter, and attempt-policy boundary real_activation_signal: Public Alpha shows repeated cross-model admission, capability-profile, quota, disclosure, or receipt failures that cannot be handled by current exact provider adapters expected_benefit: provides one audited model admission and receipt boundary while retaining exact provider and attempt identities cost_and_risk: concentrates routing and disclosure risk, may conceal provider-specific behavior, and can become a second workflow authority degradation_boundary: gateway unavailability or uncertainty blocks model execution or reduces it to an explicitly authorized lower-permission mode; no silent provider or model switch is allowed separate_issue_on_activation: true ``` ### 5.2 Model Quality Resilience #### Prevalidated Fallback Model Routing ```yaml capability_key: model_prevalidated_fallback_routing expected_owner_family: existing Runner attempt policy, model admission, and capability-profile validation owners real_activation_signal: a repeated model-specific failure has a prevalidated alternate capability profile and a current user-selected fallback policy after Public Alpha activation expected_benefit: permits bounded continuation after a classified model failure without erasing the original failure or widening authority cost_and_risk: model outputs are not behaviorally interchangeable; routing can change quality, cost, latency, disclosure, and safety assumptions degradation_boundary: fallback creates a new attempt, preserves the original failure, revalidates identity and disclosure, lowers permissions, and emits an auditable receipt; it never occurs silently separate_issue_on_activation: true ``` #### Business-Quality Monitoring ```yaml capability_key: model_business_quality_monitoring expected_owner_family: existing product Eval and acceptance owners for the selected business capability real_activation_signal: Public Alpha traffic provides outcome-bound quality observations whose deterioration is not visible through transport or schema success expected_benefit: detects product-relevant quality loss separately from provider availability and syntactic validity cost_and_risk: requires reviewed outcome definitions, delayed labels, sampling controls, privacy boundaries, and protection against metric gaming degradation_boundary: monitoring is advisory until a reviewed policy binds it; weak or missing labels cannot block, route, or claim model quality automatically separate_issue_on_activation: true ``` #### Model Drift Alerting ```yaml capability_key: model_drift_alerting expected_owner_family: existing model identity, capability-profile, and product Eval observation owners real_activation_signal: a bound model, provider revision, or observed outcome distribution changes beyond a reviewed threshold after Public Alpha activation expected_benefit: makes model or outcome drift visible before it silently changes product behavior cost_and_risk: drift signals can be noisy, seasonal, data-sensitive, or unrelated to product quality and require version-aware baselines degradation_boundary: an alert does not authorize fallback, prompt changes, threshold changes, or policy learning; uncertain drift remains an investigation signal separate_issue_on_activation: true ``` #### Capability-Profile-Based Model Weighting Or Deprioritization ```yaml capability_key: model_capability_profile_weighting_deprioritization expected_owner_family: existing reviewed capability-profile registry and Runner model-selection policy owner real_activation_signal: multiple prevalidated models are explicitly authorized and real Public Alpha outcomes show stable task-specific capability differences expected_benefit: prefers models whose verified capability profiles fit the current bounded task while deprioritizing repeatedly weak profiles cost_and_risk: weighting can become opaque adaptive routing, overfit sparse observations, or create self-reinforcing traffic bias degradation_boundary: weights cannot grant new permissions, bypass exact model admission, or use an unvalidated profile; ambiguous profiles require explicit selection or manual escalation separate_issue_on_activation: true ``` #### Formal Model Comparative Evaluation ```yaml capability_key: model_formal_comparative_evaluation expected_owner_family: existing product Eval, model identity, expected-isolation, and reviewed selection owners real_activation_signal: stable model interfaces plus a real product bottleneck plus explicit user selection justify a frozen comparative run expected_benefit: distinguishes task-bound model capability, latency, cost, and failure behavior without changing defaults from anecdotes cost_and_risk: requires frozen task, model, runtime, Prompt, schema, source, and expected-isolation identities and can otherwise reward leakage or unstable interfaces degradation_boundary: one old diagnostic, social-media claim, or desire to complete an experiment cannot activate comparison or change the default model; no default change occurs before Level 2 evidence separate_issue_on_activation: true ``` ### 5.3 Capability Degradation `FULL`, `EVIDENCE_DEGRADED`, `PLAN_ONLY`, and `SAFE_STOP` are logical mappings over existing readiness, blocker, coverage, and authority facts. They do not add a schema. Degradation can only preserve or contract authority; unknown source, permission, or side-effect state maps to `SAFE_STOP`. #### Cache-Backed Degradation ```yaml capability_key: degradation_cache_backed expected_owner_family: existing read-model, evidence freshness, and cache identity owners for the affected capability real_activation_signal: Public Alpha availability requirements justify serving a previously verified bounded result when its source, scope, age, and invalidation conditions remain inspectable expected_benefit: preserves limited read availability during a transient dependency failure cost_and_risk: stale data can mislead planning, conceal dependency failure, or cross identity and authorization boundaries degradation_boundary: cached data is labeled stale or cached with source identity and age; it never appears as fresh, current, complete, or sufficient evidence without revalidation separate_issue_on_activation: true ``` #### Partial-Result Degradation ```yaml capability_key: degradation_partial_result expected_owner_family: existing result projection and sufficiency owner for the affected capability real_activation_signal: a real Public Alpha operation can safely expose independently valid completed subsets while other declared subsets fail or remain unavailable expected_benefit: returns inspectable useful work instead of discarding every valid subset cost_and_risk: consumers may treat partial output as complete, combine incompatible subsets, or miss the failed coverage boundary degradation_boundary: every partial result declares missing scope, failed owners, freshness, and non-authority; partial results cannot masquerade as complete Evidence or authorize writes separate_issue_on_activation: true ``` #### Read-Only, Draft, Or Manual-Escalation Degradation ```yaml capability_key: degradation_read_only_draft_manual_escalation expected_owner_family: existing permission, approval, and operation-risk policy owners real_activation_signal: Public Alpha encounters a classified degraded or fallback state where observation or drafting remains useful but normal write authority is not defensible expected_benefit: preserves bounded assistance while preventing uncertain dependencies from performing high-risk actions cost_and_risk: creates more user-visible states, handoff work, and possible confusion between drafts and approved changes degradation_boundary: high-risk writes default to read-only, draft, or manual approval; degraded output never inherits normal Apply, Build, Runtime, or external side-effect authority separate_issue_on_activation: true ``` ### 5.4 Distributed Continuity Distributed resume and distributed recovery share a capability family but are not synonyms. Resume continues unfinished work from a durable checkpoint after current identity and permission validation. Recovery reconstructs auditable execution ownership and a terminal state after host, process, or worker ownership is lost; it is not simple resume. #### Distributed Resume ```yaml capability_key: continuity_distributed_resume expected_owner_family: existing Runner checkpoint continuation and immutable Artifact identity owners real_activation_signal: Public Alpha deployment requires an unfinished authorized run to continue on another admitted worker from a durable checkpoint expected_benefit: continues bounded work without replaying completed stages or losing immutable lineage cost_and_risk: stale checkpoints, identity drift, double execution, split ownership, and cross-worker permission mismatch can corrupt the run degradation_boundary: resume requires durable checkpoint ownership, fresh identity and permission validation, and an idempotent side-effect boundary; otherwise it remains blocked separate_issue_on_activation: true ``` #### Distributed Recovery ```yaml capability_key: continuity_distributed_recovery expected_owner_family: existing Runner lifecycle, lease or ownership, checkpoint, and terminal-receipt owners real_activation_signal: a real Public Alpha host, process, or worker loss leaves execution ownership or terminal state unresolved across machines expected_benefit: reconstructs one auditable current owner and reaches a truthful terminal or resumable state after ownership loss cost_and_risk: duplicate ownership, lost leases, partial side effects, stale observations, and ambiguous terminal state require distributed coordination degradation_boundary: recovery cannot assume that checkpoint continuation is safe; it must reconcile durable ownership and side effects before resume, retry, or terminalization separate_issue_on_activation: true ``` #### Durable Checkpoint Ownership ```yaml capability_key: continuity_durable_checkpoint_ownership expected_owner_family: existing ArtifactStore checkpoint identity and Runner ownership projection real_activation_signal: Public Alpha distributed execution demonstrates that process-local checkpoint ownership cannot establish one current continuation authority expected_benefit: binds each durable checkpoint to one inspectable run, revision, owner or lease, and continuation boundary cost_and_risk: ownership metadata can become stale, create lock contention, or form a second business-truth store if separated from existing durable facts degradation_boundary: an unowned, multiply owned, stale, or identity-mismatched checkpoint cannot authorize resume or recovery separate_issue_on_activation: true ``` #### Idempotent Side-Effect Boundary ```yaml capability_key: continuity_idempotent_side_effect_boundary expected_owner_family: existing operation-specific approval, Apply, Build, Runtime, and external side-effect owners real_activation_signal: Public Alpha continuity or retry scenarios expose a real risk of duplicating an already-started side effect after ownership loss expected_benefit: makes retry, resume, and recovery distinguish completed, absent, and safely replayable side effects cost_and_risk: requires operation-specific idempotency keys, receipts, reconciliation, and compensation boundaries that cannot be generalized without evidence degradation_boundary: unknown or non-idempotent side effects block automatic retry, resume, backoff replay, and recovery; high-risk continuation requires manual approval separate_issue_on_activation: true ``` #### Side-Effect Reconciliation ```yaml capability_key: continuity_side_effect_reconciliation expected_owner_family: existing operation-specific receipt, approval, Apply, Build, Runtime, and external-effect owners real_activation_signal: a real authorized operation loses process or ownership continuity after a side effect may have started and current receipts cannot determine its physical state expected_benefit: classifies the current effect as NOT_APPLIED, APPLIED, PARTIALLY_APPLIED, or UNKNOWN before any continuation decision cost_and_risk: reconciliation is operation-specific and can itself observe stale or incomplete external state; false certainty can duplicate or conceal effects degradation_boundary: retry is eligible only for NOT_APPLIED plus a verified idempotent operation; UNKNOWN and non-idempotent states safe-stop pending manual authority separate_issue_on_activation: true ``` ### 5.5 Safety Invariants And Non-Activation Boundary - Backup-model routing must never occur silently. - Fallback may use only a prevalidated capability profile. It must create a new attempt, preserve the original failure, lower permissions, and produce an auditable receipt. - High-risk writes in fallback or degraded mode default to read-only, draft, or manual approval. - Backoff and jitter must never automatically replay non-idempotent or high-risk side effects. - One logical retry owner decides whether a classified operation is retryable; adapters and gateways never retry independently. - Cache-backed and partial results must never appear as fresh, current, complete, or sufficient Evidence. - Distributed continuity requires durable checkpoint ownership, fresh identity validation, and an idempotent side-effect boundary. This catalog is only the `public_alpha_activation_triggered_advanced_robustness_backlog`. It does not enter the current P1 Queue, does not block Internal Alpha, and does not automatically become a minimum Public Alpha hard gate. Documentation is not implementation: no advanced robustness direction in this catalog is claimed implemented or complete. Semantic/vector Retrieval, Dense, RRF, and reranking are not activated by this catalog. ## 6. Conditional Retrieval Activation Catalog This catalog is conditional and does not use `issue_id`. It does not activate semantic/vector Retrieval, add current Queue work, or grant Evidence authority. `RET-001` remains limited to the observed bge-m3 plus Chroma full-R8 materialization failure; it does not own future semantic retrieval as a whole. ### 6.1 Semantic Retrieval A/B ```yaml capability_key: retrieval_semantic_ab activation_trigger: a selected real task misses mandatory source through exact, symbol, lexical, and live retrieval; independent current-source inspection proves the source exists; the user explicitly selects a bounded A/B required_evidence: - frozen task, source snapshot, query set, baseline Retriever identity, semantic provider identity, and expected-isolated relevance judgment - one independently verified mandatory-source miss attributable to location recall rather than Entry, coverage, provider timeout, or authority failure minimum_acceptance: - compare unique Recall@K against the non-semantic baseline - rehydrate every semantic hit from live source and reject stale identity - measure false-sufficiency behavior and preserve deterministic Patch-authority gates non_activation: - ENTRY failure, requirement-coverage failure, provider timeout, available embedding dependency, repository size alone, or architecture-completeness preference stop_condition: record only the bounded A/B result; do not activate fusion, storage, or default adoption without a separate trigger ``` ### 6.2 Hybrid Fusion ```yaml capability_key: retrieval_hybrid_fusion activation_trigger: a completed semantic A/B shows independent product-relevant gain and current retrievers demonstrate complementary misses under explicit user selection required_evidence: - frozen outputs and identities for exact/symbol/lexical and semantic retrievers - evidence that neither retriever alone covers the bounded mandatory-source set minimum_acceptance: - compare baseline, simple merge, and bounded RRF without changing sufficiency or authority owners - report recall, duplicate suppression, latency, stale rejection, and failure attribution non_activation: - semantic provider availability, one attractive hit, or desire to implement a documented architecture stop_condition: retain the simplest method unless bounded fusion shows independent gain; do not activate persistence or reranking automatically ``` ### 6.3 Persistent Vector Storage ```yaml capability_key: retrieval_persistent_vector_storage activation_trigger: semantic retrieval has verified product gain and a real consumer proves material rebuild cost, multi-task or multi-repository reuse, or incremental invalidation cannot be handled by a rebuildable run-local cache required_evidence: - measured rebuild and query cost over bound source identities - repeated consumer demand plus explicit invalidation and ownership requirements minimum_acceptance: - exact index identity binds provider, embedding model, chunking, source snapshot, and schema - stale entries are rejected and rebuild/incremental invalidation is deterministic - the index remains a cache and never becomes Evidence, sufficiency, or Patch authority non_activation: - one hundred thousand lines, installed vector dependencies, general scale concern, or unmeasured future reuse stop_condition: prefer rebuildable ephemeral storage until measured consumers justify persistence; stop on unresolved stale-index or ownership behavior ``` ## 7. Document Relationships - `docs/ACTIVE_PRODUCT_CONTRACT.md` keeps only the current product selection and permission boundary; it does not copy this table. - `docs/PROJECT_STATE.md` keeps only the current active blocker/selection and may link this register without copying entries. - `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_QUEUE.md` keeps only selected executable or conditional work; an observed issue is not automatically queued. - `docs/audits/LOOP_HISTORY.md` owns completed chronological narratives. - This register retains compact problem identity and reopening conditions only.

Scope And Counting Rule This audit is not bounded by a calendar window. It covers the current logical chain from the RAG-1A explicit-unresolved and relation-lineage closure through AccurateCrosshair P0/P1, sealed Entry, Recovery actuals 1-6, and the current requirement-projection blocker. The unit counted below is a logical workstream, not a commit, chat page, file, or test command. A workstream may legitimately have no Issue when it is normal capability construction, a product decision, a successful admission, or read-only asset governance. An Issue is required when a real failure, repeated failure signature, safety defect, or stage blocker establishes a physical owner and a trigger. ```yaml logical_workstreams_reviewed: 35 direct_issue_or_conditional_catalog_interactions: 17 normal_capability_or_decision_no_issue_required: 10 issue_interaction_gaps_found: 8 cross_cutting_stale_issue_statuses_found: 3 new_registered_issues_from_this_audit: - EXEC-001 - BUILD-001 - FS-001 - FS-002 - EVID-002 stale_existing_entries_updated: - ENTRY-002 - REPORT-001 - DOC-001 historical_gap_recorded_without_reactivation: - Wall relation-aware Requirement Projection correction at 8c5509e post_checkpoint_update_interactions_reviewed: 12 post_checkpoint_update_new_registered_issues: 1 post_checkpoint_update_new_registered_issue_ids: - PLAN-001 ``` The eight interaction gaps consist of one closed-route historical gap, four distinct actual1-4 execution failures, and three projection workstreams (actual5 failure, checkpoint `2b18874`, and actual6 revalidation) consolidated under the same current physical owner `EVID-002`. ## 2. trigger only if the default/public Graph receives real write authority without exact source/root authority, or selected ProductExecution fails an explicit negative path test | | Findings local schema | Owner not reached | No Issue now; wait for a separately authorized actual7 to reach findings and expose a findings-owned failure | | Requirement coverage continuity through Repair | Owner not reached | No Issue now; wait for a legal Patch followed by changed-product failure that exposes coverage loss or misrepresentation | | New sealed preflight, receipt, and actual7 | Later authority gates | Not authorized by this docs checkpoint; documents.text: # 首轮评测驱动开发结果：2026-09-26 本页保留2026-09-26起各批开发与评测经过，数字和当时待办按所属批次解释。最新可填写成果及缺口见[成果清单](../PROJECT_OUTCOMES.md)，活动工作方式见[交付与评测](../EVALUATION_FIRST_CYCLE.md)。AccurateCrosshair交付在第8、9节，独立首轮在第10节，重复及后续结果在第11—13节。 本主记录的结果截面仅包括下文明确命名的已完成证据。后续开发运行、诊断探针与候选策略不自动并入这里的分母；仍保留原运行和原评分文件。为什么要有它：同一目录会继续增长，新增诊断或改进不能回写成旧基线已经成功。 详细逐例判定留在机器记录中，本页集中解释口径、可填写成果及缺口。产品开发、RAG 问答、组件治理、受控编译和独立留出分别报告。为什么要有它：这些证据检验的对象和执行边界不同，不能相互增加成功数。 原标注存在支持度误判，原件保留；见第 9 节 | 真实筛选数据训练、检索控制推理与独立质量对照仍在实施 | 上述“未测/不可填”保留为 unknown 或 N/A，不写成零成本、零故障或零提升。为什么要有它：未出现对应执行或没有完整分母，不等于已经观测到零。 ## 2. 真实产品开发基线：B0 与 B1 均未交付 [B0 协议](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/development_protocol.json)和[B1 协议](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/development_candidate_protocol.json)绑定同一公开任务 `owned-config-max-retries-validation`、同一请求及目标源码起点。两者均为 `development`、`independent_holdout_eligible=false`，暴露状态为 `public_previously_used_and_inspected`。 模型配置为本地 `qwen3-coder:30b`，digest `06c1097efce0431c2045fe7b2e5108366e43bee1b4603a7aded8f21689e90bca`，上下文 32,768、最大输出 4,096；任务调用预算 12，worker turns 8、工具轮数 6、观察预算 32,768 bytes、provider timeout 180 秒。入口为自然语言 `run-request`；预批准目标是行为验证通过后等待精确 diff 批准，最终交付还需原 Apply/Build 路径。 | 观察 | B0 `dev01_b0` | B1 `dev01_b1` | | --- | --- | --- | | 候选变化 | 冻结的当前产品基线 | 缺失输入义务的结构化纠错提示；另加入保持代码身份的产品布局 oracle 适配 | | 已记录模型阶段 | projection、projection correction | projection、correction、findings，以及两轮补查 query/findings | | 已验证产品终态 | `domain_blocked`；`recorded_product_success=false` | `domain_blocked`；`recorded_product_success=false` | | 终态阻断 | 需求覆盖不足，Planning 没有充分的当前正式覆盖 | 需求仍被判为缺失/未解决，覆盖不足 | | 任务的 Apply / Build / Runtime / Evaluation | 均未到达 | 均未到达 | | 可作何结论 | 基线失败已观测 | 候选进入更多证据判断步骤，但未完成需求，不能称修复成功 | 终态及用量以[B0 测量 v2](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/dev01_b0_measurement_v2.json)、[B1 测量](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/dev01_b1_measurement.json)为准；旧的 B0 测量文件保留，不覆盖。结果投影的 `completion`、`independent_task_count`、`task_total_*` 仍为 null，原因是只选择了明确的运行段，没有完整历史证明。这里确认的是两个选定运行的失败终态，不是给全任务或独立任务完成率补零。 B1 协议明确是开发工程增量，不是独立留出或整个任务的单因素因果实验。新增 oracle 未被这两个运行实际走到；它的组件验证不能提升 B1 的产品成功数。 准备阶段的[原始工程行为基线](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/owned_config_baseline_verification.json)确认了 7 项预期需求失败及全部 8 项保留行为通过。这证明存在待修需求与可用裁判；不等于 Agent 已修复，也不等于任务 Build 已通过。 ### 追加开发运行：dev02_trace [dev02 准备 v2](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/dev02_preparation_v2.json)选择此前已暴露的 `AccurateCrosshair` 配置任务：无保存配置时让 Follow Recoil 默认关闭，保留已有显式值、其他默认值与配置键。任务 ID 为 `accurate-crosshair-recoil-default-off`，同样 `development`、`independent_holdout_eligible=false`，使用相同 30b 模型名、32,768 上下文、12 次任务预算；验收要求完整工程编译与真实 BepInEx 配置读写，不要求游戏画面。 [执行收据](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/dev02_execution.json)记录外层墙钟 **131.636 秒**、退出码 1、未超时；[选段测量](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/dev02_measurement.json)记录 projection、findings、planning 共 3 条真实模型响应。最终阻断为 `EDIT_TARGET_NORMALIZATION_UNSAFE`：同一路径的重叠可编辑证据未共享完整且一致的源码/方法身份。该事实先作为新反例保留，不在本报告推断其根因或声称已修复。 运行 manifest 记录基线工程确实 Build 成功、退出码 0、有 DLL 哈希；任务修改后的 Patch/Apply/Build/Runtime/Evaluation 均未到达。执行收据的 `snapshot_root` 所指 `frozen-dev02/child_execution.json` 为 `status=verified`、`failures=[]`。**执行来源 verified、基线 Build 成功和需求交付成功是三件事；本次产品结果仍为 false。** dev02 是不同任务，不能与 B0/B1 作跨任务策略收益对照。 ### 追加模板候选：dev01_b2 [模板独立审阅](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/planning_template_review.json)确认两个规划所有者改为共用具体事实义务，保留自定义要求及原放行校验。[新协议](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/dev01_b2_preparation_v2.json)从 dev02 已验证源码快照装配，仅覆盖三个模板文件；未包含正在开发的 Planning 纠正特性。原任务、模型、12 次调用预算和验收保持原配置。 [执行](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/dev01_b2_execution.json)墙钟 96.689 秒、退出码 1；[测量](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/dev01_b2_measurement.json)记录两次真实 projection 调用，输入 5,532、输出 983 Token，14 次源查询。初次输出把输入 5/6/7 同时计入 requirements 和 dispositions；纠错反馈只定位输入 5 并要求保留其他字段，模型只删除了该项 disposition，6/7 仍冲突。原始输出没有列出的 post-change 项由既有契约自动补齐，不是本次持续失败的缺项。未实际调用 Findings 或 Planning 模型，未进入 Patch。该候选的工程语义整理已验证，但本次没有表现出交付改善。 ### 追加规划纠正候选：dev02_c1 [协议](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/dev02_c1_preparation_v2.json)从 dev02 冻结源装配，只加入一次预算内目标纠正及 Planning 实际 HTTP 正文保存；没有加入新的证据模板。该版本经过[独立边界审阅](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/planning_correction_review.json)。[实际运行](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/dev02_c1_execution.json)耗时 143.735 秒、退出码 1；[测量](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/dev02_c1_measurement.json)为 4 条生成、输入 17,356、输出 1,313 Token、8 次源查询。 新的纠正通路确实执行一次，但模型返回了与第一轮相同的两个 ID 和 rationale；原 normalizer 再次拒绝，Patch 未到达。这证明反馈与预算接线可执行，**没有证明目标选择或交付效果改善**，也不记作修复成功。相比该任务基线多一次模型调用；两次运行的墙钟没有经过重复/冷暖控制，不作延迟提升结论。 ### 追加投影纠错候选：dev01_b3 [协议](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/dev01_b3_preparation_v2.json)及[独立审阅](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/projection_conflict_review.json)绑定了多冲突反馈及已审的追踪/规划接线。[真实执行](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/dev01_b3_execution.json)为 111.719 秒、退出码 1；[测量](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/dev01_b3_measurement.json)为两条生成、输入 7,236、输出 1,019 Token、14 次源查询。实际 HTTP 请求中已包含 5/6/7 三项冲突及组合修复规则，但模型仍返回未解决冲突的投影，原验证继续拒绝；Findings/Patch 均未调用。多冲突反馈的本地合同缺陷已修，**当前本地模型未因此完成该任务**，不将两次受控 callback 的通过记作真实模型通过。 ## 3. 固定 RFC 语料的 RAG 实测 语料为 RFC 8259，1 PDF、16 页、39 chunks。题型为精确概念 2、语义改写 3、多证据 3、信息不足 2。配置冻结后完成 20 个 query/arm 对；hybrid 使用 BGE-M3 查询向量，实际记录 10 次 embedding 请求。随后在原来的 top-3 contexts 上，用 `qwen3-coder:30b` 生成 20 个回答；温度 0、输出上限 1,024、无自动重试，gold 未送入生成器。 证据入口：[题集 manifest](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/rag_holdout/manifest.json)、[检索协议](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/rag_holdout/retrieval_protocol.json)、[检索执行](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/rag_holdout/retrieval_execution.json)、[回答协议](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/rag_holdout/answer_protocol.json)、[回答执行](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/rag_holdout/answer_execution.json)。回答客户端没有证明服务端实际 context window，不能把配置推测当成已核验值。 | 指标 | BM25 | Hybrid | 分母说明 | | --- | ---: | ---: | --- | | 宏平均 evidence-group Recall@3 | 81.25% | 68.75% | 8 个可答题各自算召回后等权平均 | | 命中的必需证据组 | 8/11 | 7/11 | 微观组计数，不能直接当成上行宏平均 | | 全部必需组命中的题 | 6/8 | 5/8 | 不包含 2 个信息不足题 | | 精确概念题宏平均 Recall@3 | 100% | 100% | 每臂 2 题 | | 语义改写题宏平均 Recall@3 | 100% | 66.67% | 每臂 3 题 | | 多证据题宏平均 Recall@3 | 50% | 50% | 每臂 3 题 | | AI 审阅引用正确 | 17/22，77.27% | 20/27，74.07% | 每次出现的 `[context:N]` 是一个引用单元 | | AI 审阅严格正确拒答 | 1/2 | 1/2 | 仅 gold 标为信息不足的两题 | | 可答题观察到的拒答 | 0/8 | 0/8 | 没有拒答不等于答对；另区分当前证据是否充分 | 召回原件见[Recall 报告](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/rag_holdout/recall_report.json)；语义判定见[独立 AI 引用/拒答审阅](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/rag_holdout/citation_refusal_review.json)。两种评分检验不同对象：Recall 按冻结 gold 的完整引文 chunk 替代集合计组命中，其他部分或等价片段不会自动计命中；语义审阅直接核对模型实际收到的文本。因此，未命中完整 gold 组不必然等于毫无可用信息。 49 个引用单元中，37 个正确、12 个错误、unknown 为 0；8 个回答有 9 组实质无引用覆盖缺口。独立语义审阅没有参与题目编写或回答生成，并在评分时未读 Recall 分数，但仍是 AI 判断，`human_verified=false`。其中有边界解释：承认 RFC 不足后仍给出题目所求的外部 draft/关键词，不算严格拒答；没有给出具体算法/规范化步骤的外部文档转介另记覆盖缺口。 典型失败包括：第 06 题两臂都把完整 JSON 根值错误限为对象或数组；第 08 题 BM25 遗漏 `application/json`；第 09 题两臂声明材料不足后仍补充外部 Schema 选择。正确的局部引用并不能使整答结论正确。 题集资格以[语义重合自审](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/rag_holdout/eligibility_review.json)补充限定：作者未看检索分数，对新旧 query 的自审为 7 题目标区别明确、3 题部分重合（03、05、07），并非独立第三方或人工审核。合适的表述是“固定同源语料上新编、未用于本次调参的 10 道诊断题”，不是“10 道全量语义独立留出”。全部题目与原分母保留，没有删掉重合题重算更好分数。 平均查询耗时记录为 55.03 ms / 560.08 ms，但查询顺序固定为每题先 BM25 后 hybrid，包含冷启动/缓存差异；协议只允许描述耗时，不支持速度优越或 P95 改善结论。10 题、单一熟悉文档及 AI gold 也不足以证明普遍检索选型优势。 ## 4. 治理、恢复及受限执行的证据层级 [治理矩阵 Run 02](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/governance/run_02/summary.json)覆盖 18 类已知场景，30 个参数化 cases 通过。它们不是 30 个独立工程任务，也不是随机抽样攻击。 | 场景测量 | 观察值 | 执行边界 | | --- | ---: | --- | | 应拒绝边界错误放行 | 0/14 | Dry-run、Apply、Build 结果接纳、重放和内存预算等选定边界 | | 重复副作用 | 0/5 | 各案例分别观察 Build callback、物理 Apply/产物或 resume report；不是同一种副作用的五次重复 | | 支持的计划内续接 | 2/2 | 延迟批准及批准后 Apply→Build，编译为受控替身 | | 持久记录读取恢复 | 1/1 | 同一进程重新打开 ArtifactStore，非真实进程崩溃 | | 部分/未知写入报告 | 1/1 场景族，含 7 cases | 保留实际写入事实并阻断下游，不声称完成了恢复 | 生产执行器、Graph 和 ArtifactStore 在真实临时文件/持久产物上运行；模型回复和编译结果为确定性测试替身，个别传播测试使用内存 Store。[详细边界与测量修正](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260926/governance/README.md)保留了各例差异。 Run 02 的 pytest 退出码为 **Self-RAG现有记录的进一步判读**：只读配对核实三臂14/14使用相同有序证据，外部Critic初始答案14/14与固定检索相同；其14次均拒绝并重写，原AI效用评分仅2题上升、12题不变。训练臂14/14均自评fully_supported，无法区分本轮57条无证据断言。由此将后续核验重点放在修订判定、标签区分能力与生成提示/输出协议/权重变化；材料不同这一解释已被本批数据排除。先完成当前测量，不新增无假设训练；保留[配对记录](C:/Users/10160/.codex/visualizations/2026/09/26/01a0dbd6-eb58-7d82-aacc-86c6fdb8618e/e1/self-rag-independent-20260928/existing_policy_diagnosis_01.json)。 Transfer失败诊断与正常入口复验：2026-09-28 再次核对td5真实请求，完整B0源码、受测候选、四个公开反例及重复代码警告均已送达；修订请求还包含旧格式错误候选、过时推测与重复反馈。复用原请求进行两次单轮诊断：原13消息请求仍要求读取源码；保留当前合同/源码/候选/全部最新观察的8消息视图改为再次请求upstream，未生成可验证修订。后续简明直接修复调用逐字复制已失败代码，不能据输入变短采用该方案。 让同一模型先诊断实际失败再生成，得到新的临时余额模拟实现。既有受限Docker实际编译及公开检查为**3/4**，链式信用、累计扣款回滚和余额溢出回滚通过，版本溢出因抛出错误异常类型而失败；再次直接反馈后，代码字节仍不变。共6次开发诊断调用、33,210输入/3,766输出Token、模型请求合计253.452秒；[汇总与原响应](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260928/transfer_repair_context_probe/probe-summary.json)链接[真实公开验收](C:/Users/10160/.codex/visualizations/2026/09/26/01a0dbd6-eb58-7d82-aacc-86c6fdb8618e/e1/tp/dr1/result.json)。未提供参考实现或人工修改模型代码；这些阶段控制不填独立任务或产品交付分母。模型诊断中仍有错误的异常观察转述和算术说明，未被采纳为事实。 **处理决定**：实现可选 `diagnose_behavior_failures`，默认关闭。在真实行为失败且至少剩两次共享调用时，先诊断当前候选和全部实际反馈，再继续原Patch循环；诊断占用同一调用、上下文字节与provider上下文额度，无工具执行权，模型分析只作待验证假设。诊断正文超出剩余字节时保留原响应和成本，跳过正文继续原修订，不新增语义审批。为什么要有它：观测表格未促成改码，而诊断先行已产生可验证的部分改善，需要回到正常入口测收益和额外成本。 输入、共享预算、候选更新、禁止工具执行、源码漂移及调用者的**42项相关检查分批通过**。其中原重复代码夹具在读取Ck后再次插入marker，实际不再重复，已改为重复绑定候选正文并保留全部原断言。两组新检查与该调用者加入现有CI选集，目前53文件；未宣称新版选集已完整执行或远程CI通过。 正常入口双臂按[冻结协议](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260928/transfer_diagnosis_product/protocol.json)执行：td6普通修订、td7启用诊断；同一需求、源码、模型、32K上下文、12次调用、32K观察字节、原私有8项与公开4项验收，仅诊断开关不同。两臂均从自然语言需求开始，未注入以上诊断候选。[最终结果](../../artifacts/eval_driven_20260928/transfer_diagnosis_product/execution-result.json)现已完成：均未交付，各自在三次行为检查中重复同一代码，止于`PATCH_BEHAVIOR_NO_PROGRESS`。诊断增加调用和Token，当前保持默认关闭，不继续同配置跑分；阶段3/4未转化为本轮产品交付。为什么要有它：原件已有终态就据此收口，不能让“已启动”叙述掩盖真实负结果或继续驱动无期限试验。

documents.title: Coding Agent v0 P0-P3 Delivery Route Decision
documents.text: # Coding Agent v0 P0-P3 Delivery Route Decision Status: detailed decision record Recorded: 2026-08-25 Recording context: `recorded_during_P1b_working_session`; status synchronized through actual6 and the active EVID-002 owner ## 1. Authority And Use This record preserves the stable product-route decisions behind Coding Agent v0. It is not implementation authority, a completion claim, an expected-side truth source, or a second Implementation Queue. Current source, focused tests, committed Artifacts, and actual-run evidence remain the empirical authority. The current user request and `docs/ACTIVE_PRODUCT_CONTRACT.md` retain execution authority. Two user-authored review files remain authoritative thought material for the engineering goal, value, tradeoffs, interview demonstration, and treatment of failure: - `C:/Users/10160/Desktop/项目回头自检.txt` - `C:/Users/10160/Desktop/项目自检-8月17.txt` They are not current implementation facts, expected truth, or permission to execute. Time boxes and elapsed cost are feasibility warnings and reporting inputs only; they do not veto the engineering structure required for a correct capability. Each work package is evaluated by direct benefit, reuse benefit, avoided future cost, added complexity, elapsed time, and an explicit decision to continue or stop expansion. ## 2. Product Objective And Closed Loop The objective is a trustworthy, evaluable, demonstrable Coding Agent v0, not a production-grade Agent or RAG platform built in advance. ```text request → Plan / Brief / FeatureSpec → repository and tool observations → requirement coverage → Evidence sufficiency → ImplementationPlan → Patch → Review / Dry-run → exact approval → isolated Apply → Build / Test → Repair / Revalidation → conditional Runtime → truthful result ``` Evaluation, RAG, authority controls, and documentation serve this chain. They are not independent product lines. ## 3. Six Authority Layers ```text Source Authenticity → Relevance → Requirement Coverage → Evidence Sufficiency → Patch Proposal Authority → Execution Authority ``` No retrieval signal independently grants sufficiency or Patch authority. A model may propose a semantic finding; it may not invent identity, omit a mandatory input, or directly set sufficiency, edit targets, Patch authority, or execution authority. High-risk writes and runtime actions require deterministic contracts, explicit authorization, and an auditable receipt. ## 4. Shared Requirement Pipeline There is no “dual lane architecture.” `change`, `pre_patch_evidence`, `preservation`, and `post_change_acceptance` are requirement semantic roles inside one shared Search Planning, Retrieval, Source Verification, EvidenceItem, and Coverage pipeline. Existing `planned_lanes` retain their tool/source/question execution meaning and are not repurposed as semantic roles. - EvidenceItems and requirements are many-to-many. - One EvidenceItem may support both change and preservation. - Preservation constrains the allowed semantic delta; it does not prohibit editing the file that contains the preserved behavior. - Role count, query-hit count, and EvidenceItem count are never sufficiency proxies. - Post-change acceptance must be accounted for but normally does not become a pre-patch loop gate. - `required_before_patch` is derived and validated by deterministic policy; the model cannot downgrade a mandatory obligation. The semantic trust boundary is: ```text model-originated semantic finding → deterministic requirement/evidence identity validation → deterministic current-source/reference validation → deterministic input accounting and coverage projection → deterministic sufficiency/edit-target/Patch-authority derivation ``` Deterministic code does not normally prove that natural-language semantic support is true; it constrains and audits what the model is allowed to claim. ## 5. Delivery Route And Current Status | Stage | Current synchronized status | Verified boundary | Next authority gate | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | P0 | completed | lexical-only RgLive observations fail closed without coverage | do not reopen for positive coverage | | P1a | completed at `d377ab466fb3e2c57c4c33e29bc2408864e5976e` | structural/synthetic positive requirement-coverage vertical | P1b formal provider and entry | | P1b | completed at `32a939b3f217721b076704cd7e701369fef532ed` | formal local projection/findings providers, validated consumer view, formal ProductExecution entry tests | stop Evidence expansion and enter P2 | | P2 | empirical path blocked at projection-to-findings; `ENTRY-002` closed for current scope; `EVID-002` active | actual5 and actual6 entered ProductExecution, called the local model twice each, and stopped before findings on the same projection disposition signature; checkpoint lineage `984716f` -> `22f8fa0` is formed but not yet macro-reviewed | checkpoint review, then a new preflight and separately authorized actual7 | | Internal Alpha | hard gates false/false | no changed-product success plus repair success pair | P2 empirical hard gates | | Public Alpha | not started | public entry and case evidence absent | Internal checkpoint plus public-entry actual | The current committed product checkpoint is `32a939b3f217721b076704cd7e701369fef532ed`. The P2 sealed-entry blocker is an entry/preflight incident, not evidence that the committed P1b provider or coverage capability is unimplemented. ## 6. P0: False-Sufficiency Closure P0 ensures that lexical-only or source-authentic observations remain non-authoritative when explicit requirement coverage is absent. - Checkpoint: `c8004845fe3f01d844e79ab8b6aba0634b6a5c01` - Completed transition: wrong `sufficient` → correct `insufficient` - P0 does not own positive requirement coverage and is not reopened by P1. - `EVID-001` should describe only the false-sufficiency defect; P1 is an independent product capability. ## 7. P1: Requirement Coverage And Positive Authority ### 7.1 P1a P1a checkpoint `d377ab466fb3e2c57c4c33e29bc2408864e5976e` completed the structural/synthetic vertical, not all of P1. It established: - input-obligation accounting; - versioned `requirement_coverage` inside the existing EvidencePack; - deterministic sufficiency and edit-target authority; - bounded multi-query live observations; - Planner selection of change-only edit targets; - Resolver rejection of supporting-to-edit promotion; - strict roundtrip and Hook/P0 compatibility. ### 7.2 P1b P1b checkpoint `32a939b3f217721b076704cd7e701369fef532ed` completed the formal local-model projection provider, findings provider, `run-request`/CLI construction, real preservation capture, and formal positive/blocked entry tests. This completion is bounded to product-path construction; it does not prove that a fresh sealed execution context can enter ProductExecution. The coupling decision is: - one coverage authority core owns accounting, validation, sufficiency, and edit-target derivation; - Planner and Resolver consume a stable validated coverage view; - generic relation identity belongs to a shared Evidence/Requirement boundary, while Hook Discovery keeps compatibility exports; - provider orchestration is separate from the authority core; - semantic validation remains in the core, while EvidencePack serialization and Artifact persistence remain in models/ArtifactStore; - ProposalReviewer continues through BindingResolver and does not repeat semantic judgment. Formal CLI tests may inject an admitted fake model adapter. They may not inject hand-authored projection/findings callbacks and call that the product entry. Natural-language keyword tables are not a substitute for the change versus preservation semantic provider; stable protocol syntax parsing remains valid. P1b completion ends default Evidence Architecture expansion and triggers a P2 admission review. ## 8. P2: Sealed Fresh Actual P2 product-path admission starts after the P1b actual-ready checkpoint. Fresh preflight4 plus actual5 and fresh preflight5 plus actual6 now satisfy the `ENTRY-002` current-scope close trigger: both actuals entered ProductExecution without entry-side repair. Entry remains separately reopenable on a new pre-ProductExecution identity or permission failure. Actual5 and actual6 establish the next current owner inside ProductExecution. The per-obligation schema from checkpoint `2b18874` was physically sent to Ollama, but one projection plus one correction still failed `REQUIREMENT_COVERAGE_INPUT_DISPOSITION_INVALID` before findings. `EVID-002` therefore owns exact local response-schema admission, precise semantic rejection diagnostics, and the existing single correction. It does not own retrieval, findings semantics, coverage policy, model switching, a third correction, or vector work. Three decisions remain separate: 1. **Code checkpoint review** may accept that the `984716f` -> `22f8fa0` lineage implements and tests its bounded claim. This does not change `EVID-002` to closed. 2. **Issue real-run closure** requires the recorded close trigger: after review and a new preflight, a separately authorized actual must reach findings without the projection failure signature. 3. **Actual7 product result** is independent of Issue closure. Actual7 may close `EVID-002` and still truthfully block later at findings, coverage, edit authority, Patch, or Build. It is not predeclared as product success. This remains P2 empirical work. P0 lexical false-sufficiency is completed and is not reopened by the projection Issue or its decision priority. ```text new checkpoint → new sealed packet → one new fresh actual task → Evidence → Plan → Patch → Review / Dry-run / exact approval → Apply → Build / Test → Repair / Revalidation when required ``` Each fresh actual task executes only. It does not implement providers, carry hand-written callbacks or expected projections, or repair platform code in place. On failure it freezes the first physical failure and returns to that owner. Runtime requires separate authorization only when applicable to the task's acceptance boundary. P2 hard gates are: 1. one actual-only changed-product Build/Test success; 2. one Failure → Different Repair → Revalidation success. ## 9. Internal Alpha To Public Alpha The two P2 hard gates produce the Internal Alpha checkpoint. After Internal Alpha, minimum Trace/Eval and the unique Public Runner/RAG-1B advance together; they do not wait for every operations platform. ```text one public entry → the same Runner → the same StateGraph → the same ArtifactStore and authority chain ``` Internal success does not prove public-entry success. The public entry requires another real actual. A bounded set of three to five real Cases should cover success, repair, correct block, authority-negative behavior, and technical failure attribution, retaining trajectories, calls, timings, failures, and limitations. Before Public Alpha, minimum Operational Readiness remains owned by the `minimum_acceptance` of `ENTRY-001`, `OPS-001`, `TOOL-001`, `REPORT-001`, and `REC-001` in `docs/audits/ENGINEERING_ISSUE_REGISTER.md`. The advanced-robustness catalog—full circuit breaker, model gateway, automatic fallback, distributed recovery, and related capabilities—remains `conditional_trigger`, `current_queue=false`, `internal_alpha_blocker=false`, and `minimum_public_alpha_blocker=false` unless a real risk audit at activation time promotes a specific item. Minimum Trace/Eval does not mean building a Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, Dashboard, or release platform first. Existing Artifacts and receipts may provide the initial inspectable demonstration. ## 10. Evidence Architecture And Issue Activation P1b is a required capability for the next actual and therefore belongs in the current work, not in an Issue waiting for repetition. Without it the formal entry deterministically remains insufficient. After P1b, Evidence Architecture stops expanding by default and the product returns to P2. Classification rule: - required by the next actual → current Queue; - observed with a known owner but not blocking the next actual → Engineering Issue; - not physically observed → conditional trigger; - long-term principle → decision record or `documented_only` reference; - completed work → audit or loop history. The Issue Register is not a TODO list, Queue, or authority source. Later Evidence work reactivates only after a fresh actual exposes a new first failure, the same failure repeats, a real consumer appears, and the user selects that owner. ## 11. P3 And Public-Alpha Maturity P3 covers only capabilities justified by the selected product route: - task-applicable Runtime/gameplay evidence; - one Runner and Public entry; - three to five tasks plus bounded repeatability evidence; - minimum Trace/Eval, run reporting, and demonstration; - the minimum `OPS`/`ENTRY`/`TOOL`/`REPORT`/`REC` package; - documentation and checkpoint closure; - a truthful Public Alpha claim. P3 does not automatically include every advanced-robustness direction. ## 12. Explicit Deferrals And Conditional Triggers The following are not activated by this route: - Dense retrieval, semantic hybrid retrieval, RRF, and reranking; - complete Eval, CI, nightly, release, or observability platforms; - fifty to two hundred Cases; - formal model-comparison programs; - LoRA, SFT, DPO, or multimodal work; - complete distributed recovery or model-gateway platforms; - reconciliation of the four protected WIP documents, which remains separate, incremental, and non-blocking for P1/P2. Semantic/vector retrieval activates only if exact, symbol, and live-source retrieval still demonstrates a real recall failure under a real Eval. ## 13. Collaboration And Workspace Boundaries - The current macro review task owns architecture, priority, and authorization packets. - The only implementation-progress task is `01a0285e-22ac-7d02-8052-227def631dfe`. - Old long-context tasks receive no new work. - Every fresh actual uses a new task and is never reused. - The following user WIP files remain protected from modification, staging, or commit: - `docs/ARCHITECTURE_OVERVIEW.md` - `docs/ENGINEERING_RAG_EVIDENCE_INTELLIGENCE_TARGET_DRAFT.md` - `docs/SPEC_COVERAGE_MATRIX.md` - `docs/LOCAL_MODEL_COMPARATIVE_EVALUATION_EXPERIMENT.md` ## 14. Related Records - `docs/audits/ENGINEERING_ISSUE_REGISTER.md` - `docs/audits/RG_LIVE_EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENCY_OWNER_AUDIT_20260824.json` - `docs/audits/ACCURATE_CROSSHAIR_ACTUAL_OUTCOME_20260824.json` - `docs/audits/ACCURATE_CROSSHAIR_SEALED_ENTRY_ATTEMPTS_20260825.md` - `docs/audits/LOOP_HISTORY.md` - P0 checkpoint `c8004845fe3f01d844e79ab8b6aba0634b6a5c01` - P1a checkpoint `d377ab466fb3e2c57c4c33e29bc2408864e5976e` - P1b checkpoint `32a939b3f217721b076704cd7e701369fef532ed` ## 15. Current Decision Snapshot ```yaml snapshot_as_of_commit: 22f8fa0f6913e964b556d49c8d3d6a01ead5ae2e P0: completed P1a: completed P1b: completed ENTRY_repository_implementation_checkpoint: completed P2_product_path_admission: admitted fresh_sealed_entry_admission: passed_for_current_scope ENTRY-002: closed ProductExecution_actual_runs: 2 current_P2_model_calls: 4_total_across_actual5_and_actual6 current_owner: EVID-002 EVID-002_status: active_pending_actual7 EVID-002_code_checkpoint: 984716f_to_22f8fa0_formed_pending_macro_review actual6_baseline_build: passed actual6_changed_product_build: not_reached Internal_Alpha_hard_gates: false/false ``` The current checkpoint plus actuals prove only the bounded facts above. They do not prove positive sufficiency, Patch generation, changed-product Build, Repair/Revalidation, Entry repeatability beyond the tested scope, or Internal Alpha completion. ## 16. Single-Owner Orchestration Boundary The intended composition is: ```text Thin Entry Admission → ProductExecution Preflight → one existing StateGraph → bounded capability adapters ``` Entry Admission owns packet/manifest identity, execution security context, physical locations, tool and local-model availability, outer permission and budget facts, output-root admission, and one delegate/no-delegate decision. It does not own product retry, Patch approval, completion, or business truth. ProductExecution Preflight owns the product request, content/source binding, provider/product contracts, Artifact boundary, and Graph admission. The two layers must not independently own attempt, retry, approval, or completion. At `c906d99dba8f1850864e090c4f925a78fbd4f373`, one `StrictGitAdmission` identity is threaded through entry and downstream source revalidation without turning Entry into a second control plane. Observations may change the engineering direction. The Graph constrains legal order, permission, and side effects; it does not pre-decide search strategy, interpretation, or Repair direction. BHF and WallCrawler rules remain domain Harness facts and do not enter the generic Workflow owner. Models may propose engineering semantics; deterministic owners retain identity, coverage, authority, and side-effect decisions. Capability work remains consumer-first: identify who consumes the result, what decision it changes, what current contract cannot represent, and what failure proves the need before adding infrastructure. A read-only subsystem exits after returning its bounded facts and cannot retain route or completion authority. ## 17. Recovery And Failure Semantics - **Retry** repeats the same bounded operation under an explicit retry owner. - **Resume** continues from a validated durable checkpoint without replaying completed work. - **Recovery** re-establishes a trustworthy execution owner and state after a process, host, permission, or entry failure. - **Repair** changes the proposed implementation in response to bound product evidence. - **Rollback** directly restores a prior reversible state. - **Compensation** uses a newly authorized action to offset an irreversible or externally visible side effect. - **Fallback** creates a new, lower-authority attempt using a prevalidated capability profile; it never silently replaces the original failure. Adapters report facts. One control owner decides whether retry is legal. Outer Entry Admission does not own product retry. | Failure fact | Default route | | --- | --- | | deterministic identity, authority, or schema rejection | block and return the exact owner | | explicitly retryable transient provider/tool failure before side effects | one bounded retry owner may propose a new attempt | | committed checkpoint with valid continuation authority | resume | | lost or uncertain execution ownership | recovery or safe stop | | product behavior failure with edit authority | Repair | | unknown side-effect state | safe stop and reconcile | ## 18. Authority-Aware Degradation `FULL`, `EVIDENCE_DEGRADED`, `PLAN_ONLY`, and `SAFE_STOP` are logical operating semantics. They should first be projected through existing readiness, blockers, requirement coverage, and authority facts rather than creating a new schema. Capability degradation may preserve or contract authority; it may never expand it. Unknown source identity, permission, or side-effect state maps to `SAFE_STOP`. Cached, partial, or stale material cannot present itself as fresh, complete, sufficient Evidence or Patch authority. ## 19. Retrieval And Vector Boundary RAG does not require a vector database. Semantic vectors, when activated, are only a location-recall aid. Retrieved locations must be rehydrated from current live source and rebound to current path/hash/span identity. An index is a rebuildable cache; a vector hit is not an `EvidenceItem`, requirement coverage, Evidence sufficiency, or Patch authority. Semantic A/B, hybrid fusion, and persistent vector storage activate only under the separate conditional triggers in the Engineering Issue Register. This decision record does not activate them. ## 20. Artifact, Checkpoint, Trace, Contract Reuse And Coverage Map - Graph checkpoint answers **how execution may continue**. - ArtifactStore owns product facts that require durable authority, side-effect, resume, lineage, or terminal truth. - Trace answers **what happened** and does not become a second fact owner. All stages should be observable, but not every stage creates an Artifact. Persistence belongs only at durable boundaries. Identity taxonomy remains explicit: outer run/attempt, entry preflight, product run/request/feature, stage/action/observation, provider call, Patch/approval, and Repair/revalidation identities must be correlated without being collapsed into one identifier. `RunEnvelope`, `ValidatedSourceBinding`, `StageOutcome`, `ToolCallSpec`, and `ToolReceipt` are logical checklists. They do not justify new types until a real consumer proves that existing contracts cannot represent the required fact. Run-local working memory is necessary for bounded continuation. Cross-task long-term memory activates only after repeated real tasks establish a retrieval need; it remains planning-only and cannot store Golden data, old Hook answers, or historical output as current fact. | Content | Unique owner | | --- | --- | | stable orchestration, recovery, degradation, retrieval, and contract principles | this Decision Record | | Sealed-entry Attempts A1–A5 physical facts | AccurateCrosshair sealed-entry incident record | | Complete recent logical-chain Issue interaction and actual1–6 facts | `docs/audits/CODING_AGENT_V0_RECENT_ISSUE_INTERACTION_AUDIT_20260826.md` | | trigger, physical owner, reopening and minimum acceptance | Engineering Issue Register | | explicitly activated work | Implementation Queue | | Architecture WIP stable single-Graph/observation principles; old BHF/WC order excluded | `reconcile_later` | | RAG draft stable semantic/authority/consumer principles; obsolete checkpoints and exits excluded | `extract_stable_principles_then_historicalize_or_rewrite_later` | | Coverage Matrix WIP | `regenerate_after_ENTRY` from current source; do not migrate the stale CAV0 table | | Local Model untracked protocol | `paused_standalone_asset_reconcile_later`; comparison waits for stable interfaces and a real product bottleneck | This record preserves the decision route only. It does not authorize the `EVID-002` implementation checkpoint's successor packet, preflight, actual7, or any Internal or Public Alpha claim.

documents.title: Langfuse execution diagnostics
documents.text: # Langfuse execution diagnostics Base: `7faf3a32c44606b166549638d94b35758d7e6b90`. Current acceptance: both newly completed owned Repair runs have now been sent and verified in Cloud: **42 observations, six generations and three scores**. [Paging](https://us.cloud.langfuse.com/project/cmtr5q7ae024iad0im785u4xl/traces/b707f8d386fe1284627765c3573cc205) records 7/7; [nested snapshot](https://us.cloud.langfuse.com/project/cmtr5q7ae024iad0im785u4xl/traces/498784a38297d0b40c55d67d3b1e7f5e) retains the 2/4 failure (WARNING, score 0.5) and later 4/4 (score 1.0). Original IDs, parents, types, UTC instants at Cloud millisecond precision, native levels/status messages and score identities/values matched on readback. Each request was sent once; immediate empty reads were followed by read-only reconciliation after asynchronous ingestion, without repeated POSTs. There were two OTLP POSTs and three score POSTs, no new model calls for export, and no source, prompt/reply body, local path or GTFO disclosure. These were runtime observations captured locally in frozen `a8b8971`, mapped/exported afterward; automatic live export at execution time is not claimed. The definitive export receipt is local `scratch/langfuse_cloud_diagnosis_20260909/actual-preview/completion.json`. The user requested direct use of Cloud tracing and useful journal capabilities in Langfuse. The Cloud remains a query/evaluation projection. Local journals and Artifacts retain source bytes, approval authority, recovery inputs and replay. This change does not move workflow state or grant model/source disclosure. ## Direct Cloud query `python -m src.observability.patch_langfuse_query --trace-id <actual trace ID>` reads one trace with the existing environment-configured HTTP transport. `--output <local JSON path>` writes the regenerable diagnostic result. The reader discovers current Cloud MCP tool/input/observation-field schemas; it allows only observation/schema/score reads, requests neither input nor output, and expands the three existing structured metadata fields used for bindings. Pagination and response sizes remain bounded. Schema drift, identity conflicts and incomplete pagination fail explicitly rather than claim complete evidence. The result reports recorded generations separately from `model.request` observations and reserved worker calls; times are calculated from actual UTC start/end values. Token aggregation understands this mapper's exclusive usage buckets and the Cloud-added derived `total`, without adding that total twice. Unmeasured usage, cost and TTFT remain unknown. Tool consumption joins use both call identity and observed-byte hash. Verification joins use the recorded output hash. These joins establish recorded identity, not semantic correctness. One actual Cloud trace (`08109b3cf24f0f65374c3932cc7516ad`) was queried with the new reader: 18 observations, 3 generations, 1 behavior-failed verification bound to generation 2, and one source observation consumed by generations 2 and 3. Generation 3 registered an upstream request with `upstream_execution_performed=false`; the root is partial at `generate_patch_proposal`. Cloud scores for that trace were empty. This is an old owned debugging run, not the current Repair acceptance or Mod delivery. The first live query exposed HTTP 406 because the reused HTTP helper did not declare MCP response types. The helper now adds `Accept: application/json, text/event-stream` only for the MCP endpoint. The same read then succeeded. Existing OTLP and historical score paths retain their request headers. ## Cloud dashboard already verified [Mod Agent 执行与验证](https://us.cloud.langfuse.com/project/cmtr5q7ae024iad0im785u4xl/dashboards/cmttvkxin00iiad0imc5sf21d) contains five native widgets: generation counts, latency p50/p95, input/output tokens, behavior-failed verification counts and partial-root counts. Creation, query results and saved placement/configuration were read back via Cloud APIs; rendered browser appearance was not independently verified. Its sample is the original four approved traces: 57 observations, including nine generations. The dashboard is filtered to the existing debugging data and a fixed September 8–10 UTC window. Counts are not production success rates. No new source, model prompt or GTFO material was uploaded to create it. Cloud metadata reads truncate structured keys to 200 characters unless expanded. Expanding `artifact_refs` proved all four original lists equal the approved payload. The nine usage differences were Cloud-added `total` values. Neither was evidence of lost uploaded data. ## What this does not establish - All Mod delivery stages are not yet demonstrated in Cloud. An absent span is unobserved; it does not independently prove that an operation did not run. - The actual `nlcfg_002` journal contains 19 Patch/tool/verification observations and two `patch.generate` generations. Projection, Findings and Planning each ran once upstream, but are absent from those observations. Projection/Findings sidecars retain request/output hashes without UTC start/end or usage; Planning has measured elapsed/provider duration and usage but no UTC start/end. These old facts must not be retrofitted with inferred generation timestamps. Future collection belongs at `complete_requirement_coverage_json`, `PlanningClient.complete_turn` and their actual provider calls, with the existing product trace activated before those stages. Current Patch activation occurs afterward; adding no-op spans outside it would not solve this gap. - A completed observation or `DEFAULT` level is not task success. Original records had 53 DEFAULT and four ERROR observations. - Prompt Name requires an actual managed-prompt linkage. TTFT requires actual first-output timing. Neither is generated from unrelated timestamps. - Deterministic compile, behavior, configuration and applicable Runtime results remain separate. An LLM judge cannot replace those checks. - Old development tasks are not an independent evaluation set. Dataset/experiment use must preserve task splits, scorer versions, all failed trials and deployment identity. No new judge, training, model call or automatic prompt update ran here. ## Query verification Python: existing main-repository `.venv/Scripts/python.exe` (3.10.20), cwd the isolated `langfuse_execution_diagnostics_001` tree. Initial query unit checks: `-B -m pytest tests/unit/test_patch_langfuse_query.py -q --tb=short` — 10 passed, 1.15s. After the observed HTTP 406/header repair: `-B -m pytest tests/unit/test_patch_langfuse_query.py tests/unit/test_patch_langfuse.py -q --tb=short` — 40 passed, 4.09s. Both used short system-temp basetemp/cache paths. The tests cover duplicate counts, conflicting IDs, mismatched tool content, missing usage/timing, score identity, dynamic schema drift, pagination loops, body exclusion and MCP Accept negotiation. Ruff fatal checks passed. Actual read-only output and native dashboard receipts are retained under the local run root `scratch/langfuse_cloud_diagnosis_20260909`; these local files are not a second durable workflow index. ## Prospective native verifier status and bound scores `patch_live_langfuse.py` now identifies new observations with `patch_live_langfuse_metadata_v2`. A normally returned `patch.verify` observation with `behavior_failed`, `needs_evidence`, `infrastructure_failed` or `identity_failed` receives native `WARNING` and a machine status message. Completed workflows explicitly marked partial, blocked or failed also receive `WARNING`. Neutral observation exceptions retain native `ERROR` and OTLP error status; a completed negative verifier keeps its completed-operation status. `DEFAULT` and completed operations are explicitly described as not task acceptance. No exception body, model explanation or local path is copied into the status message. The mapping uses the documented [`langfuse.observation.level` and `langfuse.observation.status_message`](https://langfuse.com/integrations/native/opentelemetry) attributes; the execution/semantic distinction is this platform's declared policy. The existing production wrapper `LocalOllamaInitialPatchAdapter._evaluate_generated_behavior` adds one guarded call to `verified_behavior_trace_attributes(report, model_response)` only when an execution trace is active. The bridge reads retained response bytes and the bound report, compares complete materialized-code and generated-change identities, then reuses the existing historical `_verified_check_counts` reader. It does not import historical records, alter a grader, or supply missing counts. Eligibility requires an admitted report, an actually invoked callback, explicit executed origin, retained response bytes matching their hash, bound report and matrix bytes, nonempty unique check names with Boolean outcomes, a positive explicit matrix execution count, and agreeing report/summary counts and status. Existing reports without an explicit response hash retain the prior helper's transitive complete-code/change binding. If a persisted report does contain `model_response_sha256`, it must equal the current retained response hash; contradictory hashes and explicit null are rejected even after the report's file hash is recomputed. Missing, reused, unexecuted, incomplete or inconsistent proof produces no behavior score. A proof-projection exception also degrades to no score and cannot change the already-admitted product result. The bridge exposes only `score_eligible`, `score_basis`, `checks_run`, `checks_failed`, `verification_executions`, `verification_matrix_sha256`, `source_snapshot_sha256` and `admission_result`; the wrapper already provides the report, output-code, response and generated-change hashes. These are observation metadata, not a new workflow registry. Verifiers without the existing explicit matrix/execution-count shape remain unscored even if their callback returned a normal result. In particular, moving a `verification_summary` number into trace metadata alone is insufficient proof. `build_patch_live_scores` creates at most one native NUMERIC `local_check_pass_fraction`, with denominator equal to verified local checks. It binds the original normalized trace/observation IDs and uses a deterministic score ID. Zero is emitted only when an actually executed nonempty matrix failed all checks; unknown execution is never numeric zero. One means those local checks passed, not complete code correctness, model qualification, Mod delivery or Runtime. The body reuses the existing [`POST /api/public/scores` contract](https://langfuse.com/docs/evaluation/evaluation-methods/scores-via-sdk) and contains no source, prompts, replies, test-body content or paths. The opt-in sink retains one bounded queue and one HTTP worker. Each item carries its observation and optional score; their combined bytes count toward the existing payload cap. Only a fully accepted OTLP response is followed by the score POST. Partial/failed observation transport suppresses the score. Score HTTP failures are counted independently, do not reverse observation acceptance or alter the product result, and do not trigger a retry. Existing observation statistics retain their meaning; new counters are `score_queued`, `score_post_attempts`, `score_http_accepted`, `score_send_failures` and `score_skipped_unaccepted_observation`. Remote readback remains not performed; HTTP acceptance is not a delivery-proof claim. Original Cloud traces/scores were not changed and this mapper implementation was not sent to Cloud. ## Mapper/score focused verification Tests use local bound-file fixtures and intercepted HTTP. They are engineering checks, not real-model or real-Cloud score results. Current selections are `tests/unit/test_patch_live_langfuse.py` and the new `tests/unit/test_patch_live_verification_scores.py`. Using the existing Python 3.10.20 environment in the isolated worktree: - Native status regression: `python -B -m pytest tests/unit/test_patch_live_langfuse.py -k 'completed_verifier or transport_exception_remains or completed_root or generic_completed' -q --tb=short --basetemp="$env:TEMP\lf-diag-green"` — **9 passed, 1.09s**, after reproducing nine failures on the old mapper. - The score/proof/sink file initially ran 29 selections: 23 passed and six failed because the raw producer references lacked the historical reader's projection shape. After adapting that shape while preserving actual byte/hash validation, `python -B -m pytest tests/unit/test_patch_live_verification_scores.py --lf -q --tb=short --basetemp="$env:TEMP\lf-score-fix"` — **6 passed, 2.18s**. - Independent review's recomputed-report/different-reply counterexample first failed twice. The targeted fix plus explicit executed-zero/one examples: `python -B -m pytest tests/unit/test_patch_live_verification_scores.py -k 'rehashed_report or extreme_scores' -q --tb=short --basetemp="$env:TEMP\lf-score-reply-green"` — **4 passed, 1.94s**. - Actual production trace-wrapper composition, including a synthetic unexpected proof-reader exception: `python -B -m pytest tests/unit/test_patch_live_verification_scores.py -k 'real_verifier_trace' -q --tb=short --basetemp="$env:TEMP\lf-score-failopen"` — **2 passed, 1.98s**. These selections overlap and are not added as independent case totals. After reader and mapper implementation stopped changing, the combined command below passed **117 tests in 32.76s**, including CLI composition: ```powershell python -B -m pytest tests/unit/test_patch_langfuse_query.py tests/unit/test_patch_langfuse.py tests/unit/test_patch_live_langfuse.py tests/unit/test_patch_live_verification_scores.py tests/unit/test_patch_live_trace_cli.py -q --tb=short -n 2 --dist=loadfile -o cache_dir="$env:TEMP/lfdiag-cache" --basetemp="$env:TEMP/lfdiag-$PID" ``` The final reader also directly queried all four existing Cloud traces: 18/18/7/14 observations and 3/3/1/2 generations respectively; all returned no scores. Measured totals were 29,050 input and 609 output tokens, without double-counting the server-derived total. Results are in `cloud-query-four-final.json` under the same local evidence root. This is actual Cloud readback; the new score writer remains validated through intercepted HTTP until an authorized product run uses it. Main-repository venv Ruff `E9,F63,F7,F821` and `git diff --check` passed for the mapper/caller/tests; the ambient Python lacked Ruff, so no dependency was installed. Integration into `codex/rag-capability-mainline` at `4f6e696` preserved unrelated documentation WIP. The intersecting producer/reservation/Review selection `tests/unit/test_patch_live_verification_scores.py tests/unit/test_initial_repair_reservation.py tests/unit/test_product_proposal_context_budget.py` passed **41 tests in 4.68s** with the same Python, `-q --tb=short -n 2 --dist=loadfile`, short TEMP basetemp and cache. The Repair acceptance tree remains frozen separately at `a8b8971`. ## Verified single-process receipt compatibility The subsequently completed owned paging/snapshot runs exposed an exact format gap: `scripts.prepare_patch_sft_data.execute_version` retained real C# process stdout, exit code, compilation/source/assembly references and `execution_origin=actual_csharp_process`, but no top-level matrix `executions`. The outer verifier summary recorded one execution. The original strict helper therefore correctly emitted no score from those unadapted records. `_verified_matrix_executions` now derives one only for this existing exact single-process receipt shape. It requires canonical parsed stdout to equal the check rows, exit code/status/failed-name list/preservation result to agree, successful compilation, and valid retained hashes for compilation, both source files, compiler arguments, subject source and nonempty assembly bytes. Compiler arguments must bind the same source and assembly references in the format produced by that owner. Unknown receipt shapes, contradictory values, missing files or hash drift remain unscored. An explicit matrix `executions` field keeps the original path, including rejection of invalid/zero values; it is never replaced by an inferred count. No matrix field is written or synthesized, and the grader and its original expectations are unchanged. The new focused file first reproduced the valid-record rejection: one failed, 17 negative cases passed. The bounded adjacent checkpoint then ran: ```powershell python -B -m pytest tests/unit/test_langfuse_single_process_receipt.py tests/unit/test_patch_langfuse.py tests/unit/test_patch_live_verification_scores.py -q --tb=short -n 2 --dist=loadfile --basetemp="$env:TEMP\lf-single-green" ``` Result: **80 passed, 5.33s**. These are file/HTTP-fixture engineering checks; they do not execute a compiler, model, or Cloud write. No broader test suite was repeated for this bounded compatibility change. Read-only acceptance then used both newly completed actual journals, each verification's own retained report/matrix/response, and the unchanged v2 mapper. The paging trace `b707f8d386fe1284627765c3573cc205` produced a preview of 16 observations, two generations and one local-check score of 1.0. The snapshot trace `498784a38297d0b40c55d67d3b1e7f5e` produced 26 observations, four generations and separate scores 0.5 then 1.0. All three actual verification observations remain represented; the latest successful report does not replace the earlier failure. These fractions are local-check results, not Mod delivery or model qualification scores. The export copies add only the verified count/hash projection. Original observation IDs, parent IDs, types and UTC instants were compared to the native payload, and all read source files were rehashed after preparation. Original journals and reports remain unchanged. Outbound previews contain no source, prompt/reply body, local absolute path, GTFO content or credential field. Collection was `local_only` during execution; mapping occurred afterward and does not claim that a live Cloud export happened at capture time. The local preview root is `scratch/langfuse_cloud_diagnosis_20260909/actual-preview/`, with separate `otlp-preview.json`, `scores-preview.json`, `verification-provenance.json` and `preview-manifest.json` per case. `source-references.local.json` contains local audit locators and is explicitly excluded from any outbound payload. No preview was sent, no new model call was made and no verification was rerun during this acceptance. ## Provider request-gate diagnostics The observed pre-send context rejection previously left only an exception type in the first finished request span. `_recording_agent_client` now selects the exact observed gate classification and its four measured/configured integer fields before that span closes. It does not transmit exception text, body or arbitrary provider diagnostics, and it does not add a generation when transport never began. The original exception, budget debit and provider gate are unchanged. This applies prospectively; old `a8b8971` spans were not retroactively augmented. The original 13,710-byte proxy plus 4,096 output-budget rejection was reproduced offline: one reservation, one failed request span, zero sender calls and zero generations. The missing-diagnostic regression first failed; nine focused tests then passed (1.21s), followed by nine selected mapper/query checks (0.98s). The query also preserves raw Cloud `startTime` and `endTime` as `start_time` and `end_time`, enabling the actual UTC readback above without inventing timestamps. Final integration of that producer change and the single-process score adapter: ```powershell python -B -m pytest tests/unit/test_patch_provider_gate_trace.py tests/unit/test_patch_live_verification_scores.py tests/unit/test_langfuse_single_process_receipt.py -q --tb=short -n 2 --dist=loadfile -o cache_dir="$env:TEMP/lf-final-cache" --basetemp="$env:TEMP/lf-final-$PID" ``` **60 passed, 4.98s**, existing main Python 3.10.20. These overlap the earlier engineering selections; they are not additional independent model tasks.

documents.title: Retrieval Validation Plan
documents.text: # Retrieval Validation Plan ## 1. Objective Determine which retrieval mechanisms materially improve the Evidence-Grounded Controlled Code Generation Agent Platform over a live-workspace `rg` baseline, without increasing unsafe edit decisions, stale evidence use, latency, or cost beyond agreed budgets. Every track freezes its cases and decision rules before first result collection. The QualityGatePolicy requirements below apply to formal benchmark/promotion runs; the directional pilot uses raw local counts and no promotion gate. Thresholds may be changed before the first formal benchmark run, but not after inspecting results without recording a new experiment version. Benchmark thresholds are a versioned `QualityGatePolicy`, not caller-supplied free-form flags. The policy must exactly cover its declared metrics, cover the required retrieval metrics, use finite non-zero retrieval thresholds, and be bound into the evaluation protocol identity. The transition Gate independently recomputes the result from policy plus metrics. ## 1.1 Two Validation Tracks This document separates two different activities that must not be promoted into each other by implication: | Track | Purpose | Active status | | --- | --- | --- | | `V2-RET-DIRECTIONAL-001` | Time-boxed local evidence for the next product investment | Completed; bounded local decision retained rg plus live reads | | `V2-RET-001A/B/C` and H1-H5 | Promotion-grade or broader formal validation when a concrete product decision requires it | Conditional long-term roadmap | The directional track is not a smaller claim disguised as a formal benchmark. It records raw local evidence and supports only a bounded next-step decision. The formal track remains available, but its Arms A-G, downstream contracts, mutation matrix, and promotion rules are not consecutive V2 blockers. The completed evaluator-contract, formal-attestation smoke v5, and directional raw results are reusable assets. Do not generalize them further unless a later bounded experiment cannot preserve truthful raw results without a specific repair. ## 1.2 Completed One-Day Directional Pilot ### Decision question For the recorded repository revision and frozen directional cases, choose one: 1. retain `rg` plus live file reads as the default; 2. invest next in the current SymbolIndexer/structural-navigation path; 3. invest next in a minimal authentic community/history BM25 path; 4. record insufficient evidence and retain `rg` without expanding retrieval infrastructure. ### Directional arms | Arm | Bounded behavior | Claim boundary | | --- | --- | --- | | A | `rg` plus live file reads | Local baseline only | | B | Arm A plus the current SymbolIndexer and live result revalidation | Measures the current implementation, not a complete AST/LSP/call-graph system | | D | Small authentic community/history BM25 fixture plus current-source verification | Measures real traceable hints; a synthetic-only fixture is `plumbing_only` | Do not run code-BM25-only, Dense, RRF, rerank, or Agentic routing in this pilot.
