missing caption is allowed; screenshot alone cannot verify acceptance Acceptance criteria: screenshot file metadata is separated from caption and verification status Failure behavior: low or missing visual evidence remains inconclusive Out of scope: real screenshot capture and vision caption generation Dependencies: Q-012 Conflict checks: image evidence must not claim runtime success by itself Completed evidence: - src/mod_agent/runtime/screenshots.py defines ScreenshotMetadata, ScreenshotRegistryError, build_screenshot_metadata, build_screenshot_registry_payload, and screenshot_registry_to_runtime_item. - src/mod_agent/artifacts/registry.py registers screenshot_registry as a runtime_evidence-stage artifact consumed by evaluate, repair_plan, and dashboard. - screenshot_registry payloads separate file metadata, caption fields, verification_status, acceptance_status, and claims_real_runtime_success. - screenshot_registry_to_runtime_item strips supports_acceptance and confidence so a screenshot cannot upgrade runtime_evidence acceptance. - tests/unit/test_runtime_screenshots.py verifies missing captions, captioned visual evidence, ArtifactStore writes, required fields, and non-acceptance conversion. - tests/unit/test_artifact_contract.py verifies the screenshot_registry artifact contract. - focused Q-018 tests passed: 25 passed. - affected controlled-agent suite passed: 111 passed, 4 skipped. - broader test command including tests/unit/test_planning.py failed during collection on an existing planning/workflow circular import, before Q-018 tests ran. ``` ### Q-019: Agent Decision Quality Evaluation Contract ```text Status: completed Module: EVAL, WF, REVIEW Spec refs: 18.3, 41.5, 49.6, 50.7 Coverage IDs: EVAL-002, EVAL-003, EVAL-004, MISS-011 Goal: Define evaluation contracts for route accuracy, evidence sufficiency, review correctness, and baseline comparison. Each R task must be closed through the normal small-loop gate: code/test inspection, implementation, focused tests, affected tests when shared contracts change, diff audit, control-doc update, git decision, stop. - P0/P1 findings must not be hidden by broad "next phase" progress. - Q-020 and later feature work remain queued but are blocked behind the active P0/P1 repair queue. ``` ### R-001: Graph Domain Policy Wiring ```text Status: completed Module: WF, REVIEW, DOM Spec refs: 9.5, 11, 49.3.4, 50.8 Source finding: P0-002 Goal: Ensure graph-level review_proposal supplies DomainReviewPolicy to ProposalReviewer when the workflow has a domain/game profile. Inputs: workflow state, domain adapter route/profile, patch_proposal, evidence_pack Files to modify: src/mod_agent/workflow/graph.py, src/mod_agent/proposal/reviewer.py if needed, tests/unit/* Artifacts produced: proposal_review JSON in tests Trace events: review.proposal_checked or existing review trace event Tests: graph review blocks unsupported/high-risk domain proposals when domain policy is required Acceptance criteria: domain policy cannot be bypassed by entering review through the graph Failure behavior: missing required domain policy blocks the proposal with a clear blocker Out of scope: adding new game profiles Dependencies: Q-017 Conflict checks: GTFO-specific rules must remain inside domain adapter/policy, not generic graph code Completed evidence: - build_graph now creates a default domain adapter registry when no registry is supplied and passes a resolved DomainReviewPolicy into review_proposal. - _run_review_proposal passes domain_policy to ProposalReviewer without embedding GTFO-specific rules in graph code. - Unknown registered domain review uses UnsupportedDomainAdapter policy, so high-risk runtime changes block with domain_profile findings. - Default graph construction now blocks unsupported-domain high-risk runtime proposals before dry-run. - tests/unit/test_workflow_graph.py adds test_default_graph_uses_domain_policy_for_unsupported_domain. - focused R-001 tests passed: 16 passed. - affected workflow/review/repair/checkpoint tests passed: 20 passed. ``` ### R-002: Evidence Pack Required For Evidence-Bound Review ```text Status: completed Module: REVIEW, ART Spec refs: 6, 11, 49.3.4 Source finding: P0-003 Goal: Make ProposalReviewer block evidence-bound proposals when evidence_pack is missing or stale instead of silently weakening validation. Inputs: patch_proposal, evidence_pack, artifact refs Files to modify: src/mod_agent/proposal/reviewer.py, tests/unit/test_proposal_review.py or graph tests Artifacts produced: proposal_review JSON in tests Trace events: review.evidence_binding_failed optional Tests: direct reviewer API blocks missing evidence_pack for proposals with evidence_refs Acceptance criteria: every evidence_ref is checked against a real evidence_pack or the review blocks Failure behavior: proposal_review status is blocked with exact missing-evidence reason Out of scope: changing retrieval ranking Dependencies: R-001 optional; can run independently for direct reviewer API Conflict checks: repair proposals still validate against repair_plan evidence when that is the approved evidence source Completed evidence: - ProposalReviewer blocks evidence-bound proposals when neither evidence_pack nor repair_plan provides evidence ids. - Evidence refs that cannot be matched to the approved evidence source block with evidence_binding findings. - repair_plan remains an approved evidence source for repair proposals. - tests/unit/test_proposal_review.py adds test_reviewer_blocks_evidence_bound_proposal_without_evidence_pack. - tests/unit/test_repair_loop.py verifies repair proposal review can pass without evidence_pack when repair_plan evidence refs match. - focused R-002 tests passed: 13 passed. - affected workflow/domain/checkpoint tests passed: 24 passed. ``` ### R-003: Separate Evidence Source From Edit Target ```text Status: completed Module: PLAN, PROP, REVIEW Spec refs: 9, 10, 49.3 Source finding: P0-004 Goal: Split evidence_source_path from edit_target_path so implementation_plan cannot use a retrieval source as a write target by default. documents.text: # Architecture Overview Status: current architecture orientation This document explains the active product shape, the verified implementation boundary, and the rules that prevent architectural drift. It does not replace `docs/ACTIVE_PRODUCT_CONTRACT.md`, `DEV_SPEC.md`, or the artifact contracts. ## 1. Product Boundary This repository is an evidence-grounded controlled code-generation Agent platform. Its first verified domain is local GTFO / BepInEx Mod development. ProposalCritic Local/Injected Assessment Boundary The ProposalCritic local/injected assessment boundary reviews a main-role judgment without becoming a second controller. For the patch path, it reads the registered `patch_proposal` and its bound upstream context, then emits a structured `critic_assessment` containing: - the exact subject artifact ref and hash; - dimension scores and total score; - a pass, revise, block, or unresolved verdict; - structured findings and limitations; - an explicit read-only/no-route-authority boundary. The deterministic review layer fuses this assessment with existing hard rules. A passing ProposalCritic assessment cannot override missing evidence, an invalid binding, a forbidden path, missing permission, or a required human approval. A failing or unresolved ProposalCritic assessment cannot approve a write. LangGraph conditional edges make the final continue/repair/blocked transition. The implemented boundary supports the local deterministic scorer or an injected scorer. Calling a separate external model is a later adapter choice and requires the same per-run disclosure and secret-handling rules as other model calls. Until a real external Critic run is preserved, the project must not claim that external-model ProposalCritic review has been validated. This is a specialist provider hosted by the existing `review_proposal` node. Its result is saved as a separate `critic_assessment` Artifact, but it does not add a second routing system or an always-on model call. A separate LangGraph node is justified only if a real use case later requires independent retry, timeout, or latency routing. Current maturity: `implemented` for ProposalReviewer hard-rule review plus one optional ProposalCritic local/injected assessment inside `review_proposal`. The following two-level review design is `documented_only`: 1. each Worker performs a lightweight structured self-check before returning; 2. same-level Worker outputs are deterministically fused; 3. a second-level ProposalCritic receives the fused judgment and complete evidence chain in a separate clean context; 4. the second level performs adversarial review but still has no write, approval, or LangGraph route authority. The current implementation does not provide a universal Worker self-check contract, parallel Worker scoring, a fusion result, a separate clean-context second-level Critic, or two-level-review execution evidence. `conditional_trigger`: a selected real task must show that the implemented ProposalReviewer plus single ProposalCritic boundary misses a material conflict because evidence is split across specialist contexts, or that context isolation/retry/timeout requires a separate review node. One trigger does not authorize a general multi-agent review platform. ### 4.1 Requirement States And Routes There is no inferred risk trigger. The graph caller must set the requirement explicitly. | State | Meaning | Deterministic route | | --- | --- | --- | | `not_required` | `critic_requirement="not_required"`; ProposalCritic is not called and no `critic_assessment` is written | Apply existing ProposalReviewer hard rules; approval continues to dry-run, revision enters repair, other blockers enter blocked | | `required_succeeded` | `critic_requirement="required"`; the provider returned a structurally valid, current-hash-bound assessment | Pass verdict plus score at least 80 continues through hard rules; revise/low score enters repair; block verdict enters blocked | | `required_failed` | Required provider is absent, raises, returns unresolved, stale, malformed, wrong-policy, or wrong-hash output | Fail closed to blocked; no dry-run and no implicit retry | Supplying a provider while the requirement is `not_required` is a configuration error. This prevents an injected scorer from silently becoming an execution trigger. ### 4.2 Score Aggregation Policy Policy version: `proposal_critic_local_injected_v1`. Applicability: `patch_proposal_review_only`. It does not score retrieval, runtime acceptance, final task success, or cross-project quality. Aggregation is `equal_weight_rounded_mean`: evidence grounding, scope discipline, verification quality, and reversibility each contribute 25 percent; the rounded arithmetic mean must be at least 80. Passing also requires verdict `pass`, no blocking ProposalCritic finding, an exact current `patch_proposal` hash, and a valid read-only authority declaration. Priority is fixed: 1. ProposalReviewer hard blockers, permissions, binding rules, and human approval cannot be overridden by any score. 2. Required ProposalCritic execution/binding/schema failure blocks the path. 3. A valid block verdict blocks; revise or a score below 80 enters repair. 4. Only a valid pass at or above 80 may continue to the remaining hard rules. The score is a local structural policy, not evidence that semantic correctness, runtime behavior, or product quality improved. ### 4.3 Business Decision And Action Translation Current maturity: `implemented` for the existing deterministic Mod-delivery actions. ProposalReviewer and LangGraph currently translate review facts into the exact decisions and routes already represented by the workflow, including: - `approve_dry_run` to no-write dry-run; - `revise_proposal` to the bounded repair path; - `blocked_insufficient_evidence`, `blocked_scope_risk`, and `blocked_requires_human` to blocked handling; - exact-diff approval before isolated apply; - task-specific runtime/evaluation applicability through the acceptance boundary. The fraud-domain four-tier action model (low risk direct release, medium risk step-up verification, high risk rejection, and grey-zone manual handling) is `documented_only` as a business-architecture reference. This repository does not implement a generic configurable risk engine, merchant/amount tiers, business-loss thresholds, or outcome-driven threshold tuning. ProposalCritic's 80-point patch-review policy is not a general business-risk score. `conditional_trigger`: a selected product request must require an action that the existing review/repair/blocked/runtime/evaluation routes cannot express, and the required action must be derived from that request's real acceptance or safety boundary. Implement the smallest deterministic action rule; do not add a generic risk platform merely to mirror the reference model. ### 4.4 Long-Term Experience And Closed-Loop Improvement Artifact history, checkpoint state, and chat history are not automatically trusted long-term memory. Closed-loop improvement must preserve the distinction between an observed run, a reusable lesson, and an approved control rule. ```mermaid flowchart LR R["Run artifacts and bound outcomes"] --> O["Post-run observation"] O --> Q["Quarantined lesson"] Q --> V{"Outcome verified and provenance complete?"} V -->|No| H["History only / unresolved"] V -->|Yes| L["Reusable planning hint"] L --> N["Next request retrieval"] N --> C["Current source/API/runtime revalidation"] C --> D["Current Workflow decision"] D --> R L -. "never automatic" .-> P["Human-approved policy or document change"] ``` A reusable lesson must bind at least the original request, relevant source and Artifact hashes, environment/version context, observed failure, action taken, verification result, limitations, and invalidation conditions. It may help the next run choose evidence queries, identify risks, preserve non-goals, or propose tests. It may not authorize a path, Hook, patch, permission, runtime claim, or delivery decision. Current source, current API shape, current Binding Registry, current runtime evidence, and explicit user approval always outrank stored experience. A lesson whose source/version/environment assumptions no longer match is stale and must be rejected or revalidated. The system must not silently rewrite prompts, scoring thresholds, `AGENTS.md`, SPEC documents, permissions, or routing policy from one outcome. A durable control-rule change requires explicit human review and a normal code/document change with tests or recorded rationale. This is governed learning, not self-modifying behavior. The current repository has Artifact lineage and planning placeholders for retrieved experience, but it does not yet implement verified lesson extraction, experience retrieval, automatic feedback ingestion, or policy learning. Those capabilities should begin only after repeated real tasks show that manually recorded lessons are useful and the required provenance can be captured without building a separate memory platform. Current maturity is split deliberately: - `implemented`: immutable run artifacts and hashes, checkpoint/runtime state at their existing boundaries, Git history, and `LOOP_HISTORY` as audit records. These are stored evidence, not learned memory. - `documented_only`: verified-lesson quarantine, next-request experience retrieval, asynchronous real-outcome feedback ingestion, automatic risk profile updates, Recall/Precision feedback, threshold learning, and policy learning. - `conditional_trigger`: repeated verified real tasks must expose the same recurrence or retrieval failure, the outcomes must be provenance-bound, and manual lessons must be demonstrably insufficient. The first triggered task is a bounded lesson-capture/retrieval experiment, not an automatic policy updater. ## 5. Architecture Maturity | Area | Current status | Allowed claim | | --- | --- | --- | | Local request entry | Verified for one BetterHitFeedback request-to-real-runtime slice | Local synchronous entry works for the preserved run through approved isolated apply, build, and separately controlled runtime verification | | LangGraph StateGraph and conditional routing | Tested | One controlled graph owns the implemented route matrix | | Structured Evidence Agent turns | Qwen Chat and OpenAI Responses request/response mappings locally tested | Provider-neutral tool/final/usage semantics work inside the Evidence specialist; no real-provider semantic-quality claim | | Artifact lineage and hash binding | Tested on focused paths | Registered outputs retain current upstream refs and hashes | | Regenerable engineering cognition | Tested read-only projection over current repository facts | Bounded orientation and explicit unknown/stale reporting only; no durable state, product evidence, route, or authority claim | | Product Dependency/API Evidence | Partial: live target C# retrieval plus separate bounded metadata/IL and direct Boolean member-access paths | No general API documentation, usage, lifecycle, behavior-dataflow, or cross-Mod correctness claim | | Patch review, no-write dry-run, and exact approval | Verified on the narrow real run plus focused tests | Model output cannot directly authorize a write | | ProposalCritic local/injected assessment boundary | Tested for explicit not-required, required-success, and required-failure paths | No external-model or semantic-quality-improvement claim | | Two-level Critic and same-level specialist fan-out | `documented_only`; `conditional_trigger` not satisfied | No Worker self-check, parallel specialist execution, deterministic fusion, clean-context second-level Critic, or two-level-review claim | | Business decision/action translation | Existing Mod workflow routes `implemented`; generic four-tier risk model `documented_only` | No generic business-risk engine, configurable domain thresholds, or automatic action tuning claim | | Real build | Verified for the preserved BetterHitFeedback run | The declared DLL compiled for that run | | Gameplay/runtime acceptance | Verified for the selected BetterHitFeedback `General.Enabled` slice plus one bounded accepted startup-marker slice and one bounded single-missing-marker negative slice in one real GTFO environment | Disabled startup and enabled gameplay behavior are observed for the Phase 2B DLL; `e7daa266` proves accepted automated deployment and terminal closure; `95efb988` proves multi-generation observation retention and observation-owned blocked closure when only the designated marker is absent. No cross-environment, long-duration, every-route, second-profile, automatic retry/recovery, or production-mature Harness claim | | Bounded Build-stage cross-process continuation | `implemented` and real-exercised | One pre-side-effect local checkpoint resumed into the existing Runtime/Eval/Terminal graph without upstream repetition; no general persistent graph backend, arbitrary-node resume, post-side-effect recovery, or concurrent exactly-once claim | | MCP/API/webhook/scheduler trigger surfaces | Partial or future-triggered | They are not the current production entry | | Long-term experience and closed-loop learning | Audit storage `implemented`; learning design `documented_only`; `conditional_trigger` not satisfied | Artifact history is not automatic memory, feedback learning, or policy tuning | | ReAct/Agentic routing | Deferred | No active architecture migration | ## 6. Change Triggers And Stop Rules Do not add graph nodes, schemas, model roles, retrieval infrastructure, dashboards, MCP write routes, or evaluation machinery merely to make the architecture look complete. An architectural change requires at least one of: - a concrete real request cannot complete through the current chain; - an observed failure cannot be represented or routed truthfully; - a demonstrated safety or claim defect requires a new gate; - a selected external user/client requires a missing interface; - a bounded product decision requires new evidence. After the smallest verified fix or capability succeeds, stop architecture work and return to the product request. Workflow maturity is supporting evidence, not an independent delivery goal. ## 7. Portfolio And Engineering Story The project demonstrates engineering and design ability through the combination of a runnable vertical workflow and explicit control boundaries: - LangGraph state-machine orchestration and deterministic conditional routing; - evidence provenance, binding identity, hashes, and stale-data checks; - bounded model authority and read-only ProposalCritic assessment; - human approval, isolated mutation, rollback, and reproducible build evidence; - domain adapters separating GTFO behavior from generic platform control; - truthful separation of tested, compiled, runtime-observed, and accepted claims; - failure-triggered evolution instead of roadmap-driven infrastructure growth. The strongest next breadth proof is another concrete Mod capability or delivery shape that exercises the existing control plane and exposes a real missing capability. ## 8. Authority Reference This document does not define an authority or reading order. Follow the current user request and the applicable working agreements in `AGENTS.md`. 为什么要有它：旧 section 2 已不再定义权限顺序，架构说明不能产生另一套任务授权。

documents.title: 控制面收敛设计
documents.text: # 控制面收敛设计 文件名：`CONTROL_PLANE_CONSOLIDATION_DESIGN.md` 状态：`proposed_normative_design` 范围：仅限控制面架构收敛 审查基线：`af178e7eb8125aa3992dcb114014214587733e08` 实施授权：`false` Artifact 迁移授权：`false` 产品源码、Build、Runtime、进程启动、游戏目录写入授权：`false` ## 1. 文档目的 本文档把已经确认的架构原则转化为一份有限、可审核、可测试的控制面收敛设计。 本文档明确规定： - capability ownership； - schema evolution ownership； - Approval Identity； - hash 与 projection 分层； - Artifact lineage 的权威位置； - Receipt 语义； - public entry 与 Execution Contract； - driver 权限和降级方案； - 影子控制面的迁移与删除顺序； - 审核粒度分类； - 必须通过的测试门和完成条件。 本文档的中心问题不是“审核是否太严格”，而是： > 平台没有稳定定义“人批准的 action 是什么”，因此执行细节、机器证据、运行观察和展示信息被混入同一个证明对象，形成过度耦合的证明体系。 当前错误关系近似为： ```text Approval Identity = Action Identity + Execution Detail + Machine Evidence + Runtime Observation + Presentation ``` 结果是： ```text stdout、Store 数量或路径显示变化 → projection 变化 → hash 变化 → Approval 被视为失效 → 重新审核 ``` 本文档不降低证据质量、权限精度或 fail-closed 要求。它只规定哪些事实由谁拥有、 在哪一层产生、是否影响批准身份，以及怎样通过唯一公共控制面执行。 ### 1.1 使用方式：同一文档、一个工作包、四个阶段 本文件同时作为架构规范和控制面收敛期间的共享修复文档。推进页与审核页围绕同一个 工作包更新本文件中对应章节的“实施合同表”，不再为同一问题建立平行设计文档。 每个工作包采用一次完整循环： ```text 一次设计 → 一次审核 → 一次实施 → 一次验收 ``` 1. 设计：推进页从实际代码中识别当前 semantic authority，自行选择目标实现，填写实施合同。 2. 审核：审核页检查隐藏 owner、合同扩张、兼容性和严重边界，避免接管正常实现设计。 3. 实施：合同边界确认后，推进页像开发者完成明确作业一样自行规划、编码、测试和自我修正。 4. 验收：审核页依据最终 diff、测试和 authority 转移事实判断工作包是否完成。 实施合同服务于集中确定公共决策，不记录 private helper 命名、局部 class 组织、fixture 命名、 格式化等普通开发选择。推进页可以在已确认的 semantic boundary 内自主调整这些实现细节。 只有影响 authority、公共 schema/API、Approval Identity、hash、lineage、side effect、 failure/retry/checkpoint 或历史兼容性的选择进入 `unresolved_contract_decisions`。该字段闭合后， 推进页即可实施，无需把每个内部步骤变成新的审批对象。 各章节表格中的方括号是待填写位置，不是可以原样保留的示例。工作包进入审核时，推进页将 “推进页决策”列替换为从实际代码得出的明确结论；如果公共合同仍有选择未定，就把它集中写入 `unresolved_contract_decisions`，而不是用模糊措辞隐藏。审核结论通过后，推进页继续完成实现与 验收回填，并在发现偏差时先自查语义边界、主动修正本表。 ## 2. 已知结构问题 ### 2.1 没有统一 capability 声明 当前 capability 支持状态分散在： - `build_graph()`； - `local_entry`； - materializer dispatch； - `ArtifactTypeRegistry`； - run-local driver； - focused tests。 这会产生同一个 continuation 在不同组件中被不同解释的情况。 已确认的实际表现包括： - Graph 与 Stagger authority materializer 已能识别 bounded observation projection； - `preflight_stagger_edit_authority_review()` 仍维护另一套 schema allowlist； - verification-only continuation 补齐了 Graph 路径，但没有同步形成稳定的公共 Build 入口； - 公共 Runtime continuation 仍要求自定义 verification-only Build 没有生成的 `run_manifest.json`。 平台目前无法从一个权威位置回答： > 哪个精确 capability 已存在、什么请求可以进入、由哪个 Graph route 执行、允许什么副作用、产生什么结果合同？ ### 2.2 Approval 没有与 observation 分离 部分 run-local projection 把以下信息与 action identity 一起计算或一起强制： - Store 总文件数和总字节数； - stdout 字节和换行； - Git status 展示； - run root 是否存在； - 时间戳和耗时； - physical locator 或路径展示； - 执行后才会产生的 Artifact 统计。 这些信息可能有审计价值，但它们回答的是“环境或执行发生了什么”，不是“人批准了什么”。 ### 2.3 Receipt 没有足够权威的统一语义 当前 `ArtifactStore.write()` 返回 `ArtifactRef`。 ArtifactStore 已经拥有： - immutable revision； - latest alias； - pending marker； - freshness； - `upstream_refs`； - revision 写入与 latest replacement。 但调用方无法只凭返回的 `ArtifactRef` 无歧义表达完整终态，因此 driver 又自行解释： - immutable revision path 与 latest alias path； - revision delta； - pending 或 partial latest failure； - 写入是否成功； - 是否可以 retry/replay/recover。 这已经造成“Store 实际写入成功，但 driver 的 post-write validator 报失败”的 false negative。 ### 2.4 外围控制层失控并形成双控制面 合理的 feature driver 可以准备参数、调用公共 API 和展示结果。 当前部分 run-local driver 则自行： - 判断 authority； - 判断 schema/capability 是否支持； - 选择 Graph 调用路径； - 直接写 ArtifactStore； - 判断 freshness； - 定义 retry/replay/recovery； - 解释 Store commit； - 产生独立 terminal verdict。 这形成两个控制面： ```text 主控制面： Public Entry → StateGraph → ArtifactStore 影子控制面： Run-local Driver → Custom Admission → Graph/Store → Custom Verdict ``` 当 Graph/Store 与 driver 都拥有最终解释权时，会出现： - Graph 成功、driver 判失败； - driver 通过、Graph lineage 不完整； - Store committed、post-write validator 判异常； - Graph 支持、public entry 不支持。 ### 2.5 Artifact lineage 被多处重复表达 Artifact durable lineage、Graph runtime state、checkpoint protocol refs、Approval exact inputs、Receipt produced refs 和 latest alias 具有不同职责。 如果它们都能独立定义 lineage，就会把： - 历史 identifier baseline； - current durable upstream； - checkpoint/resume protocol ref； - latest lookup； - driver 推断 错误合并为一条“正式 lineage”。 ## 3. 目标与非目标 ### 3.1 必须实现的目标 1. 建立一个由 public entry、Graph admission、materializer 和测试共同读取的 capability 声明来源。 2. 把 Approval Identity 固定为“人批准的 action 身份”。 3. 把 Approval hash 与 machine evidence、observation、presentation hash 分离。 4. 把正式 Artifact lineage 固定在 immutable Artifact envelope 的 `upstream_refs`。 5. 建立权威的 Store/public-executor structured result。 6. 把 Graph-before-side-effect、retry/replay、checkpoint、failure 和 restoration 收回公共执行层。 7. 把 feature driver 降级为无平台裁决权的 adapter。 8. 保留所有历史 immutable Artifact 和已执行 driver 的审计价值。 9. 使用增量迁移和真实集成测试，不进行推倒重写。 10. 用第二个真实产品切片验证公共控制面复用性。 ### 3.2 明确非目标 以下工作位于本设计的当前范围之外；出现实际需要时，应说明它解决的真实缺口、与现有合同的 关系以及新增成本，再决定是否进入后续工作包： - 重写整个 StateGraph； - 重写或删除历史 Artifact； - 创建第二个 Graph； - 创建 AuditController、ApprovalController、ValidationController 或 EvidenceController； - 创建一个需要再次被 Receipt 的总控 Receipt Artifact； - 把所有 feature 逻辑塞入 `graph.py`； - 降低 source、diff、Artifact、lineage 或副作用边界精度； - 认定所有 driver 都是错误； - 修改 Stagger 产品验收 Criterion； - 因为本文档存在而自动 Build、Runtime 或推进产品执行； - 在现有模型已能表达目标时额外引入 Artifact、Approval、Request 或 Graph 类型。 ## 4. 目标控制流与稳定公共契约 ### 4.1 唯一目标控制流 ```text Human Approval → Public Entry → Capability Admission → StateGraph → ArtifactStore → Structured Machine Result → Runtime / Product Observation → Presentation ``` Feature-specific 代码负责准备该流程需要的输入；公共路径能够表达其需求后，执行统一回到该流程。 ### 4.2 三个稳定公共契约 目标控制面只暴露三个稳定公共契约边界： 1. Approval Contract - 规范化 exact action identity； - 记录 human decision； - 不判断 Build/Runtime 成功； - 不产生产品验收结论。 2. Execution Contract - 接收已批准 action 与 current exact inputs； - 执行 capability admission； - 强制 Execution Invariants； - 不扩大 Approval scope。 3. Store/Result Contract - 持久化 durable outputs； - 返回权威 machine result； - 不决定 action 是否获得授权； - 不把 Store 成功提升为产品成功。 这三个契约是调用边界，不是三个新 Controller，也不是三个状态机。 跨契约协作遵循以下职责边界： - Approval 不判断 Build/Runtime 是否成功； - Execution 不重新定义 approved target、diff 或 side effects； - Store/Result 不决定 action 是否获得授权； - Observation 不批准新的 action； - Presentation 不决定任何 terminal state。 每个 public entry 以一份由公共契约拥有的 structured result 结束。driver 负责展示该结果； 终态解释继续由公共契约负责。 ## 5. 五层语义模型 信息按以下方向流动；低层信息不反向改变高层语义： ```text Layer 1 — Approval Identity ↓ Layer 2 — Execution Contract / Invariants ↓ Layer 3 — Machine Evidence Receipt ↓ Layer 4 — Runtime / Product Observation ↓ Layer 5 — Presentation ``` ### 5.1 Layer 1 — Approval Identity 回答： > 人批准的具体 action 是什么？当前是否仍是同一个 approved action？ 只有本层进入 human approval identity hash。 本层必须表达： - capability identity 与 contract version； - feature identity； - exact input Artifact refs； - 适用的 freshness policy； - durable lineage roots； - source-before identity 或 exact diff identity； - target 与 Binding identity； - allowed actions； - forbidden actions； - side-effect boundary； - attempt budget 与 stop conditions。 本层排除： - Store 总文件数和字节数； - stdout/stderr 格式； - 非 expiry 语义的时间戳和耗时； - Git status 展示； - run root 当前是否存在； - pending 的展示文本； - latest alias physical path； - locator 长度； - CRLF/LF； - 执行后才产生的机器结果； - Runtime 或人工观察。 executor 代码变化只有在改变 capability contract、允许副作用、执行顺序或失败语义时， 才要求升级 capability contract version 并重新获得 Approval。具体执行代码身份写入 Machine Evidence Receipt。 ### 5.2 Layer 2 — Execution Contract / Invariants 回答： > 执行器必须如何执行？本次执行是否违反规则？ 本层不进入 Approval Identity hash，由 public executor 和 StateGraph 强制。 本层必须覆盖： - capability admission 先于受控副作用； - 首次副作用前重新核对 exact approved inputs； - Graph admission 先于 Build、Runtime、process launch 或该 route 拥有的 durable write； - attempt budget； - one-shot； - retry/replay/recovery policy； - checkpoint/resume exact binding； - allowed output Artifact types； - unexpected mutation forbidden； - failure stage/classification； - no implicit permission expansion； - no hidden upstream replay； - process termination 与 restoration； - pending Store admission policy。 违反本层规则表示执行失败或阻断，不表示 approved action 自动变化，也不授权替代 action。 ### 5.3 Layer 3 — Machine Evidence Receipt 回答： > 平台实际产生了哪些可由机器验证的事实？ 本层包括： - 使用的 Approval Identity； - 使用的 capability contract version； - 解释结果所需的具体 executor、source、toolchain 和 environment identity； - consumed Artifact refs； - produced Artifact refs； - Store write outcomes； - immutable revision 与 latest alias outcome； - 有语义价值的 revision delta； - Build command/result 和 DLL identity； - Runtime process identity 和 machine markers； - 实际发生的 side effects； - failure stage 与 failure class； - retry/replay count； - termination/restoration result。 现有领域 Artifact 继续承担其职责： - `BuildResult` 记录 Build 事实； - `WorkflowCheckpoint` 记录 resumable workflow state； - `ResumeReport` 记录 resume admission/consumption； - `RuntimeEvidence` 记录 Runtime machine facts 与绑定 observation； - evaluation/terminal Artifact 保留现有职责。 Store commit acknowledgement 以 API 级结果为默认表达。只有出现现有结果合同无法保存的 durable 语义时才评估 Artifact 形式，避免形成“Receipt 还需要 Receipt”的递归。 ### 5.4 Layer 4 — Runtime / Product Observation 回答： > 外部系统或产品实际表现如何？ 本层包括： - gameplay/external-system behavior； - screenshot/capture； - operator visual/audio report； - 与 exact run 绑定的用户反馈； - 依赖外部 stimulus 才有意义的 Runtime marker； - observation limitations 和未观察条件。 每项 observation 必须保存： - provenance； - stimulus； - exact run identity； - limitations； - 支持的 Criterion 或 claim。 Observation 不改变 Approval Identity。新 observation 应形成新的 evidence content 或 immutable revision，不得改写 approved action 或历史 evidence。 ### 5.5 Layer 5 — Presentation 回答： > 人怎样查看已有事实？ 本层包括： - CLI formatting； - stdout layout； - Markdown summary； - hash 缩写； - path/locator 展示； - CRLF/LF； - UI table/label。 Presentation 不得进入 Approval Identity，不得重新定义 Artifact，不得改变执行终态。 如果文本 marker 被程序解析，解析后的 structured fact 属于 Machine Evidence 或 Runtime Observation；其周围 stdout 排版仍属于 Presentation。 ### 5.6 禁止的层级污染 明确禁止： - Observation 改变 Approval Identity； - Presentation 改变 Evidence； - Evidence 重新定义 Approval； - Execution Result 扩大 side-effect permission； - Store totals 或 stdout 使相同 action 的 Approval 失效； - driver 把 Presentation 加入 control hash； - human summary 成为唯一 durable lineage； - Build success 被提升为 Runtime/Product success； - marker success 被提升为未观察的人类视觉/听觉结论。 ## 6. 10.2 Graph 中的正确位置 StateGraph 负责 runtime state 和 route。lineage 相关职责只有： ```text 接收 exact ArtifactRef → 验证 admission/freshness policy → 在 state 中传递 ref → Store.write 时传入 exact upstream_refs → 记录 produced ref ``` 批准后，Graph 不得通过重新查询无关 latest alias 偷换 approved exact input。 Graph conditional edge 决定执行 route，但不创造 durable lineage。 ### 10.3 checkpoint/resume 边界 `WorkflowCheckpoint` 和 `ResumeReport` 保存 continuation protocol 与恢复身份。 它们作为 Artifact 时拥有自己的 `upstream_refs`，也可以引用 resume 所需 Artifact。resume 后生成的产品 Artifact 仍按其真实输入建立独立 durable lineage。 ### 10.4 alias/locator 边界 - 完整 Artifact hash 是 logical identity； - immutable revision path 是 durable physical location； - latest alias 是 mutable lookup pointer； - shortened physical locator 不是 shortened logical identity； - revision path 与 alias path Artifact、Approval/Request、Graph、Controller 或 persistent capability service； - 改变历史 Artifact/Approval 的读取能力； - 测试发现原 semantic goal 无法由当前合同表达。 这些变化并非永久排除。推进页说明真实缺口、替代方案、兼容成本和回收方式后，可以形成更新 后的明确合同决定，再进入同一轮实施。 ### 16.5 同一文档中的状态与规范 各章节的空白实施合同表是两页共享工作区。推进页填写设计与实施结果，审核页填写复核结论， 不为同一工作包创建平行设计文档。 稳定的 schema/API/owner 决定在对应章节表中形成正式记录；当前 run hash、临时日志和完整命令 输出只在“实施与验收回填”中保存必要引用，避免把短期观察提升为长期架构规则。 run-local workaround 可以用于暴露公共缺口或完成已批准的有界实验；一旦它开始拥有 authority、 Store 终态、retry 或 public verdict，就应回到对应合同表，将语义迁回公共层。 ## 17. 完成条件 只有同时满足以下条件，才能声明控制面收敛完成： 1. capability support 由一份 declaration 供 public entry、Graph、materializer、tests 使用。 2. Approval Identity 只 hash approved action boundary。 3. Machine Evidence、Observation、Presentation 不能使相同 action 的 Approval 失效。 4. Artifact lineage 只有 immutable envelope 一个 durable owner。 5. Store/public executor 能权威区分 committed、blocked、partial outcome。 6. Graph 与 caller 不会产生冲突 terminal state。 7. Graph-before-side-effect、retry/replay、checkpoint、failure、restoration 由公共层强制。 8. feature driver 已降级为 parameter adapter 与 Presentation。 9. executed historical driver 与 immutable Artifact 保持可读。 10. 第二个真实产品切片复用同一控制面，未创建新的 feature-specific executor 或 authority subsystem。 当前完成判定还必须逐项关闭§15.10与§15.11登记的开放门。尤其，§11.5完成后只能关闭Edit Authority structured result adoption，不能把C6/C7或整个平台自动恢复为complete。 在完成全部条件前，状态必须保持 `partial`，不得宣称影子控制面已经删除或通用平台能力 已经完成。

documents.title: Non-authoritative Projection Responsibility Boundary
documents.text: # Non-authoritative Projection Responsibility Boundary Status: frozen architecture responsibility decision Baseline: `2af5e36e73343ff5088ef7c1cb813a5a700335d0` This decision governs future Coding Agent v0 lineage, diagnostic reconstruction, Failure Capsule, Langfuse, and UI work. It freezes responsibility before any shared projection interface is defined. It is not a second implementation queue and does not authorize a model call, probe, Actual, Repair, Apply, Build, Runtime, network export, or external disclosure. ## 1. Rejected whole-commit designs | Commit | Disposition | Reason | | --- | --- | --- | | `1275e87e0ec49a8bcd2dec1fe17c2432967b9da5` | `whole_commit_merge: rejected_at_2af5e36`; `original_cherry_pick: do_not_merge` | It recomputes cross-owner failure order, failure chains, claim impact, and execution-authority hints. | | `7a6c96f7da7a141381ca5c9df87adc5e0071c704` | `whole_commit_merge: rejected_at_2af5e36`; `original_cherry_pick: do_not_merge` | It wraps historical fixtures in hand-authored owner, boundary, conformance, queue, and fresh-Actual decisions. | The commits remain Git audit evidence. This rejection applies to their current projection and promotion semantics, not to every integrity primitive or test input. Selective migration is allowed only through current owner contracts and new code review. The current consumer count for their public namespaces and schemas at the baseline is zero. ## 2. Current fact and decision owners | Owner | Owns | Does not delegate to a projection | | --- | --- | --- | | Entry Admission | Entry gate results and its owner-local first-failure fields | Product execution, retry, or Apply decisions | | Actual execution | Packet/seal validation, receipt, identity consumption, and explicit run authorization | Model-role, Repair, or product-success claims | | ProductExecution | Platform status, execution disposition, failure stage, blockers, Store/effect records, and completion variant | Fresh-Actual admission or human approval | | ArtifactStore | Durable Artifact revisions, refs, hashes, inputs, blockers, and trace refs | Graph routing or semantic approval | | LangGraph StateGraph | Runtime state and conditional routing | Durable claim ownership | | Build/Runtime owners | Their bound Build or Runtime result and evidence limits | Broader delivery or stable-Agent claims | | Human decision boundary | Exact-diff approval and other explicit user decisions | Automatic inference from a trace, score, or projection | Owner-local ordering may be displayed as owner-local ordering. No projection may create a total order across owners unless an explicit owner-issued causal edge already records that relationship. ## 3. Projection responsibility A future projection may: - copy exact owner-issued fields with their source ref and hash; - validate ref, hash, schema, path boundary, duplicate identity, and explicit edge shape; - display owner-local sequences and explicit causal/reference edges; - report missing, conflicting, or unreadable facts as projection-integrity diagnostics; - redact sensitive content for a separately authorized sink. A future projection may not: - compute a cross-owner first failure or canonical failure order; - choose a winning status when owners conflict; - create a product claim or reinterpret a claim's evidence level; - decide readiness, retry, pause, resume, fresh-Actual status, Repair, Apply, or approval; - write to the current ArtifactStore or modify owner records; - become an input to Graph routing, Actual admission, Repair, Apply, or retry; - treat telemetry delivery success as product success. Missing or conflicting projection inputs may make only the projection incomplete. They cannot block or change the product execution that produced those inputs. ## 4. Dependency direction ```text owner contracts and immutable results | v non-authoritative projection | +-------+-------+ v v local query/report telemetry sink ``` The reverse dependency is forbidden. Graph, Actual, Apply, Repair, approval, and product-result owners must not import or consume the projection or telemetry implementation. Production code must not import historical test replay runners. The current-tree dependency guard is `tests/unit/test_non_authoritative_projection_boundary.py`. It dynamically scans the complete `src/mod_agent` tree, resolves absolute and relative imports, and rejects dependencies on the rejected projection/replay namespaces or Langfuse. It also confirms that the rejected whole-commit module paths are absent. This static guard does not prove behavior-level route invariance or prevent an arbitrary injected callback from carrying authority; those are mandatory tests for the next shared-interface checkpoint. Legitimate owner fields such as `first_failure_stage`, `failure_stage`, `platform_status`, and `execution_disposition` are not prohibited by string matching. ## 5. Selective reuse boundary The following ideas may be reimplemented after the shared interface is frozen: - exact hash/ref/path/schema checks; - missing-reference, hash-conflict, duplicate-relation, no-write, and redaction tests; - exact owner-issued Artifact refs, terminal refs, and trace events; - raw fixture hashes and owner-specific regression inputs; - fake exporter, fail-open export, redaction, and flush tests. The following must not migrate: - cross-owner `first_failure`, `failure_chain`, or `claim_impact` derivation; - replay promotion, `fresh_actual_status`, queue mutation, or authority effects; - inferred causal edges based on timestamps, filename similarity, or write order; - production dependencies on private loading helpers from another owner; - whole-commit cherry-picks of the rejected designs. ## 6. Activation and next gate No new projection interface or runtime observer is implemented by this decision. The next serial task is to freeze one minimal, non-authoritative fact and explicit edge interface that obeys this boundary. Its acceptance must add route/result/ Store invariance, conflict-no-adjudication, deterministic serialization, and capability-isolation tests rather than claiming that the static import guard proves those behaviors. Only after that interface checkpoint is accepted may Thin Lineage, owner test migration, Langfuse export, and read-only ProjectionRebuild proceed in parallel from the same HEAD. This decision does not permanently reject complete observability capabilities. It rejects only implementations that acquire product interpretation or execution authority outside the existing owners.

documents.title: RepoForge DEV_SPEC
documents.text: # RepoForge DEV_SPEC Authority and reading order are defined only by `AGENTS.md` section 2. This file remains the detailed root control-plane specification. Older phase tables, imported material, and historical addenda do not create active work unless the active contract and current queue select it. # 0.0A Validation-First Specification Authority This section is the highest-priority specification rule. It supersedes older roadmaps, imported blueprints, phase tables, and addenda when they prescribe a technology before the project has measured its effect. The product is an evidence-grounded controlled code-generation Agent platform. Its implementation order is determined by measurable delivery capability, not by the number of modules described in this file. Current normative progression: ```text stable controlled GTFO vertical slice -> agent decision-quality evaluation baseline -> retrieval ablation and freshness evaluation -> measured production retrieval decision -> dashboard/MCP projection of proven behavior ``` Normative supporting documents: - `docs/RETRIEVAL_ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md` records accepted retrieval boundaries, known gaps, source-specific architecture, and unproven claims. - `docs/RETRIEVAL_VALIDATION_PLAN.md` defines H1-H5, experimental arms, metrics, freshness tests, and promotion/stopping rules. - `EVIDENCE_RAG_MCP_SPEC.md` defines the Evidence Retrieval / Knowledge / MCP subsystem only inside this product boundary. - `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_QUEUE.md`, `docs/PROJECT_STATE.md`, and `docs/SPEC_COVERAGE_MATRIX.md` record executable work, current verified state, and implementation coverage. Technology promotion rules: 1. `rg` plus live file reads is the code-retrieval freshness baseline. 2. Symbol/AST/LSP/call-graph indexes are disposable navigation aids until their Hook-recall and stale-result behavior pass the registered evaluation. 3. BM25 is evaluated separately for persistent community/history sources and current code; success in one source class does not prove success in another. 4. Dense retrieval, RRF, reranking, multi-hop retrieval, and Agentic retries are experimental until the registered ablations demonstrate downstream benefit. 5. Retrieval relevance never grants patch authority. Current source/API/runtime verification, EvidencePack readiness, proposal review, permission, build, runtime, and eval gates retain authority. 6. Imported or legacy technical blueprints are reference material. They cannot add implementation work or override this section without a recorded decision backed by evaluation evidence. Specification restructuring rule: - Keep the normative product contract concise and executable. - Move imported, superseded, or generic material to `docs/references/` in a later mechanical extraction step without treating that move as a capability. - Preserve completed implementation evidence in state, matrix, queue history, and audit documents rather than repeating it throughout this specification. - Do not report an architectural mechanism as a project advantage until its registered metric and downstream effect have been measured. # 0.0 Capability-First Execution Override This override supersedes older wording in this document that says to implement "only the next incomplete phase" as a schema/audit slice. For this greenfield project, a phase means product capability progression: ```text request -> feature_spec -> evidence_pack -> implementation_plan -> patch_proposal -> proposal_review -> isolated fake dry_run_result -> structured build_result -> runtime/manual evidence -> workflow_summary ``` Audits, checkpoints, schemas, validators, and policy checks are implementation supports. They should unlock runnable capability, not become product phases by themselves. Implementation priority: 1. Keep the main loop runnable. 2. Wire existing adapters before adding new passive contracts. 3. Use fake/local/supplied-output runners as stepping stones toward real writes, real builds, and real runtime automation. 4. Label early artifacts by capability level so they can be upgraded without re-litigating scope. 5. Add focused tests around the runnable loop segment and then move to the next capability-bearing step. Implementation boundaries should be written as forward paths: what can run now, what evidence upgrades it, and what unlocks the next level. Avoid turning boundary work into a substitute for product progress. # 0.0B Current Product Direction Lock This project is a vertical controlled code generation platform, not a generic RAG Q&A application. Career-oriented progression lock: ```text The project is advanced for job-market competitiveness, not for checklist completion. Each V2/V3 task should build visible evidence of production-grade Agent platform engineering: workflow control, evidence-grounded code generation, tool safety, observability, evaluation, retrieval quality, artifact lineage, runtime feedback, and external tool/data integration. Prefer tasks that create interview-visible engineering depth: - one runnable vertical slice over several isolated schemas; - measured eval and trace evidence over broad claims; - safe MCP/API/dashboard surfaces over private-only scripts; - production constraints such as approval, rollback, idempotency, recovery, budgets, and failure routing over happy-path demos; - industry-relevant concepts such as LangGraph-style durable agent workflow, MCP tool integration, OpenTelemetry-style observability, retrieval eval, and controlled write/runtime approval. Do not prioritize work merely because it is easier to document. A task should be selected when it improves the project's ability to demonstrate real enterprise engineering judgment, systems design depth, and practical AI-agent delivery experience during interviews. ``` Evidence RAG and MCP subsystem detail lives in `EVIDENCE_RAG_MCP_SPEC.md`. ```text DEV_SPEC.md is the parent control-plane specification. EVIDENCE_RAG_MCP_SPEC.md is the Evidence RAG / MCP subsystem specification. RAG/MCP implementation must support the same LangGraph artifact loop, evidence-before-edit rule, review gates, runtime gates, evaluation, dashboard, and job-oriented engineering intent defined here. ``` All non-RAG core modules must be upgraded toward the same engineering depth as the imported RAG spec. In practice, LangGraph workflow, artifact contract, planning, proposal, review, dry-run, build, runtime evidence, repair, memory, evaluation, dashboard, MCP/API/CLI, and demo packaging should each define goals, named strategies, inputs/outputs, schemas, state transitions, failure handling, implementation classes, observability, tests, acceptance criteria, implementation boundaries, phase breakdown, and ADR/trade-off notes. Implementation rule: 1. Preserve useful implemented retrieval components and legacy design material, but promote only the parts justified by current requirements and evaluation. 2. Integrate accepted behavior under the current controlled-agent knowledge and evidence modules; read source before naming an implementation path. 3. Make LangGraph controlled code generation the top-level product loop. 4. Raise non-RAG specs and code to RAG-level rigor instead of simplifying RAG. 5. Keep old RAG product naming and QA-first workflows subordinate to the current vertical code generator goal. # 0.0C Skill, Spec, State, And Artifact Roles Reusable procedures belong in Skills. Product facts, interface contracts, current branch state, queue status, test evidence, and artifact payloads remain outside Skills. Current roles: 1. `.agents/skills/auto-coder/SKILL.md` is frozen as `SKILL.md.frozen`. It is retained for historical review and is not an active development authority. 2. `.agents/skills/mod-delivery-playbook/SKILL.md` is the user-facing mod delivery process Skill. It runs the delivery chain from planning input to handoff summary while linking back to source code, artifacts, tests, and current state documents for facts. 3. `DEV_SPEC.md` remains the product and architecture source of truth. 4. `docs/PROJECT_STATE.md`, `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_QUEUE.md`, and `docs/SPEC_COVERAGE_MATRIX.md` remain the current state, work queue, and coverage ledgers. 5. Artifact files and test output remain the source of delivery evidence. The first proven delivery chain is E2E-001: ```text planning input -> feature_spec -> evidence_pack -> implementation_plan -> patch_proposal -> proposal_review -> dry_run_result -> build_result -> runtime_evidence -> eval_report -> workflow_summary ``` Current E2E-001 proof level: 1. Current-branch evidence exists in `tests/unit/test_mod_delivery_e2e.py` in the E2E-001 checkpoint. 2. The test uses a controlled temporary BetterHitFeedback source file and deterministic symbol evidence. 3. The build path verifies an expected local artifact through `BuildAdapter` using the controlled test build factory/runner, then provides a path toward a real C# toolchain build and game-loadable artifact proof. 4. The runtime path launches a real local subprocess probe through `RuntimeProbeRunner`, then feeds the real GTFO runtime validation track. 5. The next runtime capability step should connect GTFO launch, persistent game logs, screenshots, plugin markers, and gameplay evidence under one verified run record. Expert Skills may be split when they help the delivery chain move faster and their outputs stay connected to source code, artifacts, tests, and LangGraph routing. The currently discoverable process Skills in this group are: ```text runtime-diagnosis-playbook hook-discovery-playbook ``` The former `patch-review-playbook` and `repair-loop-playbook` are frozen as `SKILL.md.frozen`. They preserve history but are not discoverable Skills or execution authorities. Patch review and repair decisions use the current FeatureSpec, source, registered Artifacts, deterministic graph gates, and focused command evidence directly. # 0.0D High-Risk Git And Queue Handling Before high-risk work, run a Git status check and name the files that will be changed. High-risk work includes confirmed writes, game directory operations, runtime launch/copy operations, broad refactors, schema migrations, history repair, and queue/spec rewrites. Rules: 1. Preserve user changes while planning each edit against the current Git state. 2. Convert restored historical records into current branch proof by restoring the referenced files and rerunning focused tests. 3. Keep commits user-directed and evidence-backed. 4. If a task changes queue order, update `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_QUEUE.md` and `docs/SPEC_COVERAGE_MATRIX.md` in the same loop. 5. Review-repair tasks outrank ordinary Q work when an active P0/P1 finding is present. 6. Platform expansion should be selected by capability value. Strong near-term tracks include real dense retrieval, multimodal evidence, dashboard/API service work, MCP integration, game launch/copy automation with approval, and benchmark harnesses. # 0.1A LangGraph Control-Plane Clarification This clarification overrides older wording in this document wherever it is ambiguous. LangGraph is the workflow runtime/control plane. Business node behavior may be stubbed, fake, local, supplied-output, or real during staged implementation, and the workflow runtime should use a real LangGraph `StateGraph`/compiled graph for graph execution, routing, interrupt/resume, checkpointing, and graph audit. Implementation rules: 1. "Stub graph" means stubbed business nodes inside a real LangGraph graph. 2. LangGraph conditional edges own routing. A route matrix may declare routes, and helper functions may compute route labels or validate transitions, but helpers should remain supporting code around the primary workflow runner. 3. `transitions.py` may contain route predicates, route labels, and transition validation, with LangGraph `add_conditional_edges` remaining the execution wiring. 4. A single route registry/source should feed both LangGraph edge construction and any audit/Mermaid exporter so visual output cannot drift from execution. 5. `human_approval` in diagrams means a LangGraph interrupt/resume step that can collect approval evidence and resume the product loop. 6. LangGraph controls when artifact-producing nodes run. Nodes write artifacts through `ArtifactStore` and emit trace through trace wrappers/writers. LangGraph itself is not the artifact store. 7. LangGraph checkpointing is the source of truth for resumable graph state. Additional workflow run tables may index metadata for dashboard and API use. 8. Use canonical names consistently: ```text node names: plan_request, draft_feature_spec, retrieve_evidence, create_implementation_plan, generate_patch_proposal, review_proposal, dry_run_apply, build, collect_runtime_evidence, create_repair_plan, evaluate, done, blocked artifact/stage names: request_planning_report, feature_spec, evidence_pack, implementation_plan, patch_proposal, proposal_review, dry_run_result, build_result, runtime_evidence, repair_plan, eval_report ``` 9. `ModAgentState` is runtime control state. Artifacts are the durable audit and state projection. State entries must reference artifacts by ref/hash; durable claims must be recoverable from artifacts/traces, not hidden state. 10. CLI/API/MCP commands should call graph commands or artifact readers so the external interface follows the same product loop. 11. Evidence RAG / Knowledge Hub feeds evidence decisions inside the LangGraph controlled workflow. 12. Specialist nodes are implementation roles inside one LangGraph orchestrator and can grow as the single controlled graph matures. The optional ProposalCritic local/injected assessment boundary may score a registered proposal inside `review_proposal`, but it is read-only, writes a separate `critic_assessment` artifact, and has no route, path, approval, or write authority. Deterministic ProposalReviewer rules and LangGraph conditional edges retain final decision authority. 13. Interrupt/resume and checkpoint/resume should mature alongside real build and runtime branches. If a later section conflicts with this clarification, follow this section. ## 0.1B LangGraph Maturity And Claim Levels Use this ladder when reporting progress: | Level | Meaning | Current Signal | Next Capability | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | L0 | hand-written loop or pseudo graph | workflow skeleton | LangGraph-backed routing | | L1 | real `StateGraph` invocation with compatibility wrapper | thin LangGraph migration | broader graph ownership | | L2 | conditional edges own routing and route audit uses same registry | LangGraph routes decisions | stronger audit and dashboard views | | L3 | interrupt/resume and checkpoint/resume are tested | mature local control plane | real build/runtime automation | | L4 | bounded repair/eval paths are artifact-backed | controlled local loop | real mod capability | Reporting rules: 1. Report which part of routing is graph-owned and which part remains adapter compatibility work. 2. Generate Mermaid or graph audit output from the same route registry used to construct LangGraph edges. 3. Report large dirty diffs as accumulated work and separate them from the current task summary. 4. Use the task id from `PROGRESS_TRACKING.md` and `06-schedule.md` exactly when those files are the active planning source. 5. Documentation updates should help select and execute the next capability step. > 版本：0.4 > 状态：Greenfield Developer Specification > 关系：本文件是 `spec.md` 的开发执行版，必须与 `SKILL.md` 一起使用。 > 目标：让一个新会话中的 coding agent 只靠本文件和 skill，就能按阶段把项目做成可运行、可测试、可展示的工程，而不是只读懂愿景。 --- # 0. DEV_SPEC 使用协议 ## 0.1 文件分工 本仓库的顶层说明文件各自承担不同职责： | 文件 | 职责 | 更新频率 | 使用方式 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `SKILL.md` | 规定 agent 工作方式、读取顺序、安全边界 | 中 | 每次实现阶段都必须遵守 | | `DEV_SPEC.md` | 给出技术设计、接口、阶段任务、验收标准 | 高 | 实施时的 source of truth | 本文件不是普通产品文档，也不是只给人看的架构介绍。它必须满足三个条件： ```text 1. 能拆成可执行任务。 2. 每个任务能生成或修改明确文件。 3. 每个任务有测试、验收标准和实现边界。 ``` ## 0.2 与 `spec.md` 的关系 `spec.md` 是系统级技术规格，描述平台应该是什么。 `DEV_SPEC.md` 是开发规格，描述如何一步一步把它做出来。 因此，本文件保留并展开 `spec.md` 的主体内容，但增加以下实施层信息： - 模块落地顺序； - 文件级任务拆分； - artifact schema 的写入与校验策略； - LangGraph 节点的输入输出约束； - RAG、review、dry-run、build、runtime、repair 等关键模块的失败路径； - 每阶段最低测试要求； - agent 使用 `SKILL.md` 时的 prompt 和工作协议； - 第一天、第二天、第一周分别应该完成什么； - Demo、验证和发布时需要保留的交付边界。 ## 0.3 开发原则 本项目的开发优先级如下： ```text Graph state > hidden state Artifact contract > prompt-only memory Evidence before patch Review before apply Dry-run before write Build evidence before success claim Runtime evidence before gameplay claim Eval before resume claim ``` 任何实现只要违反这些优先级，即使 demo 看起来能跑，也应视为不可接受。 ## 0.4 新会话启动协议 每次让 coding agent 开始干活时，建议使用下面的会话启动语： ```text Read SKILL.md and DEV_SPEC.md. This is a greenfield project. Do not copy old project source. Follow the capability-first execution override. Advance the runnable product loop before adding passive validators. Use structured artifacts, trace events, focused tests, safe fake runners, and side-effect boundaries. ``` 如果目标是第一天开工，使用： ```text Implement the next runnable loop segment. Prefer adapter wiring and fake/local execution paths over more schema-only work. Move real patch/build/runtime success claims forward by attaching artifact-backed evidence. ``` ## 0.5 完成声明规则 每次阶段完成后，最终回复必须包含： ```text Phase: Changed files: Artifacts produced: Validation commands: What is now true: What is still stubbed: Next recommended phase: ``` 避免使用以下低价值声明： ```text "应该可以" "理论上支持" "后续可扩展" "大概完成" "未测试但逻辑简单" ``` 如果没跑测试，必须明确写： ```text Validation not run: <reason> ``` --- # 0A. 一号文档深度迁移原则 一号 `DEV_SPEC.md` 的价值不在于它只写了 RAG，而在于它做到： ```text 愿景 -> 技术选型 -> 模块接口 -> 数据结构 -> 失败路径 -> 测试策略 -> 小阶段排期 ``` 二号项目应把这种深度扩展到 RAG 之外。二号的核心是 controlled agentic code generation platform，因此以下模块都应逐步达到类似深度： | 模块 | 必须达到的深度 | | --- | --- | | LangGraph Workflow | 节点、条件边、checkpoint、人类中断、失败转移、trace | | Artifact Contract | envelope、schema、生命周期、stale detection、store interface | | Knowledge Base | source discovery、loader、metadata store、incremental index | | Evidence RAG | deterministic/symbol/vector/rerank/fusion/readiness/evidence pack | | Domain Adapter | risk taxonomy、managed paths、build profile、runtime evidence hints | | Planning Layer | request route、feature spec、implementation plan、blocking uncertainty | | Patch Proposal | context builder、schema、diff plan、no-op detector、scope boundary | | Review Gate | evidence binding、scope check、risk check、permission check | | Dry-run Apply | virtual patch、path guard、diff stats、write isolation | | Build Adapter | profile、command runner、error classifier、repair handoff | | Runtime Evidence | logs、screenshots、manual confirmation、vision caption fallback | | Repair Loop | failure type、hypothesis、minimal fix plan、retry budget | | Memory Compression | artifact index、context pack、token budget、critical constraint retention | | Evaluation Harness | golden cases、module metrics、regression report、dashboard summary | | Dashboard | workflow viewer、evidence browser、proposal viewer、eval dashboard | | MCP/API/CLI | external tools、schema、local inspection、write/launch approval routes | 判断某一章是否足够深，用下面的检查表： ```text 是否说清楚为什么存在？ 是否说清楚输入输出？ 是否指定文件和目录？ 是否给出数据结构或 schema？ 是否定义失败路径？ 是否定义测试？ 是否定义验收标准？ 是否说明不要做什么？ ``` 只有全部回答“是”，该章才算达到一号文档级别。 --- > 版本：0.3 > 状态：Greenfield Technical Specification > 项目类型：RepoForge > 初始领域：GTFO / BepInEx / Unity IL2CPP / HarmonyX Mod Development > 核心能力：LangGraph Workflow、Knowledge Base、Evidence RAG、Patch Proposal、Review Gate、Build/Runtime Feedback、Evaluation Harness、Dashboard、MCP/API > 目标：把自然语言 Mod 需求转化为可追踪、可评估、可审查、可回滚的受控代码生成流程。 --- ## 目录 1. 项目概述 2. 项目定位与非目标 3. 核心特点 4. 总体架构 5. Dry-run Apply 设计 14. Build Adapter 设计 15. Runtime Evidence 与 Multimodal 设计 16. Repair Loop 设计 17. Memory 与 Context Compression 设计 18. Evaluation Harness 设计 19. Observability 与 Dashboard 设计 20. Feature Spec -> Knowledge Base / Evidence RAG -> Implementation Plan -> Patch Proposal -> Proposal Review Gate -> Dry-run Apply -> Build Adapter -> Runtime Evidence Collection -> Repair Loop -> Evaluation Harness -> Dashboard / Demo / Resume Packaging ``` 本项目的核心目标是解决一个实际问题： > 非专家用户只描述想要的 Mod 功能，系统能够通过领域知识、源码证据、构建反馈和运行时证据，逐步生成可审查、可验证、可修复的 Mod 实现方案。 初始目标领域是： ```text GTFO / BepInEx / Unity IL2CPP / HarmonyX ``` 但项目架构不应写死 GTFO。GTFO 只是第一个 Domain Adapter。长期目标是形成： ```text Domain-Adapter-Based Mod Agent Platform ``` 也就是说，平台主体负责： ```text workflow orchestration artifact contracts knowledge base evidence retrieval patch proposal review gate tool permission evaluation harness dashboard ``` 具体游戏或技术栈由 Domain Adapter 提供： ```text GTFO Adapter Other Unity IL2CPP Adapter Unity Mono Adapter BepInEx Generic Adapter MelonLoader Adapter ``` --- # 2. 项目定位与非目标 ## 2.1 项目定位 本项目可以被描述为： ```text A LangGraph-based controlled code generation platform for game mod development, featuring artifact-driven workflow state, evidence-oriented RAG over source code and domain knowledge, proposal review gates, dry-run safety, build/runtime feedback loops, and evaluation harnesses for agent decision quality. ``` 中文定位： ```text 这是一个面向游戏 Mod 开发的受控 Agentic Code Generation 平台。 它用 LangGraph 编排自然语言需求、知识库检索、证据绑定、实现规划、 Patch Proposal、安全 Review Gate、Dry-run、Build/Runtime Feedback 和 Evaluation Harness，形成一条可追踪、可评估、可扩展的 AI 工程化链路。 ``` ## 2.2 面向对象 本项目面向三类用户。 ### 1. 非专家 Mod 需求用户 他们不需要知道： ```text Harmony patch class IL2CPP method signature BepInEx plugin lifecycle Unity field name C# namespace build command ``` 他们只需要表达： ```text 让击杀标记变成粉色，但不要改变普通命中、弱点命中、伤害、声音或其他反馈。 ``` 系统负责： ```text 需求澄清 风险判断 证据检索 实现规划 patch proposal 安全审查 build/runtime 验证 ``` ### 2. 开发者 / 项目维护者 他们需要看到： ```text 为什么选这个 hook 证据来自哪里 会改哪些文件 为什么没有改其他文件 build 为什么失败 runtime 证据是否足够 repair plan 是否合理 ``` ### 3. 面试 / 简历 / Demo 观看者 他们需要看懂： ```text 这是一个 LangGraph Agent 项目 它不是普通 RAG 问答 它有知识库和检索 它有受控执行 它有安全 gate 它有 evaluation harness 它能展示工程深度 ``` ## 2.3 非目标 本项目不是： - 普通 RAG 文档问答系统； - 单纯 MCP 知识库； - 无约束代码生成 bot； - 只靠 prompt 的脚本集合； - 只服务一个 sample mod 的一次性工具； - 旧项目代码的直接复制； - 一堆互相独立的 validators； - 只会生成 markdown 报告的文档项目； - 只追求能跑一次 demo 的薄包装项目。 --- # 3. 核心特点 ## 3.1 LangGraph 作为控制平面 LangGraph 不是装饰性技术点，而是本项目的控制平面。 它负责： ```text workflow state node transition conditional edges human interrupt repair loop blocked path artifact writing trace emission evaluation hook ``` 系统不是线性脚本，而是一个有状态图： ```text plan_request -> draft_feature_spec -> retrieve_evidence -> create_implementation_plan -> generate_patch_proposal -> review_proposal -> dry_run_apply -> build -> collect_runtime_evidence -> evaluate -> done ``` 失败路径： ```text retrieve_evidence -> blocked review_proposal -> revise_patch_proposal build -> repair_plan runtime_evidence -> repair_plan human_approval -> LangGraph interrupt/resume -> blocked or continue ``` ## 3.2 Knowledge Base + Evidence RAG 本项目的 RAG 不是普通问答 RAG，而是 Evidence RAG。 普通 RAG 的目标是： ```text 用户问问题 -> 检索文档 -> 生成回答 ``` 本项目的 Evidence RAG 目标是： ```text Agent 要改代码 -> 检索源码 / 文档 / 日志 / artifact / API evidence -> 判断证据是否足够 -> 绑定到 implementation plan 和 patch proposal ``` 证据不仅用于回答，还用于控制： ```text 是否允许进入 patch generation 是否允许使用某个 hook 是否允许声明 runtime behavior verified 是否允许 repair loop 继续 ``` ## 3.3 Artifact-driven Workflow 聊天上下文不是系统状态。 系统状态必须沉淀为 artifact： ```text request_plan.json feature_spec.json evidence_report.json implementation_plan.json patch_proposal.json proposal_review.json apply_result.json build_result.json runtime_evidence.json repair_plan.json eval_report.json workflow_trace.json ``` 这样可以解决： ```text 上下文污染 旧项目碎片干扰 Codex / LLM 忘记前置约束 无法复现历史决策 无法评估 agent 行为 ``` ## 3.4 Controlled Patch Proposal LLM 不直接修改代码。 LLM 只能生成： ```text patch_proposal.json ``` Proposal 经过 review gate 后，才能进入 dry-run apply。 Confirmed apply 需要人工确认。 ## 3.5 Build / Runtime / Repair Loop 生成 patch 不是终点。 系统必须支持： ```text build error classification runtime evidence collection repair planning repair proposal regression guard ``` 其中 build success 只代表编译成功，不代表游戏内行为成功。 ## 3.6 Evaluation Harness 本项目不靠“看起来能跑”证明能力，而是靠 harness 衡量： ```text request planning accuracy risk classification accuracy evidence recall evidence precision review block correctness dry-run safety build error classification repair plan correctness golden path success rate ``` --- # 4. 总体架构 ## 4.1 顶层架构 ```text User / CLI / MCP / API | v LangGraph Workflow LangGraph Workflow 设计 ## 5.1 设计目标 LangGraph Workflow Layer 负责把所有模块串成受控流程。 This layer is implemented with LangGraph `StateGraph` and conditional edges. Node handlers may be simple or stubbed, but graph execution, routing, interrupt/resume, and checkpoint/resume are framework responsibilities. 它必须满足： ```text 可中断 可恢复 可追踪 可评估 可阻断 可修复 可人工确认 ``` ## 5.2 Graph State The names in `StageName` are durable artifact/stage labels. They are not a second set of workflow node names. Workflow node names use the canonical node list from Section 0.1A. ```python from typing import TypedDict, Literal StageName = Literal[ "request_planning", "feature_spec", "evidence_retrieval", "implementation_plan", "patch_proposal", "proposal_review", "dry_run_apply", "build", "runtime_evidence", "repair_plan", "evaluation", "done", "blocked", ] RiskLevel = Literal[ "low", "medium", "high", "critical", "unknown", ] ExecutionPath = Literal[ "config_only", "no_hook_needed", "quick_patch", "standard_feature", "game_hook_investigation", "runtime_investigation", "repair_loop", "blocked_ambiguous", ] class ModAgentState(TypedDict): request_id: str feature_id: str | None user_request: str target_domain: str | None target_mod: str | None execution_path: ExecutionPath | None risk_level: RiskLevel | None current_stage: StageName next_stage: StageName | None artifacts: dict[str, str] artifact_hashes: dict[str, str] approvals: dict[str, bool] blockers: list[dict] warnings: list[dict] evidence_summary: dict review_summary: dict build_summary: dict runtime_summary: dict eval_summary: dict trace_id: str run_id: str metrics: dict ``` ## 5.3 Node 列表 ```text initialize_run plan_request draft_feature_spec retrieve_evidence create_implementation_plan generate_patch_proposal review_proposal dry_run_apply build collect_runtime_evidence create_repair_plan evaluate interrupt_resume_gate blocked done ``` `interrupt_resume_gate` is a LangGraph interrupt/resume point. It collects permission evidence and returns a resumable graph decision instead of flattening the question into an opaque status. ## 5.4 Node 输入输出约定 每个 node 必须： ```text 读取上游 artifact 执行本阶段逻辑 写入本阶段 artifact 更新 ModAgentState 写 trace event 返回 state delta ``` 推荐推进方式： ```text 直接修改 generated source 绕过 artifact store 读取 raw chat history 当主状态 吞掉异常 返回 fake success ``` ## 5.5 条件边 ```text plan_request if blocked_ambiguous -> blocked else -> draft_feature_spec retrieve_evidence if readiness == "ready" -> create_implementation_plan if readiness == "partial" and risk <= medium -> interrupt_resume_gate if readiness == "insufficient" -> blocked review_proposal if PASS -> dry_run_apply if PASS_WITH_WARNINGS -> interrupt_resume_gate if NEEDS_REVISION -> generate_patch_proposal if BLOCKED -> blocked dry_run_apply if safe and approval_required -> interrupt_resume_gate if safe and no approval_required -> build if unsafe -> blocked build if success -> collect_runtime_evidence if failure -> create_repair_plan collect_runtime_evidence if verified -> evaluate if inconclusive -> interrupt_resume_gate if failed -> create_repair_plan evaluate if pass -> done if regression -> create_repair_plan ``` ## 5.6 Checkpointing 默认实现： ```text LangGraph SqliteSaver ``` 存储位置： ```text data/db/workflow_checkpoints.db ``` Ownership rule: ```text LangGraph checkpointer owns resumable graph state. Custom tables may index run metadata and audit summaries for dashboard/API use while LangGraph checkpoint/resume remains the workflow state source. ``` 表结构： ```sql CREATE TABLE workflow_runs ( run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, feature_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT NOT NULL, current_stage TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); CREATE TABLE workflow_checkpoints ( checkpoint_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, stage TEXT NOT NULL, state_json TEXT NOT NULL, artifact_hashes_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); ``` ## 5.7 失败处理 | 失败类型 | 处理方式 | |---|---| | node exception | 写 error trace，进入 blocked | | artifact missing | stale/block | | evidence insufficient | blocked | | review failed | revise or block | | build failed | repair plan | | runtime inconclusive | human approval | | eval regression | repair plan | ## 5.8 测试要求 单元测试： ```text test_graph_normal_path test_graph_blocks_on_insufficient_evidence test_graph_interrupts_before_confirmed_write test_graph_enters_repair_on_build_failure test_graph_marks_artifact_stale ``` 集成测试： ```text test_stub_workflow_end_to_end test_config_only_golden_path test_hook_request_blocks_without_evidence ``` --- # 6. Artifact Contract 设计 ## 6.1 目标 Artifact 是系统的主状态。 它必须解决： ```text 跨 node 数据传递 长上下文压缩 审查与回溯 eval case 构建 dashboard 展示 legacy import 管理 ``` ## 6.2 Artifact 存储路径 ```text artifacts/features/<feature_id>/ request_plan.json feature_spec.json evidence_report.json implementation_plan.json patch_proposal.json proposal_review.json dry_run_result.json build_result.json runtime_evidence.json repair_plan.json eval_report.json workflow_trace.json ``` ## 6.3 通用 Envelope ```json { "schema_version": "0.3", "artifact_type": "feature_spec", "feature_id": "20260623_001_make-kill-marker-pink", "run_id": "run_001", "producer_node": "draft_feature_spec", "created_at": "2026-06-23T12:00:00Z", "input_artifact_hashes": { "request_plan": "sha256:..." }, "content": {}, "validation": { "status": "valid", "errors": [], "warnings": [] }, "hash": "sha256:..." } ``` ## 6.4 Artifact 生命周期 ```text created -> validated -> consumed -> stale -> superseded ``` ## 6.5 Stale Detection 规则： ```text 如果上游 artifact hash 改变，下游 artifact stale。 ``` 示例： ```text feature_spec changed -> evidence_report stale -> implementation_plan stale -> patch_proposal stale -> proposal_review stale ``` ## 6.6 Artifact Store 接口 ```python class ArtifactStore: def write_artifact( self, feature_id: str, artifact_type: str, content: dict, producer_node: str, input_artifact_hashes: dict[str, str], ) -> ArtifactRef: ... def read_artifact( self, feature_id: str, artifact_type: str, ) -> dict: ... def validate_artifact( self, artifact: dict, ) -> ValidationResult: ... def mark_stale( self, feature_id: str, artifact_type: str, reason: str, ) -> None: ... def list_feature_artifacts( self, feature_id: str, ) -> list[ArtifactRef]: ... ``` ## 6.7 验收标准 - 所有 artifact 写入必须经过 ArtifactStore； - artifact hash 稳定； - schema validation 可阻断 workflow； - stale artifact routes to refresh / repair before apply/build； - dashboard 能按 feature_id 展示 artifact chain。 --- # 7. Knowledge Base and Evidence RAG Detailed Knowledge Base and Evidence RAG design moved to `EVIDENCE_RAG_MCP_SPEC.md`. `DEV_SPEC.md` keeps the parent workflow, artifact, safety, proposal, review, build, runtime, repair, eval, and dashboard boundaries. RAG/MCP implementation must feed those boundaries through EvidencePack, source authority, retrieval trace, and artifact references. # 9. Domain Adapter 设计 ## 9.1 目标 Domain Adapter 负责把平台能力接入具体 Mod 技术栈。 平台主体不应知道： ```text GTFO 的目录长什么样 BepInEx log 在哪里 IL2CPP hook 风险是什么 build command 怎么跑 哪些路径安全可编辑 哪些 runtime evidence 有效 ``` 这些都由 Domain Adapter 提供。 ## 9.2 Base Interface ```python class DomainAdapter(Protocol): domain_name: str def identify_project(self, root: str) -> DomainProfile: ... def collect_knowledge_sources(self, profile: DomainProfile) -> list[KnowledgeSource]: ... def classify_request(self, user_request: str) -> DomainRoute: ... def build_evidence_queries(self, feature_spec: dict) -> list[EvidenceQuery]: ... def safe_edit_roots(self, profile: DomainProfile) -> list[str]: ... def forbidden_paths(self, profile: DomainProfile) -> list[str]: ... def build_profile(self, profile: DomainProfile) -> BuildProfile: ... def runtime_profile(self, profile: DomainProfile) -> RuntimeProfile: ... def verification_strategy(self, feature_spec: dict) -> VerificationPlan: ... ``` ## 9.3 GTFO Adapter GTFO Adapter 默认识别： ```text BepInEx plugin project C# project file generated_mods/ BepInEx references interop assemblies decompiled API index plugin config files BepInEx logs ``` ## 9.4 GTFO 风险等级 ```text config_only -> low ui_feedback_without_hook -> medium game_hook -> high runtime_behavior_change -> high native/interop/reflection-heavy -> critical unknown -> unknown/block ``` ## 9.5 GTFO Managed Paths 优先作为只读、受控修改或显式交付步骤处理： ```text BepInEx core dlls game binaries interop generated dlls decompiled reference files legacy_import/raw knowledge/indexes artifacts from other feature_id ``` ## 9.6 验收标准 - 没有 adapter 时先生成 adapter onboarding / evidence discovery 步骤； - adapter 能识别 safe_edit_roots； - adapter 能提供 knowledge sources； - adapter 能提供 build profile； - adapter safety policy 能被 path guard 调用。 --- # 10. Planning Layer 设计 ## 10.1 目标 Planning Layer 把自然语言请求转成结构化开发合同。 输出： ```text request_plan.json feature_spec.json implementation_plan.json ``` ## 10.2 Request Plan ```json { "request_id": "...", "user_request": "...", "target_domain": "gtfo", "target_mod": "BetterHitFeedback", "execution_path": "game_hook_investigation", "risk_level": "high", "ambiguities": [], "blocking_questions": [], "initial_constraints": [ "do not change normal hit marker", "do not change weakspot marker", "do not change damage", "do not change sound" ] } ``` ## 10.3 Feature Spec ```json { "feature_id": "...", "title": "Make GTFO kill marker pink", "intent": "ui_feedback_change", "target_behavior": { "change": "kill marker color becomes pink", "scope": "kill marker only" }, "non_goals": [ "normal hit marker", "weakspot marker", "damage", "sound", "other hit feedback behavior" ], "acceptance": [ { "id": "acc_001", "description": "Kill marker appears pink in the target mod.", "verification": "runtime evidence or explicit log marker" } ], "risk_level": "high" } ``` ## 10.4 Implementation Plan ```json { "feature_id": "...", "plan_id": "...", "target_files": [], "managed_files": [], "required_evidence": [], "selected_strategy": "...", "alternatives_considered": [], "implementation_steps": [], "validation_steps": [], "rollback_plan": [] } ``` ## 10.5 验收标准 - vague request 应先进入 clarification / evidence discovery / planning brief； - non-goals 必须保留； - implementation plan 必须引用 evidence； - implementation boundaries 必须明确； - acceptance contract 可被 runtime/eval 使用。 --- # 11. Patch Proposal 设计 ## 11.1 目标 Patch Proposal 是 LLM 输出代码修改的唯一合法形式。 它不是直接 diff，而是结构化修改计划。 ## 11.2 Proposal Schema ```json { "schema_version": "0.3", "feature_id": "...", "proposal_id": "...", "base_artifact_hashes": { "feature_spec": "...", "implementation_plan": "...", "evidence_report": "..." }, "target_files": [], "managed_files": [], "changes": [ { "change_id": "change_001", "operation": "create | modify | delete", "file_path": "...", "rationale": "...", "evidence_ids": [], "diff": "..." } ], "expected_validation": { "compile": true, "runtime": true, "manual": true }, "risk_assessment": { "risk_level": "high", "requires_human_approval": true } } ``` ## 11.3 Context Builder 输入： ```text feature_spec implementation_plan evidence_pack domain_profile safety_policy context_pack ``` 输出： ```json { "included": [], "excluded": [], "critical_constraints": [], "token_budget": { "max": 12000, "used": 9300 } } ``` ## 11.4 No-op Detector 如果 feature 已满足，输出： ```json { "status": "already_satisfied", "evidence_ids": [], "no_changes_required": true } ``` ## 11.5 验收标准 - proposal schema validates； - 每个 change 引用 evidence； - managed file 的处理方式应在 proposal 中说明； - no-op 不生成假 diff； - proposal 不直接写文件。 --- # 12. Review Gate 与 Delivery Confidence 设计 ## 12.1 目标 Review Gate 是写入前的质量、证据和交付信心提升环节。 ## 12.2 Review Checks ```text schema_validity artifact_freshness target_mod_alignment semantic_alignment scope_minimality evidence_binding path_safety risk_level human_approval_required ``` ## 12.3 Review Result ```json { "schema_version": "0.3", "feature_id": "...", "proposal_id": "...", "reviewed_proposal_hash": "...", "status": "PASS | PASS_WITH_WARNINGS | NEEDS_REVISION | BLOCKED", "blocking_findings": [], "warnings": [], "required_revisions": [], "requires_human_approval": true } ``` ## 12.4 Permission Model 工具权限分级： ```text read_only report_only dry_run confirmed_write external_process dangerous ``` 默认允许： ```text read_only report_only dry_run ``` 需要更高执行级别和显式意图的能力： ```text confirmed_write dangerous ``` ## 12.5 Path Guard ```python class PathGuard: def validate_path( self, path: str, safe_roots: list[str], forbidden_roots: list[str], ) -> PathValidationResult: ... ``` ## 12.6 验收标准 - stale proposal routes to refresh / repair； - wrong target mod routes to adapter/profile correction； - semantic drift routes to proposal revision； - managed path changes route to higher review； - confirmed write records approval and rollback metadata； - review result hash 必须匹配 proposal hash。 --- # 13. Dry-run Apply 设计 ## 13.1 目标 Dry-run Apply 只计算会发生什么，不实际写文件。 ## 13.2 Dry-run Result ```json { "feature_id": "...", "proposal_id": "...", "would_create": [], "would_modify": [], "would_delete": [], "blocked_paths": [], "patch_conflicts": [], "safe_to_apply": false, "requires_human_approval": true } ``` ## 13.3 验收标准 - dry-run 不写文件； - 会列出 would-change files； - path conflict 可见； - blocked path 可见； - confirmed apply 不在第一版启用。 --- # 14. Build Adapter 设计 ## 14.1 目标 Build Adapter 把不同 Mod 项目的构建命令抽象为统一接口。 ## 14.2 Build Profile ```json { "build_system": "dotnet", "project_file": "...", "command": "dotnet build", "working_dir": "...", "expected_outputs": [], "log_path": "..." } ``` ## 14.3 Build Result ```json { "feature_id": "...", "status": "success | failed | skipped", "command": "...", "exit_code": 0, "stdout_path": "...", "stderr_path": "...", "errors": [], "warnings": [], "duration_ms": 0 } ``` ## 14.4 Error Classifier 错误类型： ```text syntax_error missing_reference namespace_error api_mismatch il2cpp_access_error config_binding_error unsafe_path_error unknown ``` ## 14.5 验收标准 - build output 结构化； - error classifier 可单测； - build failure 进入 repair plan； - build success 不等于 runtime verified。 --- # 15. Runtime Evidence 与 Multimodal 设计 ## 15.1 目标 Runtime Evidence 用来证明游戏内行为，而不是只证明插件加载。 ## 15.2 Evidence Source ```text BepInEx startup log plugin runtime marker manual note screenshot vision summary config snapshot ``` ## 15.3 Runtime Evidence Schema ```json { "feature_id": "...", "startup_loaded": true, "gameplay_behavior_verified": false, "evidence_items": [ { "type": "log | screenshot | manual_note | vision_summary", "source": "...", "locator": "...", "supports_acceptance": [], "confidence": 0.0 } ], "verification_status": "verified | partial | failed | inconclusive" } ``` ## 15.4 Screenshot Registry ```sql CREATE TABLE screenshots ( screenshot_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, feature_id TEXT NOT NULL, file_path TEXT NOT NULL, captured_at TIMESTAMP, caption TEXT, metadata_json TEXT ); ``` ## 15.5 Vision Captioner 可选模块。 失败回退： ```text vision unavailable -> keep screenshot metadata only caption low quality -> mark low_confidence manual verification available -> use manual note ``` ## 15.6 验收标准 - startup_loaded 与 gameplay_behavior_verified 分离； - screenshot 有 metadata； - vision output 可选； - runtime evidence 可进入 repair loop； - dashboard 能展示 runtime timeline。 --- # 16.
