Developer Execution Layer 本章是 `DEV_SPEC.md` 相比 `spec.md` 增加的核心实施层。 前文回答“系统是什么”，本章回答“开发 agent 应该怎么把系统做出来”。 ## 29.1 总体实施节奏 推荐节奏不是先做炫酷 demo，而是先建立平台骨架： ```text Day 1: Phase A：项目骨架、LangGraph workflow、artifact store、permission model、trace event Day 2: Phase B-C：artifact contract、knowledge source registry、deterministic evidence retrieval Day 3-4: Phase D-F：planning、feature spec、implementation plan、patch proposal、review gate Day 5: Phase G-H：dry-run apply、build adapter、runtime evidence、repair loop Week 2: Phase I-K：memory compression、evaluation harness、dashboard、MCP/API、demo packaging ``` 每一天都必须保持下面的完成状态： ```text main importable focused tests passing artifacts written through store trace events emitted side effects routed through explicit approval and rollback/evidence records README or docs updated when user-facing behavior changes ``` ## 29.2 每个 phase 的最低交付物 每个 phase 至少交付四类东西： | 类型 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | Code | 真实模块、接口或 stub，文档更新应服务于可运行能力 | | Artifact | 该阶段产生的结构化输出 | | Test | 单元测试或集成测试 | | Trace | 可解释的事件记录，方便 dashboard 和 eval 复用 | 如果某阶段暂时是 stub，也必须满足： ```text stub has same public interface as future real implementation stub writes the same artifact shape as future implementation stub exposes explicit status="stubbed" stub exposes the next evidence step toward real success ``` ## 29.3 文件命名约定 推荐顶层 Python 包： ```text src/mod_agent/ ``` 除非已经进入某个 phase，否则不要提前创建空目录。目录增长应跟随真实模块增长。 核心命名规则： ```text workflow/ LangGraph state, graph, nodes, transitions artifacts/ artifact envelope, store, schemas, validators planning/ request routing, feature spec, implementation plan knowledge/ source discovery, loaders, indexing evidence/ retrieval, fusion, rerank, readiness domain/ adapters and risk policies proposal/ patch proposal generation and context builder review/ proposal review gate and safety findings apply/ dry-run patch apply and path guards build/ build profiles, runners, error classifier runtime/ log/screenshot/manual evidence collection repair/ failure analysis and repair plan memory/ artifact index and context pack evaluation/ eval cases, runner, metrics, reports observability/ trace event schema and storage dashboard/ local visual UI api/ HTTP API mcp/ MCP tools and resources tools/ tool registry and permission model model/ LLM provider abstractions config/ settings loading and validation ``` ## 29.4 Artifact envelope 标准 所有 artifact 都必须采用统一 envelope。不要让每个模块随意写 JSON。 ```json { "schema_version": "1.0", "artifact_type": "feature_spec", "feature_id": "20260623_001_example", "run_id": "run_...", "stage": "draft_feature_spec", "status": "success", "created_at": "2026-06-23T00:00:00Z", "inputs": { "request_id": "req_...", "upstream_artifacts": [] }, "data": {}, "warnings": [], "blockers": [], "trace_refs": [] } ``` 最小字段要求： | 字段 | 规则 | | --- | --- | | `schema_version` | 必须存在，便于迁移 | | `artifact_type` | 必须是注册类型 | | `feature_id` | feature 级 artifact 必须存在 | | `run_id` | workflow run 级 artifact 必须存在 | | `stage` | 必须等于产生它的 graph node 或 phase | | `status` | `success`、`blocked`、`failed`、`stubbed`、`skipped` 之一 | | `data` | 业务内容只能放这里 | | `blockers` | 阻塞原因必须结构化 | | `trace_refs` | 关联 trace event id | ## 29.5 Trace event 标准 每个 graph node 至少产生两个 trace event： ```text node_started node_finished ``` 失败或阻塞时额外产生： ```text node_blocked node_failed repair_requested human_approval_required ``` Trace event schema： ```json { "event_id": "evt_...", "run_id": "run_...", "feature_id": "feature_...", "stage": "retrieve_evidence", "event_type": "node_finished", "timestamp": "2026-06-23T00:00:00Z", "duration_ms": 123, "status": "success", "summary": "retrieved 8 evidence items", "artifact_refs": ["artifacts/features/.../evidence_pack.json"], "metrics": {}, "warnings": [], "blockers": [] } ``` 禁止把 trace 写成自然语言流水账。Dashboard、eval、debug 都要能读取结构化字段。 --- # 30. Phase A：LangGraph Runtime Skeleton With Stubbed Business Nodes ## 30.1 目标 Phase A 的目标是建立平台骨架，而不是实现真实 mod 修改。 完成后必须成立： ```text 用户请求可以进入 graph graph 可以走完 stubbed-business-node golden path 每个 node 更新 state 每个 node 通过 artifact store 写 artifact 每个 node 写 trace event 危险动作默认不执行 测试能证明 normal path 与 blocked path ``` ## 30.4 A2：Graph State 核心 state 必须是 TypedDict 或 Pydantic model。推荐先用 TypedDict 保持轻量。 ```python class ModAgentState(TypedDict): run_id: str request_id: str feature_id: str | None user_request: str target_domain: str target_mod: str | None execution_path: str | None risk_level: str | None current_stage: str artifacts: dict[str, str] approvals: dict[str, bool] blockers: list[dict] trace: list[dict] metrics: dict[str, object] ``` 实现要求： ```text state initializer must create run_id and request_id feature_id may be None before planning current_stage starts as "start" artifacts starts empty approvals starts empty blockers starts empty ``` 测试： ```text state initializer returns required keys state can be serialized to JSON-compatible dict missing user_request is rejected or blocked ``` ## 30.5 A3：Artifact Store Artifact store 是所有阶段写文件的唯一入口。 接口草案： ```python class ArtifactStore: def write(self, feature_id: str, artifact_type: str, payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> ArtifactRef: ... def read(self, ref: ArtifactRef) -> dict[str, Any]: ... def list_feature_artifacts(self, feature_id: str) -> list[ArtifactRef]: ... def exists(self, ref: ArtifactRef) -> bool: ... ``` 路径规则： ```text artifacts/features/<feature_id>/<artifact_type>.json artifacts/runs/<run_id>/workflow_trace.jsonl ``` 验收标准： ```text write creates parent directories write wraps payload in envelope read returns same envelope artifact_type is validated paths cannot escape artifact root ``` ## 30.6 A4：Permission Model Phase A 只实现权限模型，不执行危险命令。 权限分级： | Level | 示例 | 默认 | | --- | --- | --- | | `read_only` | read file, list artifacts | allowed | | `report_only` | planning, retrieval report | allowed | | `dry_run_write` | patch dry-run, diff simulation | allowed with explicit phase | | `confirmed_write` | modify generated source | blocked | | `external_side_effect` | copy into game directory, run external executable | blocked | 接口草案： ```python class PermissionDecision(TypedDict): allowed: bool level: str reason: str required_approval: str | None ``` 测试： ```text read_only is allowed confirmed_write records approval and rollback metadata external_side_effect records approval and runtime/build evidence decision includes reason ``` ## 30.7 A5：Stub Nodes Phase A 的 graph nodes： ```text plan_request draft_feature_spec retrieve_evidence create_implementation_plan generate_patch_proposal review_proposal dry_run_apply build collect_runtime_evidence create_repair_plan evaluate done blocked ``` 每个 stub node 必须： ```text receive state set current_stage write an artifact with status="stubbed" emit trace event return updated state ``` 推荐推进方式： ```text stub node reports capability_level and next_real_step stub node produces the same artifact shape as the future real node stub node connects to retrieval / patch / generated source work through explicit follow-up tasks ``` ## 30.8 A6：Graph Transitions 最小正常路径： ```text start -> plan_request -> draft_feature_spec -> retrieve_evidence -> create_implementation_plan -> generate_patch_proposal -> review_proposal -> dry_run_apply -> build -> collect_runtime_evidence -> evaluate -> done ``` 最小阻塞路径： ```text plan_request -> blocked retrieve_evidence -> blocked review_proposal -> blocked dry_run_apply -> blocked ``` 测试： ```text normal path reaches done vague request can route to blocked blocked state includes blocker reason trace contains node_started and node_finished ``` --- # 31. Phase B：Artifact Contract ## 31.1 目标 Phase B 要把 artifact 从“能写 JSON”升级为“系统契约”。 必须实现： ```text registered artifact types schema validation stale detection artifact dependency graph artifact lifecycle status contract tests ``` ## 31.2 Artifact 类型注册表 首批类型： ```text request_planning_report feature_spec evidence_pack implementation_plan patch_proposal proposal_review dry_run_result build_result runtime_evidence repair_plan eval_report workflow_trace ``` 每种类型必须声明： ```text artifact_type schema_version required_fields producer_stage allowed_statuses stale_inputs ``` ## 31.3 Stale Detection 当上游 artifact 改变后，下游 artifact 进入 refresh / repair 路由。 推荐实现： ```text 每个 artifact envelope 记录 inputs.upstream_artifacts 每个 upstream ref 记录 path + sha256 read artifact 时可检查 upstream sha256 是否变化 变化则 status_view = stale ``` 验收标准： ```text 修改 feature_spec 后 implementation_plan 被识别 stale stale artifact routes to refresh before patch proposal review dashboard 可以显示 stale reason ``` --- # 32. Phase C: Knowledge Base and Evidence RAG Phase C/D RAG implementation detail moved to `EVIDENCE_RAG_MCP_SPEC.md`. The parent requirement remains: Knowledge Base and Evidence RAG must produce inspectable evidence for planning, proposal, review, repair, eval, and dashboard flows, not final patch authority by themselves. # 33. Phase D-F：Planning, Proposal, Review ## 33.1 Request Planning Request planning 不负责写代码，只负责把用户请求变成 route decision。 执行路径： ```text quick_patch standard_feature game_hook_investigation full_runtime_investigation repair_loop blocked_ambiguous blocked_out_of_scope ``` 输出 artifact： ```json { "route": "standard_feature", "risk_level": "medium", "target_mod": "BetterHitFeedback", "requires_hook_evidence": true, "requires_runtime_evidence": false, "uncertainties": [], "blocked": false } ``` ## 33.2 Feature Spec Feature spec 必须把自然语言愿望变成可验收需求。 必填字段： ```text feature_id user_request target_behavior non_goals target_mod risk_level acceptance_criteria evidence_requirements runtime_verification_plan ``` 反例： ```text "让体验更好" 先进入 clarification / planning brief "修一下那个问题" 没有上下文时生成 clarification / evidence request ``` ## 33.3 Implementation Plan Implementation plan 是“准备怎么改”，不是 patch。 必填字段： ```text target_files target_symbols evidence_refs proposed_changes side_effect_boundaries test_plan rollback_plan open_questions ``` 验收标准： ```text 每个 proposed_change 至少绑定一个 evidence_ref 每个 target_file 必须在允许范围内 高风险计划必须声明 runtime verification open_questions 非空且 blocking=true 时先进入 clarification / evidence discovery ``` ## 33.4 Patch Proposal Patch proposal 是 reviewable artifact，不是直接写文件。 必填字段： ```text proposal_id feature_id summary files diff_intent evidence_refs scope_boundary risk_assessment expected_tests manual_review_notes ``` 推荐推进方式： ```text 不要在 proposal 阶段修改源文件 不要生成未绑定 evidence 的 hook 修改 不要把 unrelated refactor 塞进 proposal 不要把 no-op 当成 patch ``` ## 33.5 Review Gate Review gate 至少检查： ```text schema_validity evidence_binding scope_boundary target_alignment risk_policy forbidden_paths permission_level test_plan_presence no_op_detection ``` Review result： ```json { "decision": "approve_dry_run", "findings": [], "required_changes": [], "allowed_next_stage": "dry_run_apply" } ``` 决策枚举： ```text approve_dry_run revise_proposal blocked_insufficient_evidence blocked_scope_risk blocked_requires_human already_satisfied ``` --- # 34. Phase G-H：Dry-run, Build, Runtime, Repair ## 34.1 Dry-run Apply Dry-run apply 的目标是证明 patch 可以被应用，但不真正写入最终 source。 必须输出： ```text changed_files diff_stats path_guard_result conflict_result would_write permission_required ``` 验收标准： ```text dry-run 不修改 generated source 路径逃逸被拒绝 forbidden path 被拒绝 diff stats 可读 失败进入 repair 或 blocked ``` ## 34.2 Confirmed Apply 第一版不要求 confirmed apply。 如果后续实现，必须满足： ```text requires human approval artifact approval includes proposal_id and diff hash write only allowed after review decision approve_write write emits irreversible_side_effect trace event rollback hint is recorded ``` ## 34.3 Build Adapter Build adapter 不是简单跑 shell。它必须把构建结果结构化。 Build profile： ```json { "profile_id": "gtfo_bepinex_il2cpp", "working_directory": "generated_mods/BetterHitFeedback", "command": ["dotnet", "build"], "expected_artifacts": ["bin/Debug/BetterHitFeedback.dll"], "timeout_seconds": 120 } ``` Build result： ```json { "status": "failed", "exit_code": 1, "duration_ms": 12000, "stdout_excerpt": "", "stderr_excerpt": "", "error_class": "compile_error", "diagnostics": [] } ``` Error classes： ```text compile_error missing_reference api_mismatch package_restore_failure timeout permission_denied unknown ``` ## 34.4 Runtime Evidence Runtime evidence 不是“我觉得能用”。它至少来自： ```text runtime log manual user confirmation screenshot video frame game-side artifact ``` MVP 可以只支持手动 evidence，但必须结构化： ```json { "source": "manual_confirmation", "claim": "kill marker became pink and normal hit marker did not change", "confidence": "medium", "attachments": [], "limitations": ["manual observation only"] } ``` ## 34.5 Repair Loop Repair plan 不是“再试一次”。它必须说明失败类型、假设、最小修复。 字段： ```text failure_source failure_class evidence_refs hypothesis minimal_changes retry_budget stop_condition ``` 推荐推进方式： ```text 不要无限 repair 不要在没有新 evidence 时扩大 scope 不要用 repair loop 绕过 review gate ``` --- # 35. Phase I-K：Memory, Eval, Dashboard, MCP/API ## 35.1 Memory and Context Compression 本项目 memory 的 source of truth 是 artifact，不是聊天记录。 Context pack 生成逻辑： ```text select feature artifacts rank by relevance and recency preserve critical constraints compress long evidence excerpts report included/excluded artifacts report token budget ``` Context pack 必填： ```text feature_id purpose included_artifacts excluded_artifacts critical_constraints evidence_summary open_blockers token_estimate ``` ## 35.2 Evaluation Harness Eval 不是装饰。它用于证明 agent 决策质量可回归。 首批指标： ```text path_accuracy risk_accuracy evidence_recall proposal_schema_validity review_block_correctness dry_run_safety repair_plan_quality golden_path_completion ``` Eval case： ```json { "case_id": "quick_patch_config_default", "user_request": "Change default EnableDiagnosticLogging to false.", "expected_route": "quick_patch", "expected_risk": "low", "expected_blocked": false, "must_not_require_hook_evidence": true } ``` 最低验收： ```text eval runner can run all cases report includes pass/fail per metric regression summary is written as artifact dashboard can read eval report ``` ## 35.3 Dashboard Dashboard 必须解释 workflow，而不是做漂亮壳。 第一版页面： ```text Overview Workflow Run Viewer Artifact Browser Evidence Browser Patch Proposal Viewer Review Findings Evaluation Dashboard ``` 每个页面必须回答一个问题： | 页面 | 回答的问题 | | --- | --- | | Overview | 当前系统有哪些 run、feature、失败和阻塞 | | Workflow Run Viewer | 某次请求走到哪一步，为什么停下 | | Artifact Browser | 产生了哪些 artifact，是否 stale | | Evidence Browser | patch 依据哪些证据，证据是否充分 | | Patch Proposal Viewer | 准备改哪些文件，scope 是否可控 | | Review Findings | 为什么允许或阻止下一步 | | Evaluation Dashboard | 系统在哪些决策上退化 | ## 35.4 MCP/API MCP/API 默认只暴露 safe tools。 首批 tools： ```text plan_request list_artifacts read_artifact retrieve_evidence review_proposal run_eval get_workflow_status ``` 默认不暴露： ```text confirmed_apply copy_to_game_directory run_external_game delete_artifacts ``` 接口规则： ```text MCP/API 通过 graph state 推进 MCP/API 写 source 走 proposal/review/dry-run/apply 链路 所有 tool 输出都必须有 schema 危险工具必须返回 required_approval 而不是执行 ``` --- # 36. Agent Implementation Checklists ## 36.1 开始任一 phase 前 必须检查： ```text 读过 SKILL.md 读过 DEV_SPEC.md 对应 phase 确认当前 git/worktree 状态 确认不会复制旧 source 确认该 phase 的文件清单 确认最低测试命令 ``` ## 36.2 修改代码前 必须回答： ```text 这个改动属于哪个 phase？ 会新增或修改哪些 artifact？ 是否改变 graph transition？ 是否改变 permission boundary？ 是否需要新增测试？ 是否存在危险 side effect？ ``` ## 36.3 完成阶段前 必须验证： ```text python -B -m compileall src python -B -m unittest discover -s tests ``` 如果项目采用 pytest，则改为： ```text python -B -m pytest ``` 并在 README 或本文件相关位置更新验证命令。 ## 36.4 高杠杆推进方式 ```text README 更新应绑定代码、artifact、测试或 demo 入口。 Prompt 工作应沉淀为 artifact schema、node contract 或 eval case。 Patch 生成应尽快接入 evidence、review、dry-run、build/runtime 验证链。 Apply 能力按 dry-run -> reviewed write -> rollback metadata 的顺序推进。 Runtime success 应由 log、marker、screenshot、manual/probe evidence 逐步升级。 旧项目目录作为 knowledge source、reference pattern、fixture 或 migration input 使用。 Demo 状态应展示真实 workflow 状态，并把 blocked/repair 变成可操作下一步。 Trace 优先结构化，同时允许 dashboard 生成可读摘要。 Eval case 应和新能力同步补充，避免最后集中补课。 ``` ## 36.5 第一周完成定义 第一周完成不要求真实自动改出复杂 Mod。第一周完成要求平台骨架可信。 必须能演示： ```text natural language request -> graph run -> request planning artifact -> feature spec artifact -> evidence pack artifact -> implementation plan artifact -> patch proposal artifact -> review result artifact -> dry-run result artifact -> eval report artifact -> dashboard view ``` 允许仍然 stub： ```text real vector embeddings real reranker real confirmed apply real gameplay runtime automation production MCP server multi-domain adapter ``` 第一周建议真实落地： ```text graph state artifact store permission model trace event schema review decision schema eval case runner ``` ## 36.6 面试讲述角度 最终项目应该能这样讲： ```text 我做的不是普通 RAG 问答，而是一个面向游戏 Mod 开发的受控 Agentic Code Generation 平台。 它用 LangGraph 管理 workflow state、分支、人类确认和 repair loop； 用 artifact contract 把每一步的输入输出结构化； 用 Evidence RAG 检索源码、API、日志和历史 artifact，确保代码生成前有证据； 用 patch proposal 和 review gate 阻止 scope creep 与无证据修改； 用 dry-run/build/runtime evidence 形成安全闭环； 用 evaluation harness 和 dashboard 让 agent 决策质量可以被观察和回归。 ``` 这段话中的每个名词都必须能在代码、artifact、测试或 dashboard 中找到对应实现。 --- # 37. Confidence, Context, and Documentation Honesty 本节专门回应一个现实问题：大文档如何被 agent 稳定使用。 ## 44.1 200KB Markdown 是否难以读取 200KB Markdown 对一次性完整推理确实不理想。问题不是“读不了”，而是： ```text 一次性塞入上下文会挤压代码、测试输出和当前任务空间； 长文档容易让 agent 记住目录却漏掉执行细节； 如果没有章节索引和任务模板，后续会话容易只读一部分就开始写。 ``` 因此，本项目必须采用分层读取策略： ```text 先读 0 / 0A / 当前 phase / 36 / 42； 实现某模块时再读对应设计章； 需要 RAG 时读 37； 需要多模态时读 38； 需要 dashboard 时读 39； 需要测试时读 41。 ``` ## 44.2 文档可执行深度 以后不按文档长度判断成熟度，而按检查表判断： ```text 是否有设计策略名词？ 是否有具体执行步骤？ 是否有配置示例？ 是否有类和函数？ 是否有测试方法？ 是否有验收标准？ 是否有失败路径？ 是否有实现边界和下一步能力？ ``` 缺少关键项时，将该章标为“需要补齐执行深度”，并列出下一步。 ## 44.3 后续文档收口标准 DEV_SPEC 最终收口时要满足： ```text 每个核心模块都有 deep dive； 每个 phase 都有 task-level checklist； 每个 task 都有 files/classes/tests/acceptance； README 只摘取可展示内容，不复制全部 DEV_SPEC； SKILL.md 强制 agent 按 phase 读取，而不是全量盲读； Demo script 只展示已经由 artifact/test/eval 支撑的能力。 ``` --- # 45. 48.1 Engineering Spec Standards 成熟工程 spec 的结构来自三类方法的叠加： | 方法 | 给本项目的启发 | | --- | --- | | arc42 | 把 goals、constraints、solution strategy、building blocks、runtime view、crosscutting concepts、quality requirements、risks 分开写 | | C4 | 从 system context、container、component、code 分层，并补 dynamic/deployment 视图 | | ADR | 对关键技术决策记录 decision、rationale、trade-off、consequence | 落到本项目，每个核心模块都要回答： ```text 为什么存在？ 输入输出是什么？ 使用什么命名策略？ 主流程、失败流程、阻塞流程是什么？ 关键 artifact/schema/config 长什么样？ 代码落在哪些目录、类、函数？ 如何 trace、metric、log、dashboard 展示？ 如何测试和评估？ 做到什么才算完成？ 哪些事情明确不做？ 为什么这样取舍？ ``` ## Physical storage uses a short deterministic locator only to keep the local write path addressable: ```text features/<feature_id>/<artifact_type>.json -> mutable latest envelope projection features/<feature_id>/r/<artifact_type>/<artifact_hash first 32 hex>.json -> immutable committed revision locator features/<feature_id>/p/<artifact_type>/<artifact_hash first 32 hex>.json -> internal pending-write marker ``` The 32-hex locator is not revision identity. An existing short-locator file is read and checked against the complete hash, feature id, artifact type, schema, and envelope content before it can be reused. A different complete hash at the same locator is a deterministic collision and blocks overwrite. Write-time idempotence checks the exact legacy full-hash revision location before the short-locator location. A valid legacy revision is reused without copy, migration, or a second revision file. Explicit `ArtifactRef` reads use the persisted path and validate that referenced revision only; they do not scan other revisions or rewrite old paths. Legacy pending markers are not recovered or migrated by this compatibility boundary. The commit order remains: ```text pending marker -> immutable revision -> latest envelope projection -> pending marker cleanup ``` Each file is written through a short same-directory temporary file, followed by flush, `fsync`, and `os.replace`. Parent directories are created before the replace operation. Pending data records the complete artifact hash and the actual intended revision and latest locations; identity is never inferred from the abbreviated filename. Before `intelligent-evidence-request` constructs or invokes the graph, model, or evidence tools, `ArtifactStore` probes the actual pending, revision, and latest write locations for `evidence_run_attempt`, `request_planning_report`, `mod_planning_brief`, `feature_spec`, and `evidence_pack`. The probe uses the production locator and atomic-write implementation, removes its reserved probe files after success, and creates no business revision, latest projection, `ArtifactRef`, or upstream binding. A recognized unaddressable-path replace failure returns the existing CLI top-level `BLOCKED` result with exit code 2 and a machine-readable diagnostic: ```text category = infrastructure_preflight_failure component = artifact_store stage = artifact_preflight code = artifact_path_unaddressable operation = os.replace model_execution_started = false tool_execution_started = false model_call_count = 0 tool_call_count = 0 details include artifact_type, path_role, path lengths, parent existence, and the operating-system error number without absolute local paths ``` Unknown `OSError` values are not relabeled as this path failure. The historical blocked run's observed process exit code remains 1; current source and focused tests prove exit code 2 for the new recognized preflight branch but do not explain or rewrite that historical discrepancy. The verified reliability claim is limited to the current Windows process, local NTFS artifact root, and single-process evidence-only write chain. It does not establish arbitrary path-length support, a Windows-specific path layer, cross-process locking, fallback storage, dual writes, migration, retention, garbage collection, or crash recovery beyond the normal pending commit flow. ### 49.2.8 Durable Evidence Attempt Identity And Provider Diagnostics `intelligent-evidence-request` writes an `evidence_run_attempt` revision with status `running`, `run_validity=attempt_started`, and `terminal_stage=before_graph` before `graph.invoke` can make the first model call. A terminal `success` or `failed` revision uses the same `run_id`; an external call that later fails validation therefore remains bound to a durable attempt identity even when no EvidencePack is produced. The terminal revision records model and external-model call counts, accepted model actions, executed evidence tools, failure attribution, and one sanitized provider-turn envelope per provider response. Each tool-call diagnostic keeps `provider_reported_tool_name` and `adapter_extracted_tool_name` as distinct values and also records `normalized_tool_name`, `normalization_applied`, JSON validity, argument SHA256, provider request and tool-call ids, finish reason, API type, streaming state, and reported usage. It does not persist API keys, complete prompts, source roots, or raw tool arguments. The production Qwen Evidence request explicitly uses `stream=false`. Unknown tool names fail before evidence-tool execution and do not trigger an automatic provider retry. `accepted_model_actions` counts accepted model tool actions and an accepted model finish; a deterministic control-plane finish is not counted. These fields provide run diagnosis and attribution evidence. They do not prove semantic correctness or authorize later workflow stages. --- ## 49.3 Change Control Chain This section deepens Planning, Patch Proposal, and Review Gate as one continuous control V2 Real-Task Intelligence Transfer Program This chapter defines the V2 capability program that begins after the controlled workflow baseline exists. It supersedes any interpretation of V2 as a list of frameworks to install or as a replay of the stage names Proposal, dry-run, apply, build, and runtime. V2 is advanced through one real product request at a time. The current request is WallCrawler. Platform infrastructure may grow only when the current run exposes an exact missing capability, protocol failure, evidence gap, or verification failure. ## 51.1 Problem, Goal, And Optimization Target The implemented control plane can already route planning, evidence, Proposal, review, dry-run, approval, isolated apply, build, runtime, and repair. That proves controlled execution behavior. It does not by itself prove that the platform has taken over the substantive decisions that an operator previously performed. The unproven decisions include: ```text which registered source is relevant; which bounded evidence tool should run first; which symbol is discovered from the observation rather than supplied manually; which dependent tool call follows from that symbol; what the observed evidence proves and does not prove; whether the current tool set is sufficient; whether the run should finish, block, or request one bounded capability. ``` Without this capability, the operator or Codex can precompute paths, symbols, tool order, IL reports, and blockers while LangGraph only validates the answer. That is a controlled workflow, not demonstrated intelligence transfer. The V2 optimization target is therefore: ```text maximize verified platform-owned task decisions inside a real request while preserving deterministic route, permission, evidence, write, and claim authority ``` The target is not maximum autonomy, maximum model calls, maximum tool count, or minimum human approval. Human approval remains mandatory where disclosure, write, game launch, game-directory copy, or runtime control requires it. ## 51.2 Status And Authority Model Architecture references use the existing exact states: - `implemented`: current source plus focused evidence supports the recorded claim boundary; - `documented_only`: responsibility separation or a possible design, not an implementation or queue entry; - `conditional_trigger`: implementation may be selected only after the exact real-task signal named by the reference is recorded. Implementation status and semantic evidence status are separate. A model adapter or loop can be implemented and locally tested while real-model semantic quality remains unproven. The single LangGraph `StateGraph` remains the control plane. Specialist loops operate inside their nodes. They cannot authorize paths or writes, approve a Proposal, launch build/runtime work, or choose final graph routes. ArtifactStore owns durable outputs and lineage. Deterministic policy owns validation and promotion. ## 51.3 V2 Program Shape V2-C was an experimental intelligence-loop gate and is now frozen after one real repaired-path core closure. It does not continue as the V2 product mainline. Later conditional product gates require a separate mainline reconstruction decision first. ### 51.3.1 Core Intelligence-Transfer Gate ```text V2-A controlled intelligent input -> V2-B bounded intelligent loop inside retrieve_evidence -> V2-C real WallCrawler run with no manual answers -> V2-D add only the exact capability or loop repair exposed by that run -> rerun V2-C -> resolve the intelligence-transfer gate truthfully ``` The gate can resolve with grounded `needs_more_evidence`. It does not require WallCrawler Hook feasibility or Proposal readiness. It does require the model to perform an observation-dependent evidence sequence and finish truthfully within the configured boundary. The repaired-path run recorded in section 51.6 resolves this experimental core claim once. That result is retained as feasibility evidence and reusable observation/decision/action/verification/stop contracts. It does not establish an authoritative Agent entry, unified run state, canonical runtime path, converged retry/termination ownership, reconstructable source baseline, or V2 product completion. V2-D no longer derives work from that closure. ### 51.3.2 Mainline Reconstruction Before Product Gates Before selecting another product capability, perform only a read-only, evidence-only reconstruction of one current real Agent run when its entry conditions are satisfied: ```text control path: admission -> source/authorization/scope -> queue -> readiness -> retry/stop/abstain -> completion; intelligent execution path: goal -> observation -> interpretation -> decision -> action -> new observation -> verification -> continue/stop; evidence path: run identity -> source revision -> model/tool calls -> state transitions -> artifacts -> validation evidence -> final verdict. ``` Every path edge must be classified as `observed`, `source-confirmed`, `inferred`, or `unknown` and bound to source or trace where applicable. The reconstruction must identify entry points, state ownership, retry ownership, stop/completion ownership, Artifact ownership, the V2-C loop's actual position, legacy/experiment isolation, and the minimum evidence break when a canonical path cannot be selected. The read-only result must contain: ```text one actual path map whose nodes record source, entry condition, state reads, state writes, next hop, runtime observation, and evidence location; an entry-point inventory separating production, experiment, legacy, retry/resume, callback, test, and unknown entries; a state-ownership table identifying creators, writers, authority, persistence, duplicate concepts, and memory/artifact/queue conflicts; a V2-C disposition for each component: REUSE_AS_MAINLINE_COMPONENT REUSE_AS_CONTRACT REUSE_AS_TEST_FIXTURE ARCHIVE_AS_EXPERIMENT UNKNOWN_NEEDS_EVIDENCE; one reviewable mainline recommendation or the minimum evidence gap that blocks selection. ``` The reconstruction must abstain from a canonical-path claim when no real run can be matched, the run cannot be associated with source evidence, critical state exists only in an inaccessible system, multiple entries cannot be distinguished by trace, dynamic registration/reflection/external callbacks are not visible, further work requires an unauthorized external model, or the path could be asserted only from identifier names. `source_binding_status=missing` still permits a bounded runtime-path observation but not a reproducible source-level baseline. This is not an active task until the available Source Registry, readable trace/EvidencePack, files in scope, authorization boundary, and no-write acceptance conditions are checked. `current_queue` remains `None`. ### 51.3.3 Conditional Delivery-Intelligence Gates Only after the experimental core gate is resolved and runtime-path reconstruction supports one authoritative mainline may a separately selected product request activate one later gate: ```text evidence-to-implementation planning -> Proposal-only generation and review -> deterministic dry-run and exact approval -> isolated apply and real build -> failure-driven build repair when observed -> separately approved runtime evidence and diagnosis -> evaluation, delivery, repair, or explicit unresolved handoff ``` These are not a preapproved consecutive queue. Each gate has its own entry evidence, selected capability, permission boundary, verification, and stop condition. Dry-run and apply remain deterministic control mechanisms; no model role is added merely because a later stage exists. ### 51.3.4 V2 Productization Acceptance Boundary V2 is not complete merely because V2-C closed once. Productized V2 requires: 1. one declared authoritative mainline, with adapters, legacy paths, and experiments classified explicitly; 2. one authoritative run-state contract; the exact current schema and owner must be established from source rather than invented in this document; 3. the intelligent loop invoked from a real product entry instead of only a test or experiment entry; 4. every action followed by a new observation and verification rather than a model self-report being accepted as environmental success; 5. explicit terminal semantics for at least `completed`, `abstained`, `blocked`, `failed`, `paused`, and `retryable`; 6. reconstructable bindings for source revision, configuration, model/tool identity, artifacts, and runtime trace; 7. one real product capability traversing admission, semantic, capability, readiness, intelligent loop, action, re-observation, verification, convergence assessment, and terminal state through that mainline; 8. every V2-C part either absorbed as a mainline component or formal contract, retained as a regression fixture, archived as an experiment, or explicitly left unknown pending evidence. Independent semantic, capability, readiness, and convergence verdicts do not constitute independent orchestration paths. One authoritative control path must consume them without allowing conflicting state ownership. ## 51.4 V2-A Controlled Intelligent Input ### 51.4.1 Input Representation The model input combines: ```text natural-language product goal; path-hidden Source Registry views; allowed read-only tools per source; model-step, tool-call, result-byte, and total-observation budgets; external disclosure boundary; evidence-only stopping boundary; current compact action/observation trajectory; deduplicated metadata-method and IL-inspection catalogs; latest full observation only. ``` Machine-local roots, API keys, write targets, and unrestricted filesystem access are not model input. Source identity is preserved through registered source id, relative path, live file identity, assembly identity where applicable, and current-run observation identity. ### 51.4.2 Information Preserved And Lost The representation preserves: ```text the product goal; which evidence classes and tools are available; the current source and assembly identity; the exact observed method identity needed for dependent IL work; the exact direct IL identity, method-body outcome, instruction count, and inspection observation id after its full payload rotates out; prior action summaries and observation ids; budget, stop state, and per-turn serialized discovery-message byte counts. ``` It intentionally removes: ```text absolute local paths; unrelated source trees; earlier full observations after their compact identities are recorded; hidden model reasoning; unapproved local material; operator-supplied answers that would make the intelligence claim circular. ``` Loss is acceptable only when the compact trajectory retains every identity required for a legal dependent action. If a required source, method identity, constraint, or observation reference is lost, the run blocks or the context representation is repaired; the model may not reconstruct it by guessing. ### 51.4.3 Input-Pollution Boundary A V2-C acceptance run requires all four current audit counts to remain zero: ```text manual_symbol_count manual_tool_sequence_count precomputed_report_count operator_intervention_count ``` The user may approve sources and data disclosure. This is an experiment-traceability limitation and does not authorize another semantic or validation expansion without a concrete false acceptance, false rejection, missing diagnostic, or gate conflict. V2-C is frozen at this point as a `V2 intelligence-loop validation spike`. Grounded/walkable behavior, collision/contact response, and every other gameplay direction remain unselected. No further V2-C rerun, V2-D capability, or Proposal-oriented continuation is implied by the closure. ## 51.7 V2-D Failure-Driven Capability Growth V2-D records the bounded repair policy used while the V2-C experiment was active. It is `conditional_trigger`, not an open tool-building phase. After the recorded core closure, this path is frozen and cannot derive another product or gameplay task. | Observed failure class | Allowed response | Forbidden expansion | | --- | --- | --- | | provider request or response mismatch | repair the current adapter mapping and add a captured regression | replace the control plane or build a generic provider router | | action/schema failure | repair the exact tool/final contract or validation feedback | weaken deterministic validation | | repeated work or context growth | repair trajectory reconstruction, observation shape, deduplication, or post-inspection stop signaling; 009 applies this to the 008 direct-IL loss | add unbounded chat memory or silently enable provider-side retained conversation state | | metadata result noise | narrow the current query/result representation | activate Dense/RRF/rerank without a measured retrieval failure | | missing current method identity | add the smallest current-source identity lookup proven necessary | build a general decompiler platform | | missing native mapping | add one bounded read-only mapping tool for the exact registered material | claim native semantics from interop wrappers | | tool process failure | repair the registered local tool invocation and evidence reporting | allow unrestricted Shell or target execution | | grounded `needs_more_evidence` | select one exact evidence acquisition task | convert an unresolved gap into Proposal readiness | | semantic irrelevance | repair source projection, query choice, or the exact missing evidence tool | pass because the trajectory was structurally valid | During an explicitly active V2-C experiment, each repair has a finite retry budget and returns to the same acceptance run. Repeated failure at the stop condition yields an explicit unresolved or blocked handoff. The current frozen experiment authorizes no such return. ## 51.8 Conditional Post-Core Capability Gates The following design is deeper than a stage list. Each gate defines the decision capability to prove, its input representation, deterministic authority, failure boundary, and evidence required for promotion. These gates are not selectable until section 51.3.2 reconstructs enough of one real runtime path to identify an authoritative entry, run state, action and verification boundaries, retry owner, stop/completion owner, Artifact owner, and the V2-C integration or isolation point. Missing source-revision binding permits a runtime-path observation but forbids a reproducible source-level canonical-path claim. ### 51.8.1 Evidence-To-Implementation Planning Entry trigger: ```text the intelligence-transfer gate is resolved; the selected evidence decision supports planning; the user selects a Proposal-oriented product task. ``` Capability to prove: ```text transform FeatureSpec, EvidencePack, current Binding Registry, acceptance criteria, non-goals, and runtime applicability into a bounded implementation intent without inventing paths, symbols, Hooks, APIs, or configuration fields. ``` The model may propose change intent and unresolved alternatives. Deterministic validation owns target binding, writable scope, evidence refs, risk, and whether planning may continue. Missing Hook, source identity, configuration identity, or runtime plan blocks the gate. Promotion evidence is an implementation plan whose targets and claims are bound to current artifacts and source identity. The gate stops before source write. ### 51.8.2 Proposal-Only Generation And Review Entry trigger: ```text a current validated implementation plan exists; the Proposal-only task is explicitly selected; required source disclosure is approved for that generation run. ``` Capability to prove: ```text generate a minimal exact patch proposal from the bounded context pack and survive deterministic review without relying on copied or invented authority. ``` The Proposal context preserves exact evidence refs, target bindings, source excerpts, acceptance criteria, non-goals, side-effect boundaries, and rollback intent. It excludes unrelated source and historical chat. ProposalReviewer remains authoritative. ProposalCritic is called only when the explicit `critic_requirement` requires it. A review failure may select one proposal-repair task; it cannot authorize a write or activate parallel critics, Worker self-check, or second-level Critic without the documented real failure trigger. Promotion evidence is a reviewed Proposal that is allowed to enter dry-run. The gate performs no source write. ### 51.8.3 Deterministic Dry-Run And Exact Approval Entry trigger: ```text Proposal review permits dry-run; current bindings and source identities are fresh. ``` No new model intelligence is required by default. The capability is deterministic simulation and user inspection: ```text fresh live-source read; exact before/after display; unique-match and path validation; no-write result; exact context/diff hash; explicit approval boundary. ``` Conflict, ambiguity, stale binding, or source drift blocks. A model may explain the conflict only in a separately selected repair task; it cannot reinterpret the approved bytes. ### 51.8.4 Isolated Apply And Real Build Entry trigger: ```text the user approves the exact displayed hash; fresh source and Binding Registry checks still match. ``` Apply remains deterministic and isolated. Build uses the declared profile and must verify the expected artifact identity. Neither exit code zero nor DLL existence alone proves runtime behavior. If build fails, the next intelligence capability is not generic self-healing. It is a failure-evidence-bound repair loop: ```text compiler diagnostics and build log refs -> bounded root-cause hypothesis -> minimal repair intent -> new Proposal -> normal review, dry-run, approval, apply, and build gates ``` The repair model cannot edit directly, broaden scope without evidence, or skip review because the failure occurred after approval. ### 51.8.5 Runtime Evidence And Diagnosis Entry trigger: ```text the selected request requires runtime acceptance; a verified build artifact exists; the user separately approves each required game copy, launch, process, capture, or manual observation action. ``` Runtime intelligence is evidence interpretation, not autonomous game control. It receives only approved logs, screenshots, probe output, manual notes, current build identity, environment identity, acceptance criteria, and non-goals. The runtime gate must separate: ```text startup/load evidence; configuration and identity binding evidence; gameplay behavior evidence; non-goal preservation evidence; missing or contradictory signals. ``` A build-level fact cannot become a gameplay claim. A local probe cannot become real game evidence. A runtime failure may select one bounded diagnosis/repair task, which re-enters Proposal review and the normal execution gates. ### 51.8.6 Evaluation, Delivery, And Reuse Delivery claims use the weakest evidence boundary. Evaluation records the selected case, route, evidence sufficiency, Hook/file correctness where ground truth exists, review correctness, repair attempts, token usage, latency, human interventions, runtime applicability, and limitations. One successful WallCrawler run proves that bound task and environment only. It does not establish cross-project generality. Artifact history and Git preserve audit lineage; they do not become learned memory or policy. Reusable lessons remain planning-only and require a separately triggered experiment under the long-term memory rules. ## 51.9 Task Promotion Contract Only one selected product task enters `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_QUEUE.md`. A V2 task record must identify: ```text the concrete product decision or observed failure; the intelligence capability being transferred; the current source, artifact, log, or runtime evidence; the model and tool input representation; the information intentionally excluded; the deterministic authority that remains outside the model; the exact permissions and disclosure required; the focused verification and real-run acceptance; the stop condition and conditional next outcomes. ``` A later gate is not activated because it appears in this chapter. It activates only when the preceding real result supplies its exact trigger and the user or product decision selects it. ## 51.10 Current WallCrawler Mapping Current verified mapping: | Work | V2 role | Current claim | | --- | --- | --- | | `WALLCRAWLER-PLAN-001` through `WALLCRAWLER-CURRENT-HOOK-EVIDENCE-003` | real request, deterministic Evidence, source/tool baseline | supporting evidence and regression baseline; not intelligent-transfer proof | | `WALLCRAWLER-INTELLIGENT-EVIDENCE-004` | V2-A and V2-B plus first V2-C attempt | bounded loop implemented; prior real Qwen run ended without conclusion | | acceptance-hardening insertion | failure-driven validation repair | conclusion, provenance, identity, budget, and input-audit boundaries tested locally | | `WALLCRAWLER-INTELLIGENT-EVIDENCE-005` | failure-driven provider/context/observation repair | structured turns and compact context tested locally; no new real-model semantic acceptance | | `WALLCRAWLER-INTELLIGENT-EVIDENCE-006` | post-005 V2-C real-model acceptance | real Qwen used six focused metadata searches and only 20,001 observation bytes, but never selected IL and failed two exact finish validations; intelligence transfer remains unresolved | | `WALLCRAWLER-INTELLIGENT-EVIDENCE-007` | 006-triggered V2-D contract/progress repair | one exact nested finish schema is shared across model response format, system context, and bounded correction; metadata/IL observation progress and remaining acceptance requirements are locally tested with unchanged tools and budgets; no external model call | | `WALLCRAWLER-INTELLIGENT-EVIDENCE-008` | post-007 V2-C real-model acceptance | real Qwen converged in 7 steps, selected one metadata-derived IL read, and emitted a valid `needs_more_evidence` finish; the gate remains unresolved because no grounded conclusion cited the IL observation and later compact context misrepresented the successful IL step as `observed_methods: []` | | `WALLCRAWLER-INTELLIGENT-EVIDENCE-009` | 008-triggered V2-D compact-IL and convergence repair | direct IL outcomes survive in a deduplicated inspection catalog, repeated metadata method identities collapse, the latest full observation is not duplicated, per-turn message bytes are recorded, and missing IL citation receives one bounded correction; 75 focused tests passed with unchanged tools and budgets and no external call | | `WALLCRAWLER-LOCAL-MODEL-EVIDENCE-011` | loopback-only local real-model acceptance plus local provider boundary | Ollama native tools and separate hidden gates are implemented and 85 focused tests pass; the one real local run used six metadata searches with three repeated signatures, selected no IL, and failed capability, convergence, and semantic gates while preserving local-data and evidence-only boundaries | | `WALLCRAWLER-INTELLIGENT-EVIDENCE-012` | 011-triggered V2-D query-semantics and exact-repeat repair | prompt v5 states the actual literal managed-symbol query semantics; exact repeated source/tool/arguments are rejected before execution with one repeat-specific answer-free correction; deterministic recovery reaches changed metadata query, observation-derived IL, and grounded conclusion; a second repeat stops; 198 affected tests pass with no real model call, tool addition, or runtime-budget increase | | `WALLCRAWLER-LOCAL-MODEL-EVIDENCE-013` | post-012 same-model local V2-C rerun | exact 011 input and 4B Q4 identity preserved; 5 turns and 3 tools reached observation-derived IL with no repeat; two invalid finishes exhausted correction, no accepted final conclusion survived, all hidden gates failed, and Proposal remained locked | | `WALLCRAWLER-INTELLIGENT-EVIDENCE-014` | 013-triggered V2-D query/finish/provenance repair | prompt v6 removes copyable argument values, shares finish cross-field rules across initial and correction context, and separates valid method-origin provenance from convergence; 31 direct and 199 affected deterministic tests pass with unchanged tools, budgets, and evidence-only stop; no real model call | | `WALLCRAWLER-LOCAL-MODEL-EVIDENCE-015` | post-014 same-model local V2-C rerun | exact request/source/model/budget boundaries preserved; the removed placeholder was not copied, but identical zero-result query strings were used across both sources and repeat correction exhausted before method_id or IL; 4 turns, 2 metadata tools, no model conclusion, all hidden gates false, Proposal locked | | 2026-07-17 artifact persistence validation | infrastructure unblock plus one bounded local execution | short physical locators, complete-hash collision checks, legacy revision reads, atomic preflight, and structured CLI blocking are implemented; run `intelligent_evidence_5327cb5988774bc5aba6cfcc53f8d2ab` persisted all evidence-only artifacts and then ended `budget_exhausted`; all V2-C gates remain false | | 2026-07-18 external Qwen evidence-loop validation | attempt diagnostics plus real candidate_ref identity loop | checkpoint `5c78e06` durably binds pre-call and terminal attempt revisions and sanitized provider diagnostics; one approved `qwen3.6-plus` run completed four metadata searches, two candidate_ref-derived IL reads, and a grounded-abstention finish with complete provenance, but the current semantic evaluator produced a demonstrated false positive and is not invoked by this provider path; V2-C and implementation readiness remain false | | 2026-07-18 repaired semantic core closure | frozen V2 intelligence-loop validation spike | run `intelligent_evidence_36d25ed53f3447e3adeaa71f42fb7ec0` provides one real capability=true and semantic=true core closure with convergence=false, readiness=partial, Proposal locked, and `source_binding_status=missing`; reusable contracts are retained, but the experiment does not define the Agent mainline or derive another product task | The 006-exposed model-facing acceptance-contract repair is complete as 007 and was exercised exactly once by 008. The 008-exposed compact IL, inspection- citation, and post-IL convergence failure is repaired locally as 009. It does not authorize a larger budget, a new tool, Proposal, implementation, provider- side conversation retention, or another external run. 011 later exercised the same loop through a literal-loopback local model and exposed identifier-query and repeated-action failures; 012 repairs those two contracts locally without resolving real-model intelligence transfer. 013 then reached IL without a repeat but failed final-schema convergence and exposed query-placeholder plus provenance-report coupling. 014 repairs those three structural defects locally. 015 exercised prompt v6 once without copying the removed placeholder but failed before IL because it did not revise zero-result literal symbol queries and then exhausted repeat correction. It therefore does not validate the finish or provenance repairs and does not select another repair automatically. The later repaired semantic core closure supersedes those unresolved historical states for the narrow feasibility claim. The V2-C branch is now frozen. Any future reuse must be classified through runtime-path reconstruction as a mainline component, reusable contract, regression fixture, archived experiment, or evidence gap; successful execution inside V2-C does not promote the whole path into the Agent runtime. ## 51.11 Non-Goals This program does not authorize: ```text an always-on multi-agent swarm; top-level ReAct migration; parallel specialist fan-out without a separable real risk; two-level Critic without the recorded cross-context review failure; Dense, RRF, rerank, or formal retrieval expansion without measured need; a generic decompiler or native reverse-engineering platform; automatic source, Hook, path, permission, or write authority selection; automatic game copy, launch, process control, or gameplay claim; long-term memory, policy learning, or threshold tuning from chat history; framework installation as a substitute for a verified product capability; treating V2-C as a parallel continuing product route after its frozen closure; selecting another gameplay capability before the authoritative runtime path is reconstructed and manually reviewed. ```

documents.title: 2026-09-09 真实运行触发的请求准入修复
documents.text: # 2026-09-09 真实运行触发的请求准入修复 本轮由用户明确执行旧分页、嵌套快照、Findings及FirstShot验证，并要求实测问题触发修复。原运行固定 `7faf3a32c44606b166549638d94b35758d7e6b90`，原记录及执行树不改。两个工程缺口分别有原始阻断记录，没有将它们归为模型修码失败。 ## 分页：首请求的保守字节门槛 新分页attempt的首个worker调用被provider发送前的准入检查拒绝：HTTP body的UTF-8代理值13,710，加4,096输出额度为17,806，超过原16,384配置。已预留一次worker调用，但没有开始native模型发送；后续本题仅安排最多四次新增调用，不退款或重领五次。 原始结果位于输出根 `scratch/repair_actual_7faf_001/owned/paging_partial_tail/attempt/actual/summary.json`，SHA-256 `bad4bdd95b7517132802fd408fd9b8411d499424c2111933c25a90113f114465`。该代理不是已测得的native token数量，不能据此宣称模型实际token超窗。 修复只精简native固定规则、source工具说明及重复inspection尾句。任务、B0、C1、F1、完整工作视图、工具参数、schema、模型/输出/观察额度和原准入检查均不变；两条legacy提示的原字节哈希保持。逐条语义核对保存于输出根 `scratch/repair_native_context_001/validation/RULE_PRESERVATION.md`。这是规则文字去重改写，不是原提示的逐字可逆编码。 实际保留请求的离线重放：原13,710被拒；新真实PreparedNative渲染12,273，加4,096为16,369，原gate放行且本地fake sender仅一次。只证明该输入可被准入，余量15字节不代表其他输入均可通过；没有网络/模型调用或编造校准值。精确证据是同目录 `final-reviewed-green.json`。 ## FirstShot：已有Repair上下文被重复预留 新FirstShot初次尝试在模型调用前停止，原journal模型调用数0。C1/F1及当前代码视图实际消费26,737字节，最大注册源码窗5,789；旧fresh初稿规则又预留26,737+5,789=32,526，致使32,768总额仅剩242可供当前上下文准入，错误地挡住首发。 已绑定并获准的Repair现在不再使用fresh初稿预留；当前消息仍计26,737，硬上限32,768不变，fresh生成及真正超额的停止行为不变。修复是已有Repair阶段与fresh阶段的区分，不是扩张预算。 实际材料无模型预检仍暴露下一独立门槛：新的首请求body59,605，加4,096后为63,701，超过原49,152保守代理门槛。此处尚未解决；不能因重复预留的回归通过就宣布FirstShot已可实际首发或模型已修好。证据为输出根 `scratch/repair_native_context_001/firstshot-request-preview-001/summary.json`，SHA-256 `38e33fea1a9da46f17bda600e106665f8ca20a018144b540bfa475071ef1463b`。 旧C1只用于验证器准备：完整项目编译、13项配置、原36项分别实际执行；原行为仍33/36。旧临时B0副本缺失已按原checker重新建立基线；旧matrix输出范围限制通过修正新配置实例解决，没有修改原矩阵或原输出。 ## 验证 使用已有仓库虚拟环境，短系统临时目录，全部模型传输为明确替身： - native文字：私有旧请求红→绿；公开10项通过（4.86s）；native/codegen/loop/引用/CLI/adapter一次218项checkpoint通过（20.23s）。 - Repair预留：2红→2绿，另2边界保持；相邻Repair一次31项checkpoint通过（23.84s）。 - 合并两改动后：46项checkpoint首次45通过/1失败（50.25s）。失败测试以固定失败Repair冒充fresh初稿，仍期待fresh预留。改为明确fresh输入保留旧预留断言，并增加已有Repair可以纠正格式的相反场景；仅这两项复跑通过（4.50s），没有改生产逻辑绕过失败。 主要命令（两次checkpoint选择存在重叠，不相加作独立任务数）： ```powershell python -B -m pytest tests/unit/test_native_patch_rule_context.py tests/unit/test_patch_code_generator.py tests/unit/test_patch_agent_loop.py tests/unit/test_patch_excerpt_references.py tests/unit/test_patch_tool_effects_cli.py tests/unit/test_agent_turn_adapters.py -q --tb=short -n 2 --dist=loadfile python -B -m pytest tests/unit/test_initial_repair_reservation.py tests/unit/test_patch_repair_continuation.py tests/unit/test_patch_recovery_worker.py -q --tb=short -n 2 --dist=loadfile python -X utf8 -B -m pytest tests/unit/test_initial_repair_reservation.py tests/unit/test_native_patch_rule_context.py tests/unit/test_continuous_behavior_repair.py tests/unit/test_patch_submission_cli.py tests/unit/test_patch_upstream_unchanged_plan.py -q --tb=short -n 2 --dist=loadfile --basetemp="$env:TEMP\native-merged-0909" python -X utf8 -B -m pytest tests/unit/test_patch_submission_cli.py::test_format_correction_cannot_spend_model_turns_reserved_for_behavior_repair tests/unit/test_patch_submission_cli.py::test_bound_repair_can_correct_format_without_a_second_fresh_reservation -q --tb=short --basetemp="$env:TEMP\native-followup-0909" ``` 这些工程结果不替代新模型验收；后续分页与快照使用新的固定源码/实例，原失败完整保留。FirstShot的第二层输入表示门槛继续作为明确未完成项。 ## 后续真实验收结果 冻结 `a8b89716976f87224f31e350ebd8db494f9800a6` 的一次验收已完成：分页2次实际模型请求、原7/7；嵌套快照4次请求、首份新输出2/4，同worker消费本次失败后修订为4/4。两者通过原Review和无写入Dry-run，停在精确差异批准之前；没有Apply、正式产品Build或游戏Runtime。分页仍保留旧预留1次，逻辑累计3/5；快照使用4/5，没有强迫花完额度。 完整新输入、两次真实运行及三份矩阵的证据只在输出根 [acceptance-results.md](C:/Users/10160/.codex/visualizations/2026/09/05/01a07014-bccb-7420-bbcd-38defc72fecb/scratch/repair_actual_native_002/acceptance-results.md) 记录。任务是既有开发回归和人工给定Plan的修复，不作为独立新题或自然语言到Runtime成绩。本次快照实际覆盖一次新的行为失败后自动修订，不扩张成连续两轮以上失败的实测结论。FirstShot仍阻断，独立题仍只准备。

documents.title: WallCrawler bounded-search evidence material
documents.text: authority: non_authoritative_derived_presentation # WallCrawler bounded-search evidence material ## Request boundary Read the exact UTF-8 request in `request.txt`. Its SHA256 is `B60BF872F06F8772B5D558629A1179A5D3E7C5E8CC463CEA33514596088B6F0A`. The request requires selected enemies to crawl on walls and ceilings only in configured areas while retaining normal AI movement, turning, actions, and attacks. Ceiling traversal uses a prone pose and is limited to enemies already supporting prone locomotion. The user-provided reference clue is preserved exactly as `bep/plugins/xxxrundowns/.json`. It is an investigation lead only. Its real path, filename pattern, JSON format, and field structure have not been verified and are not inferred here. Ladder logic is also an implementation hint, not a required mechanism. ## Current physical facts - Search-root allowlist: `Assets/Scripts/Modules-ASM`, `Datablocks`. - Expected canonical snapshot: 3,196 files, `sha256:40ed82c420c7192f64c539cc983c40aae7e1a8fe221e0c2cd0e31964ace26ba2`. - R8 `Modules-ASM.dll` SHA256: `DD0C57D5C527E78B40FAB798456EDD73413DA0F140995A63FCA3619C36C32698`. - MVID: `28e7d845-eb8b-48af-a5b2-9b1addb278ae`. - The 11 fixed files are verified directly against `R8_EXPECTED_SHA256`. | Method | Token | Signature | Body fact | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `ES_PathMove.CommonFixedUpdate` | `0x06000B8C` | `200001` | `IL 002A` (`nop; ret`) | | `ES_PathMove.UpdateRotation` | `0x06000B8E` | `200001` | `IL 002A` (`nop; ret`) | | `ES_PathMoveBase.UpdateRotation` | `0x06000B93` | `200001` | abstract, RVA `0`, no body | All three exact symbols were found, but their bodies establish `searched_and_absent_behavioral_semantics`, not `not_found`. Product readiness, `can_generate_patch`, blocker codes, and prior Agent/RAG output remain non-authoritative. The bound R8 sources also expose `ES_ClimbLadder` start position, end position, normal, move target, and `OffMeshLink` fields; `EnemyLocomotion` exposes `PathMove`, `ClimbLadder`, `EnemyCrawlFlip`, and `EnemyCrawl`; course-node, zone, area, and layout declarations expose structural identities. These are bounded investigation leads only. They do not prove that the requested movement, AI, animation, attack, and configuration capabilities compose. ## Evidence gaps for independent technical review 1. arbitrary-surface movement rather than only a fixed ladder route; 2. wall/ceiling acquisition and usable surface normals; 3. movement and turning in a surface-relative coordinate frame; 4. integration with the existing AI rather than complete takeover or pause; 5. a JSON area-configuration entry point and runtime area binding; 6. default prohibition for unconfigured, unknown, or parse-failed areas; 7. reliable identification of enemies supporting a prone locomotion pose; 8. positive integration evidence that the mechanism does not inherently replace or disable normal attack state transitions. This material does not disclose or decide the provisional annotation, its hash, or a continue/block outcome. ## Later planning-stage details Planning or implementation may separately validate the exact wall/floor/ceiling transition algorithm, animation transition timing, attack-pose and hitbox tuning, collision parameters, concrete JSON field structure, per-enemy compatibility, and final Runtime behavior and visuals. These details are non-authoritative here and do not expand the judgment schema.

documents.title: Patch 上游续接
documents.text: # Patch 上游续接 现有 `continue-fresh-patch` 可通过 `--patch-upstream-config <本地配置文件>` 装配 Evidence / Planning provider。原 `--patch-worker-config` 继续选择共享 worker 和行为验证器。配置是输入，不授予模型披露、修改或审批权限。 配置的精确顶层字段为 `schema_version`（`patch_upstream_configuration_v1`）、 `planning_profile`、`evidence`。Profile 使用现有本地模型字段：`profile_version`、 `base_url`、`model`、`context_window`、`output_budget`、`timeout_seconds`。 `evidence` 可以为 null；启用时只含 `profile`、工作区内相对 `search_root` 和 `max_additional_queries`。加载和装配不调用模型。 本入口要求已绑定的 Repair 输入、启用恢复的原 worker 和允许上游请求的策略。 模型选择是否请求上游；没有请求时保留同 Plan 路径，不强制读取或重新规划。 当前不支持与 `--qualified-model-routing` 同时启用，不静默降级模型资格。 读取工具返回已登记源码或已保存API正文，不重算Evidence/Coverage或Plan。 上游工具请求重评Evidence支持/冲突/覆盖判断，或Planning目标/范围。引用已经存在 不排除需要重评；理由使用现有`reason`自由说明，无新增诊断JSON或固定调查顺序。 Graph在worker开始前按当前配置声明`upstream_effects`，初次生成和失败修订共同使用： | 值 | 当前接受请求后的执行后果 | | --- | --- | | `record_and_stop` | 保存请求并结束本次运行，不自动重评 | | `assess_then_stop` | 直接Graph尝试重评，成功后停在Plan，不继续Patch | | `assess_and_continue` | 公开入口可在准入及剩余预算内重评，再接新Plan下的Patch | | `provider_unavailable_stop` | 该owner未配置provider，保存请求后停止，不假称已经重评 | Evidence与Planning可以有不同后果。一个自动周期结束后，新worker仍可提出上游请求， 但声明会回到`record_and_stop`；工具不隐藏，请求不被静默替换为普通读取。 这些事实只说明执行能力，不证明模型选对了动作。 一次有界调用可以执行：当前被测代码及失败 → 上游请求 → 完整 Evidence/Coverage 重算（需要时）→ 模型 Planning → 新 Plan → 重建 worker/Binding 上下文 → 原行为 验证 → 新 Proposal/Review/Dry-run。`needs_evidence` 不回退到旧 Plan。 本次调用最多自动完成一个上游周期；后续明确上游请求保留为待处理结果，不发放额外尝试。 Patch、Query、Findings、Planning 共用原模型调用额度；新 worker 只继承剩余读取与 观察字节额度。额度为零仍允许合法直接输出，不强迫读取。预留/尝试、实际发送和收到 响应是不同事实。预算结束或异常不会自动重试或切换模型。 工具读取验证过的 B0 基线；正在修的代码是失败所引用的完整 assistant 输出。 新 Plan 输入保留旧失败作为诊断历史，旧 binding ID 不成为新权限。原成功标准保持； 验证器可读取当前 `implementation_plan`，同一配置的验证器实例保持连续报告身份。 固定旧 Plan 的领域验证器仍须先适配，不能仅因本入口可运行就宣称支持任意新 Plan。 旧 Proposal、Review 和批准不继承。新 Proposal 使用原 Builder/Reviewer，不变更 schema；工具轨迹留在原 journal。`patch_execution_segments` 分别记录各段 Plan 和 worker，`shared_model_budget` 记录整链预算；只读 `patch_execution_index` 保留各段 失败与末段结果，缺失信息显示 unknown。 工程验收使用合成源码和 HTTP 替身，实际运行原 CLI、取证、Planning、物化、行为 检查、Review 和 Dry-run。它证明接线和恢复能力，不证明真实模型修好 AccurateCrosshair。

documents.title: 核心能力
documents.text:
以源码证据驱动、以真实验收交付的 Coding Agent 平台

A coding agent platform that turns repository evidence into verified, controlled changes.

快速开始 · 核心模块 · Trace 示例 · 实测结果 · 架构文档 · 服务部署

--- RepoForge 面向新建、修改和修复代码库的自然语言任务，将**源码调查 → 补丁生成 → 编译与行为验收 → 授权交付**连接为可追溯工作流。首个验证领域是 C# / Unity / BepInEx / IL2CPP / Harmony 风格的 GTFO Mod，领域验收与共享 Agent 执行链分离，便于扩展其他工程场景。 ## 核心能力 - **从当前源码找到依据**：默认使用 ripgrep 活源检索，结合依赖 API、文档 RAG 与引用，为需求调查、规划和代码修改提供上下文。 - **让验收反馈驱动修订**：LangGraph 编排任务阶段，共享 Patch worker 接入真实编译与领域行为验收；失败反馈进入后续修订，候选可保存、复验和续接。 - **让修改和结果可复查**：精确 diff、源码身份、授权和适用验收绑定；ArtifactStore 保存产物与谱系，Trace 关联模型调用、工具观察和用量。 - **把 Agent 接入服务**：FastAPI 与独立 Worker 复用正常业务入口；Redis 提供队列、租约、幂等、限流和缓存，配合超时处理、Prometheus 与 Docker Compose。 ## 工作流 ```mermaid flowchart LR A[自然语言需求] --> B[新建 / 修改 / 继续修复] B --> C[源码与 API 调查] C --> D[计划与补丁] D --> E[编译与行为验收] E -->|失败反馈| D E -->|候选通过| F[Review / Dry-run] F --> G[精确授权] G --> H[隔离 Apply / Build / 复验] ``` **LangGraph** 负责业务编排，**RAG / 活源检索**提供调查依据，**ArtifactStore**保存产物谱系，**领域验收器**连接具体工程的编译和行为检查。模型服务支持本地 Ollama 与配置的外部提供方；执行范围见[产品契约](docs/ACTIVE_PRODUCT_CONTRACT.md)。 ## 核心模块与工程取舍 RepoForge 按“编排—证据—检索—生成—执行—验收—服务化”拆分职责；各模块通过显式产物与身份关联协作，领域规则与共享 Agent 控制面保持分离。 | 模块 | 职责与关键设计 | 代码 / 证据入口 | | --- | --- | --- | | **任务编排与状态机** | 将自然语言请求路由为新建、修改、续接或澄清任务；LangGraph 通过显式状态转移串联调查、计划、补丁、验收与失败修订，并支持 checkpoint、interrupt / resume。 | [请求路由](scripts/dsh_request_routing.py) · [工作流](src/mod_agent/workflow/graph.py) · [规划](src/mod_agent/planning/) | | **源码证据与上下文** | 默认从当前工作区执行 `rg` 活源检索与有界源码读取，校验证据身份、freshness、需求覆盖和可编辑范围；历史记忆与文档证据只作辅助，不能替代当前源码。 | [Evidence](src/mod_agent/evidence/) · [活源检索](src/mod_agent/evidence/rg_live.py) · [上下文策略](src/mod_agent/evidence/small_project_context.py) | | **RAG 知识检索** | 摄取链覆盖解析、切分、Embedding、BM25 与向量入库；查询层提供 Sparse / Dense / Hybrid、融合、重排和引用。Dense、RRF 与模型重排保持可选或实验定位，不冒充 Agent 默认取证路径。 | [Ingestion](src/ingestion/) · [Query Engine](src/core/query_engine/) · [检索决策](docs/RETRIEVAL_ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md) | | **补丁生成与受控执行** | Patch worker 在计划绑定的源码范围内生成最小变更；Review、Dry-run、源码 preimage、允许路径和授权共同约束副作用，再进入隔离 Apply / Build，行为失败可返回 Repair。 | [Patch loop](src/mod_agent/proposal/patch_agent_loop.py) · [受控执行](src/mod_agent/execution/) · [产品执行](src/mod_agent/product_execution.py) | | **领域验收与评测驱动** | 共享执行链接入编译检查和领域行为裁判，保留首个失败并把可操作反馈送回修订；结果区分 `code_ready`、`awaiting_approval` 与 `delivered`，不以局部通过替代交付。 | [领域验收](src/mod_agent/domain/) · [评测](src/mod_agent/evaluation/) · [EDD 口径](docs/EVALUATION_DRIVEN_DEVELOPMENT.md) | | **模型接入与训练实验** | 统一 LLM 抽象接入 Ollama、OpenAI、Azure 与 DeepSeek；Agent-turn 另提供 Ollama Chat、Qwen Chat 与 OpenAI Responses 适配器。QLoRA Patch SFT 与 Self-RAG 作为实验链保留，未因脚本存在而进入默认产品路径。 | [模型适配](src/libs/llm/) · [QLoRA SFT](scripts/run_patch_sft_training.py) · [Self-RAG](scripts/run_self_rag_training.py) | | **产物谱系、追踪与恢复** | ArtifactStore 保存 revision、哈希与 lineage；Trace 关联模型请求、工具观察、Token、验收和失败反馈，支持候选保存、复验与有界续接。外部可观测投影不替代业务事实。 | [ArtifactStore](src/mod_agent/artifacts/) · [Trace](src/core/trace/) · [Observability](src/observability/) | | **服务化与协议接入** | FastAPI、独立 Worker 与 Redis 实现异步队列、租约、幂等、限流、缓存和超时；Prometheus、Docker Compose 与 MCP 复用同一业务模块，而不是另写展示逻辑。 | [服务层](src/service_layer/) · [MCP](src/mcp_server/) · [部署指南](deployment/service/README.md) | ## 精简 Trace 示例 下面是 SpreadAPI 受控交付的公开投影，不是伪造的原始日志；本机路径、模型正文和敏感配置被省略，阶段结果仍绑定已记录的 Artifact 与验收身份。 ```json { "request": "非法数值输入原子拒绝，并保持状态与回调行为", "route": "modify_project", "baseline": {"behavior_checks": "53/87"}, "stages": [ {"stage": "evidence_retrieval", "status": "passed", "output": "evidence_pack"}, {"stage": "implementation_plan", "status": "passed", "output": "source-bound plan"}, {"stage": "patch_proposal", "status": "passed", "output": "exact diff"}, {"stage": "candidate_verification", "status": "passed", "behavior_checks": "87/87"}, {"stage": "task_delegation", "status": "approved", "binding": "diff + source snapshot + required checks + allowed effects"}, {"stage": "isolated_apply_and_build", "status": "passed"}, {"stage": "final_revalidation", "status": "passed", "behavior_checks": "87/87"} ], "result": "delivered", "scope": "候选与最终 DLL 各 9 个独立进程、60 个动作；跳过游戏回调主体；未启动游戏、未部署" } ``` 完整实验条件、Token 与边界见 [SpreadAPI 受控代码交付](docs/PUBLIC_RESULTS.md#34-spreadapi-受控代码交付)；本地记录可通过 [Trace 查询入口](scripts/product_trace.py)按明确 run 身份读取。 ## 已验证成果 | 方向 | 已记录结果 | 验证范围 | | --- | --- | --- | | **代码修改交付** | SpreadAPI 候选与正式 DLL 均通过 **87/87** 检查，并完成精确授权的 Apply / Build。 | 已暴露开发题的受控行为验收：9 个独立进程、60 个动作；跳过游戏回调主体。 | | **工程评测与修复** | 覆盖 **13 个模块、224 个不同工程用例**，最新结果 **222 通过**；定位并修复预算数值与验收产物身份绑定缺陷。 | 部分路径使用替身；其余 2 项训练依赖问题仍在迭代，工程用例数不等于用户任务数。 | | **服务故障恢复** | **11 项故障联调检查通过**，覆盖 Redis 中断与恢复、Worker 死亡后的租约接管、短预算超时。 | 实际服务进程联调；执行结果不明的 Agent 任务保留为 `indeterminate`，避免盲目重跑。 | | **异步检索性能** | 4 并发下 **64/64** 作业成功，**1.028 作业/秒，P95 4.031 秒**。 | 两个 Worker、6 个源码文件 / 37 块，单次纯 BM25 检索压测、模型调用 0；非完整 Agent 吞吐。 | 真实 Agent HTTP 入口也已接通 Qwen3-coder:30b 与 LangGraph：候选编译成功，**15/15 受控行为断言**通过，停在 `awaiting_approval`；尚未 Apply，完整交付仍在迭代。完整数据、成本、实验条件和历史结果见[公开实测记录](docs/PUBLIC_RESULTS.md)。 ## 快速开始 ### 本机体验 环境：Python 3.10+、`uv`；源码调查使用 `rg`。以下命令验证入口并生成只读工程导航，不调用模型： ```powershell git clone https://github.com/yang-hoo-xin/RepoForge.git cd RepoForge uv sync --frozen --extra dev uv run --frozen python -m src.main --help uv run --frozen python -m scripts.engineering_cognition --view summary --pretty uv run --frozen pytest tests/unit/test_mod_agent_cli.py -q ``` 完整 Coding Agent 运行通过任务 profile 配置目标工程、模型服务、适用的 .NET / 领域依赖，以及写入和 Build 范围，参见[Agent 注册](deployment/service/README.md#agent-注册)。 ### Docker 服务演示 环境：Docker Engine / Docker Desktop 与 Compose。将 [`.env.example`](deployment/service/.env.example) 复制为 `deployment/service/.env`，设置两个不同的随机值：`SERVICE_API_TOKEN` 和 `SERVICE_REDIS_PASSWORD`；保留已有配置，凭据不提交 Git。为什么要有它：接口和队列使用独立凭据，公开仓库只保存可共享的模板。 ```powershell docker compose --env-file deployment/service/.env -f deployment/service/compose.yaml up -d --build --scale worker=2 curl.exe http://127.0.0.1:8080/health ``` Compose 自动初始化真实仓库源码的 BM25 / Chroma 示例语料，默认运行无需模型的纯检索服务。API 文档位于 `http://127.0.0.1:8080/docs`，Prometheus 位于 `http://127.0.0.1:9095`。请求格式、认证、Agent profile 注册和停止命令见[部署指南](deployment/service/README.md)。 ## 深入阅读 | 从这里开始 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | [公开实测结果](docs/PUBLIC_RESULTS.md) | 交付案例、服务性能、故障恢复与证据范围。 | | [架构说明](docs/ARCHITECTURE_OVERVIEW.md) · [产品契约](docs/ACTIVE_PRODUCT_CONTRACT.md) | 模块职责、执行流程与权限边界。 | | [部署指南](deployment/service/README.md) · [压测说明](scripts/service_load/README.md) | API / Worker / Redis / Prometheus 部署与测量口径。 | | [测试](tests/) · [评测定义](docs/EVALUATION_DRIVEN_DEVELOPMENT.md) · [历史成果](docs/PROJECT_OUTCOMES.md) | 回归检查、评测方法与完整演进记录。 | ## 持续迭代 RepoForge 正在围绕更多独立工程任务、重复交付稳定性、训练依赖收口和服务长期运行验证持续迭代；游戏运行时与跨环境支持按具体领域任务扩展。当前发布面向本机研发与受控验证，模型质量、性能优化和成本收益以对应实验为依据，进展记录在[项目状态](docs/PROJECT_STATE.md)。 维护者负责需求定义、架构与技术选型、验收设计，并结合 AI 编码工具推进实现；平台开发、产品模型行为和独立评测分别记录。

documents.title: Agent Engineering Harness Transition
documents.text: # Agent Engineering Harness Transition Status: non-normative transition program Program direction: user-approved bounded product decision Prepared: 2026-07-25 Last reviewed: 2026-07-31 Current implementation authority effect: H1.1 and H3 promoted through Phase B; no later boundary active First selected migration boundary: H1.1 / `AGENT-HARNESS-BUILD-RUNTIME-HANDOFF-001` Implementation entry status: H1.1 and H3 complete; no later boundary active ## 1. Purpose And Authority This file defines a bounded transition from the current controlled Mod delivery platform toward a production-oriented Agent Engineering Harness. It is a transition guide, not a second product contract, workflow, implementation queue, or source of current capability claims. The engineering motivation is to reduce the cost and ambiguity of long-running Agent work: a failed late stage must not force repeated model, Proposal, Apply, or Build work; continuation must be reproducible; side effects must be admitted and recoverable at their declared evidence level; and domain Runtime behavior must remain replaceable without copying the control plane. The Harness Evolution Program is an approved bounded product direction. That decision permits evidence-producing migration work, but it does not pre-approve any specific implementation, permission, side effect, or capability claim. The working notes from 2026-07-23 are mandatory design-review input. They are not product facts, architecture authority, implementation evidence, or task authorization. Each concern from those notes must be checked against current source, focused tests, configuration, and bound run Artifacts before it can affect an architecture status or implementation task. Authority remains with the repository reading order in `AGENTS.md`. This file must not override: - `docs/ACTIVE_PRODUCT_CONTRACT.md`; - `docs/PROJECT_STATE.md`; - current source and focused tests; - `docs/SPEC_COVERAGE_MATRIX.md`; - `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_QUEUE.md`; - `docs/ARCHITECTURE_OVERVIEW.md`; - the detailed control contracts in `DEV_SPEC.md`. Only three architecture reference states are used: - `implemented`: current source plus focused evidence supports the exact claim; - `documented_only`: a responsibility or target is described but is not current behavior or an implementation task; - `conditional_trigger`: implementation is forbidden until a named product capability, observed failure, demonstrated safety defect, or bounded product decision requiring evidence activates the smallest required boundary. ## 2. Transition Baseline Gate Before H1.1 implementation begins, the implementation worktree must contain one reviewed and committed baseline that includes the latest accepted Phase 2B status, Runtime deployment/restoration behavior, marker-observation repair, Artifact contracts, and related focused tests. The current Harness transition worktree and the supplied latest Runtime worktree diverge after a shared Git checkpoint. The supplied Runtime worktree also contains uncommitted source, tests, Artifacts, and control-document changes. H1.1 must not be implemented against an older Runtime boundary merely because this transition file exists. Baseline reconciliation is complete only when: 1. the intended source versions are identified by Git commit and reviewed diff; 2. unrelated user changes remain preserved; 3. Runtime deployment/restoration source and tests are present when their documented claims are retained; 4. current Phase 2B and queue status agree across the authority documents; 5. focused Runtime and Artifact tests pass from that exact worktree; 6. `git diff --check` passes; 7. the selected implementation worktree is explicitly recorded. This gate may reconcile, commit, or deliberately reject supplied changes. It must not silently copy documents while omitting the source and tests that make their claims true. ## 3. Responsibility Boundary ### 3.1 Agent Engineering Harness The project-level Harness owns: - request and acceptance-boundary admission; - source, environment, permission, run, and attempt identity; - the existing LangGraph `StateGraph` and its conditional routes; - Artifact refs, hashes, freshness, and durable lineage; - checkpoint, handoff, resume validation, and idempotence; - model and tool admission boundaries; - review, dry-run, approval, apply, and Build gates; - failure ownership, bounded Repair routing, evaluation, and terminal classification; - context, tool-output, and trace budgets required to keep a run inspectable. ### 3.2 Domain Runtime Verification Provider A Runtime provider owns only domain-specific execution and observation: - capability preflight for the selected environment; - verified deployment and restoration when required; - process launch, liveness, termination, and cleanup; - environment-specific logs, markers, screenshots, and behavior observations; - a graph-compatible RuntimeEvidence payload with explicit limitations. The GTFO provider does not own run lifecycle, checkpoint policy, graph routing, Repair authorization, evaluation authority, or terminal success. ### 3.3 Stable And Replaceable Boundaries Stable contracts include: - run and request identity; - source and Build Artifact identity; - `ArtifactRef`, complete hash, and stale-lineage checks; - explicit authorization and disclosure boundaries; - checkpoint and resume binding; - observation source, time/byte window, and limitation; - RuntimeEvidence, evaluation, restoration outcome, and terminal lineage. Replaceable domain behavior includes: - executable and working-directory selection; - loader, plugin, configuration, and log layout; - startup and acceptance markers; - process and screenshot collection details; - environment-specific cleanup and restoration mechanics. No domain implementation may promote itself into the stable core merely because it is the first verified provider. ## 4. Target Structure ```text Agent Engineering Harness | +-- Policy And Governance Overlay | +-- deterministic admission, permission, disclosure, approval, retention, | route authority, and claim ceiling across every boundary | +-- Thin Admission / Lifecycle Boundary | +-- request, source, environment, permission, run, attempt | +-- Existing LangGraph StateGraph | +-- nodes, conditional routes, interrupts, Repair, Terminal | +-- Working-State And Durability Boundary | +-- ArtifactStore, checkpoint, handoff, continuation, lineage | +-- target: side-effect attempt journal and crash-safe re-admission | +-- Model And Tool Execution Boundary | +-- provider-neutral turns, bounded context, structured tool feedback | +-- Delivery Boundary | +-- Proposal, Review, Dry-run, Approval, Apply, Build | +-- Runtime Verification Boundary | +-- stable RuntimeEvidence contract | +-- replaceable GTFO execution and observation behavior | +-- Evaluation And Diagnostic Boundary +-- deterministic gates, trace, failure evidence, terminal claim ceiling ``` This diagram describes responsibility composition. It does not require each box to become a service, graph, registry, database, or independently deployed module. The Policy And Governance Overlay is a cross-cutting view of existing deterministic contracts, not a new policy engine, route owner, or second control plane. The unified overlay is `documented_only`; each constituent gate retains its separately evidenced status and current owner. The target diagram is intentionally more complete than the current implementation; architecture presence never bypasses Migration Boundary admission. ### 4.1 Three State Layers And Atomic Context Refresh The Harness separates three state layers: ```text Active Context the bounded input sent to one model/tool turn Working State graph state, run-local files, registered Artifacts, checkpoint, and progress Durable Project Guidance reviewed AGENTS.md rules, authority documents, Git checkpoints, and evidence-bound reusable guidance ``` **Active Context** manages the current responsibility. Each model-bearing node must construct a fresh bounded context pack from the immutable goal, exact Artifact refs/hashes, the latest relevant observation, current budget, and the node's output contract. It must not inherit an unbounded conversation merely because the previous node saw it. This is the product equivalent of atomic task-context refresh. Sliding windows, compaction, and interactive rewind are client techniques, not portable repository contracts. When equivalent behavior is needed: - a window retains only the turns required by the current node contract; - a compacted summary is derived data with source refs, limitations, and an invalidation rule, never the only durable copy of a decision; - a rewind restores or forks from a validated checkpoint and marks later outputs non-authoritative without deleting immutable audit history. No universal percentage of a context window is an acceptance threshold. The budget must be measured for the selected provider/model/task, and the Harness must disclose truncation or summarization before information is lost. **Working State** manages the selected run. Long-running work must expose inspectable progress through existing queue/state documents, graph checkpoints, and registered Artifacts. A run-local plan or scratch file may be used when it reduces context load, but it is not route or approval authority. Temporary search output, logs, and generated excerpts must be archived as registered evidence when needed for claims, or removed after the round when they have no continuing audit value. **Durable Project Guidance** manages later sessions. A new session reconstructs authority from reviewed control documents, exact Git commits, Artifact refs/hashes, and the selected checkpoint/handoff. Git commits bind source history but do not replace graph state or Runtime evidence. `AGENTS.md` remains minimal and project-specific; Skills remain evaluated process guidance. Neither becomes an automatic store of model reasoning. ## 5. Mandatory Harness Design Lenses Every Migration Boundary review must address every row below. A row may be not applicable to the selected boundary, but it may not be silently omitted. | Lens | Current bounded evidence | Transition rule | | --- | --- | --- | | Model behavior profile | Provider-neutral structured turns and bounded output settings are `implemented` at their recorded paths; one universal role-based sampling policy is `documented_only` | Bind model identity, provider, output/context budget, structured-output contract, fallback, and retry. Model replacement requires the same contract tests and one bounded task evaluation; do not copy universal sampling or repetition values across providers or roles | | Active context | The Evidence loop's compact trajectory, latest full observation, byte accounting, and bounded correction are `implemented`; a repository-wide compaction system is `conditional_trigger` | Build a fresh node-specific context pack; preserve decisions and refs rather than full dialogue.
